translations.source: "አሁን የስኳር በሽተኛ ያልነበሩ አሁን ግን የሆኑ የ4-ወር-ዕድሜ ያላቸው አይጦች አሉን፣ አለ። "
translations.reference: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.hypothesis: "We now have 4-month-old babies who have never known a world without sugar," he said.

translations.source: ዶክተር ኢሁድ ኡር፣ በሃሊፉሽ፣ ኖቫስኮሽያ ውስጥ በሚገኘው በዳልሃውዚ ዩኒቨርሲቲ የህክምና ፕሮፌሰር፣ እና የካናዳዊ የስኳር ህመ ማህበር የክሊኒካዊ እና ሳይንሳዊ ክፍል ሊቀመንበር ጥናቱ ገና በጅማሬ ወቅቱ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል።
translations.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Judah Urquhart, a medical professor at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia, and chairman of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association, said the study is still in its early stages.

translations.source: ልክ እንደ ሌሎች ባለሙያዎች፣ አይነት 1 የስኳር በሽታ ላለባቸው ሰዎች እነዚህ ግኝቶች ምንም ጥቅም እንደሌላቸው በመገንዘብ የስኳር በሽታ ሊፈወስ የሚችል መሆኑን ይጠራጠራል።
translations.reference: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.hypothesis: Like other professionals, he is aware that there is no known cure for diabetes, but he is convinced that diabetes can be reversed.

translations.source: ሰኞ ዕለት፣ ሳራ ዳኒየስ፣ ለኖቤል ኮሚቴ ለስነ ጽሁፍ በስዊድናዊ አካዳሚ ቋሚ ጸሃፊ የሆነቸው፣ በስዊድን ውስጥ በስቨሪጅስ ሬድዮ ፕሮግራም ላይ ኮሚቴው፣ ቦብ ዲላንን ስለ በስነ ጽሁፍ የ2016 የኖቤል ሽልማቱን ስለማሸንፍ ማግኘት ስላልቻለ፣ እርሱን ለመድረስ ጥረቶችን እንሚያቋረጥ በግልጽ ተናገረ።
translations.reference: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.hypothesis: On Monday, Sara Danius, the permanent secretary of the Swedish Academy, announced on a Swedish radio programme that the committee had been unable to reach a consensus on who should win the 2016 Nobel Prize for Literature, and that they would be breaking with tradition by not announcing the winner.

translations.source: “አሁን ምንም እያደግን አይደለም። ለቅርብ ተባባሪው ደውያለሁ አና ኢሜይል ልክያለሁ እናም በጣም ተስማሚ መልሶችን ተቀብያለሁ። ለጊዜው፣ ይህ በእርግጥ በቂ ነው።” አለ ዳኒየስ።
translations.reference: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.hypothesis: "I'm not saying we're not doing anything. I'm in constant contact with my top three to five potential competitors, and I'm getting very positive feedback. For the time being, that's enough for me," D'anielles says.

translations.source: ከዚህ ቀደም፣ የሪንግ ዋና ሥራ አስኪያጅ፣ ጄሚ ሲሚኖፍ፣ ኩባንያው የጀመው የበር ደውሉ መኪና ማቆሚያው ውስጥ በሚገኘው ሱቅ ውስጥ አልሰማ ሲለው እንደሆነ ተናግሯል።
translations.reference: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.hypothesis: Previously, the company's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, said the company didn't hear from the car parked in the garage where the Ring's Doorbell was installed.

translations.source: እሱ እንዳለው፣ የWiFi የበር ደውል ሰራ።
translations.reference: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.hypothesis: He said, "The WiFi was down.

translations.source: ፓናሉ ለንግድ መጀመር ገንዘብ በተከለከለበት በ2013 በሻርክ ታንክ ምዕራፍ ላይ ከቀረበ ወዲህ ሽያጭ እንደጨመረ ሲሚኖፍ ተነግሯል።
translations.reference: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.hypothesis: Since his appearance on the show, where he failed to secure funding from the sharks, sales have increased, he told CNN.

translations.source: በ2017 መጨረሻ ላይ፣ ሲሚኖፍ በሽያጭ የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ ላይ ቀርቦ ነበር።
translations.reference: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.hypothesis: By the end of 2017, Siminoff was pitching his business on TV.

translations.source: ሪንግ ከተፎካካሪ የደህንነት ኩባንያም ADT ኮርፖሬሽን፣ ጋር ክስ መስርቷል።
translations.reference: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.hypothesis: Ring is also being sued by security company ADT Corporation.

translations.source: አንደ የሙከራ ክትባት የኢቦላን ገዳይነት ቢቀንስም፣ እስካሁን፣ ነባር በሽታዎችን እንዲያክም አመቺ ሆኖ የቀረበ ምንም መድሃኒት የለም።
translations.reference: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.hypothesis: There is as yet no licensed drug or vaccine that reduces viral load or has been shown to improve survival in people with EVD, although a range of potential treatments and vaccines are currently being piloted.

translations.source: አንድ የጸረ እንግዳ አካል፣ ZMapp፣ በዚህ መስክ ላይ ተስፋን አሳይቶ ነበር፣ ግን መደበኛ ጥናቶች ሞትን ለመከላከል ከተፈለገው ጥቅም ያነሰ እንዳለው ያሳያል።
translations.reference: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.hypothesis: One monoclonal antibody, ZMapp, has shown some efficacy in this area, but clinical studies have indicated it provides only a modest benefit in preventing deaths.

translations.source: በPALM ሙከራ፣ ZMapp እንደ መቆጣጠሪያ ያገለግል ነበር፣ ማለት ተመራማሪዎች እንደ መነሻ ይጠቀሙበት እና ከሌሎች ሶስት ህክምናዎች ጋር ያነጻጽሩታል።
translations.reference: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.hypothesis: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as the control, meaning the researchers used it as the starting point and compared the other three treatments to it.

translations.source: የአሜሪካ ጂምናስቲ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ኦሎፒክ ኮሚቴ ደብዳቤ ይደግፋል እናም በሙሉ አስፈላጊነት የኦሎምፒክ ቤተሰብ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ አካባቢ ለሁሉም አትሌቶቻችን ማስተዋወቅ እንዳለበት ይቀበላል።
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.hypothesis: The US Gymnastics Federation supports the United States Olympic Committee and stands with all athletes in demanding a safe environment for all.

translations.source: የአተሌቶቻችን እና የክለቦቻችን ፍላጎቶች እና ስፖርታቸው፣ እንደገና ከማጽደቅ ይልቅ በድርጅታችን ውስጥ ትርጉም ባለው ለውጥ ወደፊት በመጓዝ የአትሌቶቻችን እና የክለቦቻችን ፍላጎቶች እና ስፖርታቸው በተሻለ ሊገለገሉ ይችላሉ፣ ከሚለው የ USOC መግለጫ እንስማማለን።
translations.reference: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.hypothesis: We agree with the USOC that the needs and interests of our athletes and clubs are best served by moving forward with a significant change within our organization, rather than a re-vote," said a statement from the clubs.

translations.source: የ USA ጂምናስቲክስ በላሪ ናስር በሕይወት የተረፉት ሰዎች በድፍረት በተገለጸው የበደል መጠን ምላይ ምን ያህል ሳይመረመር ለረጅም ጊዜ ሊሄድ የነበረበትን ሁኔታን በደምብ ሊያብራራ የሚችል ገለልተኛ ምርመራን ይደግፋል እናም ማንኛውንም አስፈላጊ እና ተገቢ ለውጦችንም ይቀበላል።
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics stands by the survivors and supports the independent investigation as it may reveal the extent to which Larry Nassar was enabled and the steps that should be taken to ensure that such abuse is never again tolerated.

translations.source: የዩ.ኤስ.ኤ ጂምናስቲክስ እና USOC ተመሳሳይ ግቦች አሏቸው — የጂምናስቲክስ እና ሌሎች ስፖርቶች በተቻለ መጠን ህልማቸውን ለሚከተሉ አትሌቶች የተጠበቀ፣ አውንታዊ እና አበረታች አካባቢ ማድረግ።
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics and the USOC share the goal of providing a safe, positive and supportive environment in which young athletes can pursue their dreams in gymnastics and other sports.

translations.source: በ1960ዎቹ፣ ብርዜዚንስኪ ለ ጆን.ኤፍ ኬኔድ እና ለአማካሪዎቹ ይሰራ ነበር እና ከዚያ በኋላ ለ ሊንደን ቢ. ጆንሰን አስተዳደር።
translations.reference: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy and his advisors, and later for the administration of Lyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: በ1976 ምርጫዎች ካርተርን በውጪ ፖሊሲ አማከረ፣ ከዚያን ሄንሪ ኪሲንገርን በመተካት ከ1977 እስከ 1981 እንደ ብሄራዊ የደህንነት አማካሩ(NSA) አገልግሏል።
translations.reference: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: In 1976, he advised Carter on foreign policy and then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: እንደ NSA፣ እንደ ካምፕ ዴቪድ አኮርድስ፣ 1978፤ በ1970ዎች የአሜሪካ እና የቻይና ግንኙነትን መመለስ፤ የኢራን ታጋች ቀውስን የመራው የኢራን ርዕዮተ አለም፣ 1979፤ እና በአፍጋኒስታን የሶቭየት ወረራ፣ 1979 ያሉ የአለም ጉዳዪች በዲፕሎማሲ መንገድ ለማስተናገድ ካርተርን ረዳው።
translations.reference: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: Global issues that Carter helped mediate through diplomacy include the Strategic Arms Limitation Treaty (SALT I), 1972; the restoration of relations between the United States and China in 1972; the Camp David Accords, 1978; the Iranian hostage crisis, stemming from the Iranian Revolution, 1979; and the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan, 1979.

translations.source: ራየን ጎሊንግ እና ኤማ ስቶን የሰሩበት ፊልም በሁሉም ዋና ምድቦች እጩነት አግኝተዋል።
translations.reference: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.hypothesis: The film, in which Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone star, has received nominations in all major categories.

translations.source: ጎዝሊንግ እና ስቶንስ ለምርጥ ተዋናይ እና ሴት ተዋናይ ለአጩነት ቀርብዋል።
translations.reference: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling and Stone are up for Best Actor and Best Actress respectively.

translations.source: ሌሎቹ እጩዎች ምርጥ ምስል፣ ዳይሬክተር፣ ሲኒማቶግራፊ፣ የአልባሳት ዲዛይን፣ ለፊልም ኤዲቲንግ፣ የመጀመሪያ ውጤት፣ የምርት ዲዛይን፣ የድምጽ ኤዲቲንግ፣ የድምጽ ሚክሲንግ እና የመጀመሪያ ድርሰት ያጠቃልላሉ።
translations.reference: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.hypothesis: The other categories are Best Cinematography, Best Director, Best Film Editing, Best Original Costume Design, Best Original Music, Best Original Score, Best Production Design, Best Sound Editing, Best Sound Mixing, and Best Visual Effects.

translations.source: ከፊሉ ሁለቱ ሙዚቃዎች፣ ኦዲሽን (ዘ ፉልስ ሁ ድሪም) እና ሲተ ኦፍ ስታርስ፣ ለምርጡ አዲስ ሙዚቃ እጩነት አግኝተዋል። ላየንስጌት ስቱዲዮ 26 እጩዎችን አገኝቷል — ከማንኛውም ስቱዲዮ የበለጠ።
translations.reference: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.hypothesis: Some of the songs, Audition (The Full Story) and City of Stars, were nominated for Best Original Song. Lainges Studio had the most nominations with 26 — more than any other studio.

translations.source: እሁድ ማለዳ ላይ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በፕሬስ ፀሃፊው በኩል በሰጡት መግለጫ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ከሶሪያ እንደሚለቁ አስታውቀዋል።
translations.reference: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.hypothesis: Early Sunday morning, President of the United States Donald Trump announced via his Twitter account that the United States military would be withdrawing from Syria.

translations.source: ማስታወቂያው የተነገረው ትራምፕ ከቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ሬሴፕ ታዪፕ ኤርዶጋን ጋር በስልክ ከተወያዩ በኋላ ነው።
translations.reference: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.hypothesis: The announcement was made after a phone call between Trump and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

translations.source: የአውሮፓ አገራት ወደ ሀገራቸው ለመመለስ ፈቃደኛ ባልሆኑበት፣ መግለጫው ቱርክ የተያዙትን የአይ ኤስ ተዋጊዎችን ጥበቃም ትረከባለች ብሏል።
translations.reference: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.hypothesis: The statement also said that Turkey was responsible for the protection of the IS fighters who were being returned to their home countries, even though the European countries were unwilling to take them back.

translations.source: ይህ ዳይኖሰሮች ላባ እንደነበራቸው፣ የተስፋፋ ጽንሰ ሃሳብ፣ ብቻ ሳይሆን ነገር ግን ቅሪት አካላት ሊያቀርቡ የማይችሉትን እንደ ቀለም እና ባለ ሶስት ልኬት አቀማመጥ አይነት ዝርዝሮችንም ያረጋግጣል።
translations.reference: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.hypothesis: This confirms not only that the dinosaurs had feathers, but also provides information on the types of colours and patterns that they may have had, which cannot be obtained from the fossil record.

translations.source: . የዚህ እንሰሳ የላባ ቀለም ደማቅ ቡናማ ከላይ እና ነጣ ወይም ብርትኳናማ ካታች ነው ብለዋል ተመራማሪዎች።
translations.reference: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.hypothesis: The animal's skin is said to be dark brown with a lighter or spotted belly.

translations.source: ግኝቱ በወፎች ውስጥ ስለ የላባ ዝግመተ ለውጥ እይታን ይሰጣል።
translations.reference: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.hypothesis: The find gives insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.

translations.source: የዳይነሶር ላባዎች የዳበረ ራቺስ የሚባል ዘንግ ስለሌለው፣ ነገር ግን ሌሎች የላባ ባህርያት — ባርብስ እና ባርቡልስ — ስላለው ተመራማሪዎች ራቺስ ከእነዚህ ሌሎች ባህርያት የቆየ ዝግመተ ለውጥ ውጤት እንደሆነ ይላሉ።
translations.reference: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.hypothesis: Since the lampreys lack a true backbone, but have other features common to the vertebrata — barbels and barbels — some scientists believe that the vertebrata have evolved from some other chordate.

translations.source: የላባዎቹ መዋቀር ለበረራ የሚውሉ ሳይሆን ለሙቀት መቆጣጠር ወይንም ለእያታ ነው። ተመራማሪዎች ይህ የልጅ ዳይኖሰር ጭራ ቢሆንም፣ ናሙናው የአዋቂ ላባዎች ስብስብ እንጂ የዶሮ እንዳልሆነ ተናግረዋል።
translations.reference: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The large structures are not used for flight but are used for thermoregulation or display. The scientists said that although this is a juvenile dinosaur, the specimen is a collection of adult bones and not a chicken.

translations.source: ተመራማሪዎች ይህ የልጅ ዳይኖሰር ጭራ ቢሆንም፣ ናሙናው የአዋቂ ላባዎች ስብስብ እንጂ የዶሮ እንዳልሆነ ተናግረዋል።
translations.reference: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists said the sample was not a dinosaur feather, but a collection of adult ratites, which are flightless birds.

translations.source: በጋዚያንተፕ፣ ቱርክ ውስጥ በትናንትናው እለት በፖሊስ ዋና ጽህፈት ቤት ውስጥ በፈነዳው የመኪና ፈንጂ ሁለት ፖሊሶች ተገድለዋል እና ከሃያ በላይ ሰዎች ተጎደተዋል።
translations.reference: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.hypothesis: Two police officers were killed and more than twenty injured in a car bomb explosion yesterday outside a police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey.

translations.source: የአገረ ገዢው ቢሮ አስራ ዘጠኝ ፖሊስ መኮንኖች ተጎድተዋል ብሎ ተናገረ።
translations.reference: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.hypothesis: The governor's office said 19 police officers were injured.

translations.source: ፖሊስ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው ተጠርጣሪ የዴእሽ (ISIL) አማጺ ነው ብለው ተጠርጥረዋል።
translations.reference: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.hypothesis: Police suspect the attack was the work of the so-called Islamic State (ISIL).

translations.source: ጸሀይ የሚሰራበት መሰረታዊ መርህ ለሎች ኮከቦች ከሚሰሩበት መርህ ጋር ተመሳሳይ እንደሆነ አግኝተዋል፡ በስርዓቱ ውስጥ የሁሉንም ኮከቦች እንቅስቃሴ የሚመራው በማንፀባረቅ፣ በመሽከርከራቸው እና በሌላ በምንም እንዳልሆነ ተገኝቷል።
translations.reference: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.hypothesis: They found that the basic principles of how the Sun works are the same as for other stars: that the motion of all the stars in the system is determined by gravity, and that they are all moving around each other.

translations.source: የብርሃን መጠን እና መሽከርከሩ አንድላይ ከፕላዝማ ፍሰት ጋር የሚገናኘውን የኮከብ ሮስቢ ቁጥርን ለመፈለግ ተጠቅመው ነበር።
translations.reference: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.hypothesis: They used the amount of light and the star's color to find out how fast it was moving towards or away from us.

translations.source: ሮስቡ ቁጥሩ ባነሰ ቁጥር፣ ከመገነጢስ መገልበጥ አንጻር የኮከቡ ንቃት ይቀንሳል።
translations.reference: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.hypothesis: The lower the Rossby number, the more the flow is influenced by the Coriolis effect.

translations.source: በጉዞው ላይ፣ ኢዋሳኪ በብዙ አጋጣሚዎች ላይ ችግር አጋጥሞታል።
translations.reference: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.hypothesis: On the trip, Ewasaki faced many challenges.

translations.source: በባህር ላይ ወንበዴዎች ተዘርፏል፣ በቲቤት ውስጥ በእብድ ውሻ ተነክሷል፣ በኔፓል ውስጥ ከጋብቻ አምልጧል እና በህንድ ውስጥ ታስሯል።
translations.reference: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.hypothesis: He'd been shanghaied on a ship, bitten by a rabid dog in Tibet, eloped in Nepal and imprisoned in India.

translations.source: የ 802.11n ደረጃ በሁለቱም በ 2.4 ጊኸርትዝ እና በ 5.0 ጊኸዝ ሞገድ ይሠራል።
translations.reference: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.hypothesis: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4 GHz and 5.0 GHz bands.

translations.source: የዋና ጣቢያው ሁለት ሬዲዮዎች ሳሉት፣ ይህ ከ 802.11a ፣ 802.11b እና 802.11g ጋር ወደኋላ የሚስማማ እንዲሆን ያስችለዋል።
translations.reference: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.hypothesis: The base station has two radios, which allows it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g.

translations.source: የ802.11n ፍጥነቶች በፊት ከነበረው ከፍተኛ ንድፈ ሀሳባዊ 600 ሜቢ/ሰ ከሆነው እጅግ ይፈጥናል።
translations.reference: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: The 802.11n speeds are much faster than the theoretical maximum of 600 Mbps that was available before.

translations.source: ዱቫል፣ አግብቶ ሁለት አዋቂ ልጆች ያሉት፣ በሚለር፣ ታሪኩ ከተገናኘው፣ ላይ ትልቅ ተዕጽኖ አላሳደረም።
translations.reference: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.hypothesis: Duvall, married with two grown children, was not significantly affected by the Lerp story.

translations.source: ለአስተያየት ሲጠየቅ፣ በችሎቱ “ወቅት ማይክ ብዙ ያወራል... እየተዘጋጀሁ ስለነበር ምን እንደሚል እየሰማሁ አልነበረም።” አለ ሚለር።
translations.reference: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.hypothesis: When asked for comment, Miller said in a statement to the press, "The mic was on when I said that, and I was cut off before I could finish my thought."

translations.source: "የካርቦን ዳይኦክሳይድ ለቀትን ለGDP እያንዳንዱ አሃድ ከ2005 አንጻር በሚታወቅ ልዩነት በ2020 ለመቀነስ እንሰራለን፣ አለ ሁ። "
translations.reference: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.hypothesis: "We will work to reduce the carbon footprint of GDP per capita by 2030, relative to 2005 levels," he said.

translations.source: በቻይና የኢኮኖሚ ወጪ መሰረት ይሰራሉ በማለት ለማለፊያዎቹ ቁጥር አላስቀመጠም።
translations.reference: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.hypothesis: It did not give a figure for the number of routers, saying only that they were operated by China-based economic entities.

translations.source: ሑ ታዳጊ ሀገሮች “ውሀን አሁን በክሎ በኋላ የማጥራት መንገድን እንዲተዉ” አበረታተዋል።
translations.reference: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.hypothesis: Encourage developing countries to move ‘beyond the use of boiling as the primary means of household water treatment’.

translations.source: “ከእድገታቸው ደረጃ፣ ሀላፊነት እና አቅም ባለፈ ሀላፊነት እንዲወስዱ መጠየቅ የለባቸውም።” ብሎ ተናገረ።
translations.reference: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.hypothesis: They shouldn't be asked to take on responsibilities beyond their developmental stage, capacity, and experience," she said.

translations.source: የኢራቅ ጥናት ቡድን ሪፖርቱን ዛሬ ከቀኑ 12.00 GMT ሰዓት ላይ አቅርቧል።
translations.reference: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
translations.hypothesis: The Iraq Study Group will present its report at 12.00 GMT today.

translations.source: ማስጠንቀቂያው በዚህ ወቅት በኢራቅ ውስጥ የሚወሰደው ማንኛውም እርምጃ የሃይማኖት ጦርነትን ፣ የግጭት መጨመርን ወይም ወደ ትርምስ መንሸራተትን ያስቆማል የሚል ማንም ዋስትና ሊሰጥ አይችልም።
translations.reference: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
translations.hypothesis: No guarantees can be given that any action taken in Iraq at this time will not result in sectarian violence, escalation of the conflict, or further fragmentation of the country.

translations.source: ሪፖርቱ የተከፈተው ክፍት የሆነ ክርክር እንዲኖር በመጠየቅ እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ስላለው ፖሊሲ በአሜሪካ ውስጥ የጋራ መግባባት በመፍጠር ነው።
translations.reference: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
translations.hypothesis: The report opens with a call for an open debate and the forging of a consensus in the United States, where policy toward the Middle East is made.

translations.source: ሪፖርቱ ለአስፈፃሚው ወደ ኢራቅ ያለው የአሁኑ የአስፈፃሚ ፖሊሲ አቅጣጫ በሁሉም አኳያ ላይ በጣም ወሳኝ ነው እናም በአፋጣኝ አቅጣጫ እንዲለወጥ አሳስቧል።
translations.reference: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.hypothesis: The report is highly concerned by the current trend in the Executive’s policy towards Iraq and calls for an immediate reversal of course.

translations.source: ከ 78 ቱ ምክሮች መካከል የመጀመሪያው የኢራቅ ድንበሮችን ከጠላት ጣልቃገብነቶች ለመጠበቅ እና ከጎረቤቶችዋ ጋር ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነትን እንደገና ለማቋቋም ከዚህ ዓመት መጨረሻ በፊት አዲስ የዲፕሎማሲ ውጥን መወሰድ አለበት የሚል ነው።
translations.reference: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.hypothesis: The first of 78 recommendations urges the Iraqi government to adopt a new diplomatic approach before the end of the year to protect its borders from enemy provocations and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.

translations.source: የአሁኑ ሴኔተር እና የአርጀትኒና ቀዳማዊ እመቤት ክርስቲና ፈርናንዴዝ ዴ ክሪችነር ለፕሬዝዳንትነት ተወዳዳሪ እንደሆነች ትናንትና ማታ በ ላ ፕላታ፣ ከ ቡዌኖስ ኤሪስ 50 ኪሎሜትሮች (31 ማይሎች) በሚርቅ ከተማ ላይ አስታወቀች።
translations.reference: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: The current senator and former first lady of Argentina, Cristina Fernández de Kirchner, announced yesterday evening that she will run for president in the upcoming general election.

translations.source: ወ/ሮ ክሪችነር የአርጀንቲናዊ ትያትር፣ ለቡዌኖስ ኤሪስ ክፍለ ሀገር የሴኔት አባል ለመሆን ለየ2005 ዘመቻውን የጀመረችበት ተመሳሳይ ቦታ ላይ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ለመሆን እቅዷን አሳውቃለች።
translations.reference: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.hypothesis: Ms. Kirchner announced her presidential bid at the same venue where she launched her 2005 campaign to become a senator for the province of Buenos Aires, Argentina.

translations.source: ክርክሩ የተነሳው በአውሎ ንፋስ ካትሪና ስለ በመመለስ እና ዳግም በመገንባት ላይ ነው፤ አንዳንድ የፋይናንስ ውይይቶች “የቡሽ ኒው ኦርሊንስ ውል” የሚል ቀልድ ተሰይመዋል።
translations.reference: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.hypothesis: The debate was over the response to, and rebuilding of, New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina; some of the financial dealings were dubbed "the New Orleans deal" by Bush critics.

translations.source: በዳግም የመገንባት ጥረት ላይ ነጻ ትችት ለሚታዩት የዋሽንግተን ውስጣዊዎች የዳግም መገንባት ኮንትራቶችን መሸለም ላይ ትኩረት አድርጓል።
translations.reference: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
translations.hypothesis: The free speech absolutist Washington Post has focused on the sale of reconstruction contracts.

translations.source: ከአራት ሚሊዮን ሰዎች በላይ የቀብር ስነ ስርዓቱን ለመካፈል ወደ ሮም ሄደዋል።
translations.reference: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
translations.hypothesis: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.

translations.source: የተገኘው የሰው ቁጥር ብዙ ከመሆኑ የተነሳ በቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ አደባባይ ላይ ለተደረገው የቀብር ስነ ስረዓት ሁሉም ሰው ተደራሽነት ማግኘት አልቻለም።
translations.reference: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the large number of people who had come to pay their respects, it was impossible to get close to the tomb in St. Peter's Square.

translations.source: ሥነ ሥርዓቱን ህዝቡ እንዲከታተል በሮም የተለያዩ ቦታዎች በርካታ ትልልቅ የቴሌቪዥን ማያ ስክሪኖች ተተክለው ነበር።
translations.reference: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.hypothesis: Screens were set up in various locations throughout Rome for the public to watch the ceremony.

translations.source: በጣልያን ሌሎች ከተሞች እና በተቀሪው ዓለም፣ በተለይም በፖላንድ፣ በጣም በትልቅ የሕዝብ ቁጥር የታዩ ተመሳሳይ አደረጃጀቶች ተፈጥረው ነበር።
translations.reference: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.hypothesis: Similar organizations were founded in other Italian cities and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, where a large Polish-speaking community existed.

translations.source: የኤፍቢአይ የስኬት ደረጃን ለማሳደግ በማሰብ፣ በተለይም በቀላሉ ሊፈቱ በሚችሉ ጉዳዮች፣ በተሰረቁ የመኪና ጉዳዮች ላይ ትኩረት በማድረጋቸው የታሪክ ተመራማሪዎች ያለፉ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ትችት ሰንዝረዋል።
translations.reference: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.hypothesis: Historians criticize the policy, saying that the FBI's focus on easily solved cases, such as car theft, rather than more difficult cases, such as terrorism, has led to a decline in the FBI's success rate.

translations.source: በ2005 አመት ምክር ቤቱ የወሲብ ተነሳሽነትን በገንዘብ ማገዝ ጀመረ አና FBI 10 ወኪሎችን ወደ ለወሲባዊ ፊልሞች መስጠት እንዳለበት ጠቅሷል።
translations.reference: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
translations.hypothesis: In 2005, the Council began funding an initiative to train and deploy 10 FBI agents to work undercover in the adult film industry.

translations.source: ሮቢን ኡታፓ፣ በ41 ኳሶች በ11 ፎሮች እና በ 2 ሲክሶችን በመምታት፣ የኢኒንጉን ከፍተኛ ውጤት 70 ሩጫዎችን አስመዘገበ።
translations.reference: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa, with 70 runs off 41 balls, including 11 fours and 2 sixes, recorded the highest score for the innings.

translations.source: መካከለኛ ደረጃ ባትስማኖች፣ ሳቺን ቴንዱልካር እና ራሁል ድራቪድ፣ ጥሩ ተጫውቱ እና የመቶ ሩጫ ኣጋርነት አደረጉ።
translations.reference: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.hypothesis: The middle-order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, played well together and added a century stand.

translations.source: ነገር ግን፣ ካፒቴኑን ዊኬት ህንድ ከተሸነፈች በኋላ እስከመጨረሻው 36 ሩጫ እና 7 ዊኬቶችን ተሸንፋለች።
translations.reference: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.hypothesis: However, they lost by 36 runs and 7 wickets in the final.

translations.source: የአሜሪካ ፕሬዚዳንት ጆርጅ ቡሽ ህዳር 16 ቀን ጠዋት ላይ ሲንጋፖር ደርሰዋል፣ ከዚያም ሳምንታዊ ጉብኝት በእስያ አደረጉ።
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.hypothesis: President George W. Bush of the United States arrived in Singapore on the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long visit to Asia.

translations.source: በሲንጋፖር ምክትል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዊን ካን ሴንግ አቀባበል የተደረጉ ሲሆን ከንግድ ሥራ እና ከአሸባሪነት ጉዳዮች ጋር በሲንጋፖር ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሊ ሄይን ሎንግ ጋር ተወያይተዋል።
translations.reference: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.hypothesis: They were received by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister, Teo Chee Hean, and discussed with Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong, matters of trade and security.

translations.source: በአጋማሽ ምርጫው ከሳምንት ሽንፈት ቡሃላ፣ ቡሽ በእስያ ውስጥ ስላለው የንግድ ሥራ መስፋፋት ለታዳሚዎች ተናግሯል፡፡
translations.reference: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
translations.hypothesis: After a week of losses, Bush told investors that he was still committed to expanding the business in Asia.

translations.source: ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ስቴፈን ሃርፐር የመንግስትን የ “ንፁህ አየር ሕግ”ን ከሁለተኛው ንባብ በፊት ከማክሰኞው ከጠቅላይ ሚንስትር ጃክ ሎይተን ጋር በPMO ላይ ከተደረገው የ25 ደቂቃ ስብሰባ በኋላ ለአጠቃላይ ፓርቲ ኮሚቴ እንዲገመገም ለመላክ ተስማምተዋል።
translations.reference: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.hypothesis: Prime Minister Stephen Harper agreed to send his government's proposed "Clean Air Act" to a general committee for review after a 25-minute meeting with Jack Layton, the Liberal Party leader, at the PMO on Tuesday morning.

translations.source: ሌይተን ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ጋር በተደረገው ስብሰባ ወቅት የወግ አጥባቂዎች አካባቢያዊ የህግ ረቂቅ ላይ ለውጦች እንዲደረጉ፣ የወግ አጥባቂው ፓርቲ አካባቢያዊ የህግ ረቂቅ “ዝርዝር እና የተሟላ ፅሁፍ” እንዲቀርብላቸው ጠይቀዋል።
translations.reference: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.hypothesis: During the meeting with the Prime Minister, the Conservatives demanded that the environmental bill be amended to include their proposals for a "detailed and comprehensive" environmental plan.

translations.source: ፌዴራል መንግስቱ ዴቨንፖርት፣ ታስሜኒያ ውስጥ ላለው ሜርሴይ ሆስፒታል የገንዘብ ድጋፍን ለመስጠት ከወሰነ ጊዜ ጀምሮ፣ የክልል መንግስት እና አንዳንድ ፌዴራል የፓርላማ አባላት ይህንን ድርጊት ኖቬምበር ላይ ለሚጠራው የፌዴራል ምርጫ ሴራ ነው ብለው ተችተውታል።
translations.reference: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.hypothesis: Since the federal government committed to funding the Mercy Hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal parliamentarians have criticised the move as a lead-up to a federal election in November.

translations.source: ነገር ግን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጆን ሆዋርድ እንደተናገሩት ድርጊቱ ተጨማሪ የ AUD$45 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በመስጠት የሆስፒታሉን ተቋማት በታስማኒያ መንግስት እንዳያወርዱ ለመጠበቅ ብቻ ነበር።
translations.reference: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
translations.hypothesis: However, Premier John Howard said the action was only to protect the hospital's facilities from being taken over by the Tasmanian government, which would cost an extra AUD$45 million.

translations.source: በቅርቡ ማስታወቂያ መሰረት፣ የባህር ወለል ንባቦች ሱናሚ መመንጨቱን አመልክተዋል። ከፓጎ ፓጎ እና ኒዌ አቅራቢያ የተረጋገጠ የሱናሚ እንቅስቃሴ ተመዝግቧል።
translations.reference: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
translations.hypothesis: According to a recent announcement, undersea landslides have been attributed to the tsunami. A confirmed tsunami activity was also registered near Pago Pago and Niuatoputapu.

translations.source: በቶንጋ ምንም ዓይነት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ወይም የአካል ጉዳት አልተዘገበም፣ ቢሆንም ግን ለጊዜው ኃይል ጠፍቶ ነብር፣ ይህም ደግሞ የቶንጋ ባለሥልጣናት በ PTWC የተሰጠውን የሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያ እንዳያገኙ እንዳደረጋቸው ተገልጿል።
translations.reference: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
translations.hypothesis: There were no immediate reports of major damage or injuries in Tonga, but there was a blackout, which officials attributed to the tsunami warning issued by PTWC.

translations.source: ማስጠንቀቂያዎቹ ቢነሱም በሃዋይ ውስጥ በባህር ዳርቻዎች ወይም አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ 14 ትምህርት ቤቶች ረቡዕ ቀን በሙሉ ተዘግተዋል።
translations.reference: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
translations.hypothesis: Although the alerts were lifted, 14 schools in the Hawaiian Islands and one in Guam were closed on Wednesday.

translations.source: የዩኤስ ፕሬዚደንት ጆርጅ ደብሊው ቡሽ መግለጫውን ተቀብሏል።
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
translations.hypothesis: The US President George W. Bush welcomed the declaration.

translations.source: የቡሽ ቃል አቀባይ ጎርደን ጆንድሮ የሰሜን ኮሪያን ቃል “የኮሪያ ባሕረ ሰላጤን እርግጠኛ የሆነ ከኒውክሊየር የማጽዳት ግብን ለማሳካት ትልቅ እርምጃ ነው” ብለዋል፡፡
translations.reference: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
translations.hypothesis: Bush's chief speechwriter, Gordon D. Johndroe, said the North Korean action was "a positive step toward the goal of a nuclear-free Korean peninsula."

translations.source: በአትላንቲክ ውቅያኖስ ወቅት ዛሬ አስረኛው የተሰየመ አውሎነፋስ ጄሪ፣ በአትላንቲክ ውቅያኖስ ተመስርቷል።
translations.reference: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
translations.hypothesis: Tropical Storm Jerry, the tenth named storm of the 2023 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the Atlantic Ocean.

translations.source: የብሔራዊ አውሎ ነፋሳት ማዕከል (NHC) እንደገለጸው በዚህ ጊዜ ጄሪ ለመሬት ሥጋት የለውም።
translations.reference: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
translations.hypothesis: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) said Jerry is no longer a threat to land.

translations.source: የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ሰራዊት ክፍል የምህንድስና ቡድን እንደሚገምተው 6 ኢንች ዝናብ ቀደም ሲል ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ግድቦች ሊያልፍ ይችላል።
translations.reference: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
translations.hypothesis: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers estimates that 6 inches of rain could top the levees protecting the valley.

translations.source: በካትሪና አውሎነፋስ ወቅት እስከ 20 ጫማ ከፍታ ያለው በጎርፍ መጥለቅለቅ ያጋጠመው ዘጠነኛው ክፍል፣ በአሁኑ ጊዜ የአቅራቢያው ግድብ በከፍታ ስለተበለጠ ከወገብ በላይ ውሃ ውስጥ ይገኛል።
translations.reference: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
translations.hypothesis: The ninth district, which was hit by a 20-foot storm surge during Hurricane Katrina, is now below sea level due to the levee failing.

translations.source: ውሃው 100ጫማ ስፋት ባለው ክፍል ግድቡ ላይ እየፈሰሰ ነው።
translations.reference: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
translations.hypothesis: The water was flowing down the channel toward the dam, which was 100 feet wide.

translations.source: የ Commons አስተዳዳሪ አደም ኩርደን ባለፈው ወር ከ Wikinews ጋር ሲነጋገሩ በስረዛው ላይ የተሰማቸውን ብስጭት ገልጸዋል።
translations.reference: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.hypothesis: Commons administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration with the deletion on his blog last month, in a post titled "Wikinews' slow death".

translations.source: "እሱ [ዌልስ] ከመጀመሪያውም እየዋሸን ነበር። መጀመሪያ፤ ይህ ለህጋዊ ምክንያቶች እንደሆነ በማስመሰል። ሁለተኛ፤ እስከ ስዕሉ መሰረዝ ድረስ እኛን እየሰማን እንደሆነ በመምሰል።"
translations.reference: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
translations.hypothesis: "He [Wells] was lying to us from the start. Firstly, he said it was for legal reasons. Secondly, he said we were imagining things until he deleted the image."

translations.source: የህብረተሰቡ ብስጭት በሚልዮን የሚቆጠሩ በግልፅ ፈቃድ ያላቸው የመገናኛ ብዙሃንን ለሚያስተናግደው ጣቢያ የወሲብ ይዘት በተመለከተ ፖሊሲ ለማርቀቅ የአሁኑን ጥረት አስከትሏል።
translations.reference: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
translations.hypothesis: The public outcry has prompted the current administration to introduce legislation aimed at regulating content on social media platforms.

translations.source: የተከናወነው ሥራ በአብዛኛው በንድፈ ሀሳብ የተደገፈ ቢሆንም ፕሮግራሙ የተጻፈው ከሳጊታሪዩስ ጋላክሲ የተሰጡትን ምልከታዎች ለማስመሰል ነበር።
translations.reference: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.hypothesis: The work was mostly done by hand, though the program was written to mimic the observations given by the Sagittarius Dwarf Galaxy.

translations.source: ቡድኑ እየፈለገው የነበረው ተፅዕኖ በጋላክሲው ምስጢራዊ ቁስ አካል እና የሚልኪ ዌይ ምስጢራዊ ቁስ አካል መካከል ባሉ የታይድ ኃይሎች የሚከሰት ነው።
translations.reference: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
translations.hypothesis: The effect the team was looking for was caused by the tidal forces between the Milky Way and the LMC.

translations.source: ልክ ጨረቃ በምድር ላይ የስበት ሃይል እንዳላት እና ማዕበሎች ን እንደምታስነሳ ሁሉ፣ ሚልኪ ዌይ በ ሳጊታሪየስ ጋላክሲ ላይ የስበት ሃይል አለው።
translations.reference: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.hypothesis: Just as the moon has a gravitational pull on the Earth and causes tides, the Milky Way has a gravitational pull on Sagittarius Dwarf galaxy.

translations.source: ሳይንቲስቶቹ ዳርክ ማተር ሌሎች ዳርክ ማተሮች ላይ የሚያሳድረው ተጽእኖ ልክ እንደ መደበኛ ማተር ነው የሚል ድምዳሜ ላይ መድረስ ችለዋል።
translations.reference: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists have concluded that dark matter interacts with other dark matter in the same way that normal matter does.

translations.source: ይህ ንድፈ-ሀሳብ በጋላክሲ ዙሪያ ያለው አብዛኛው የጨለማ ቁስ በጋላክሲው ዙሪያ በአንድ ሃሎ ውስጥ የሚገኝ ሲሆን ከብዙ ትናንሽ ቅንጣቶች የተሠራ ነው ይላል።
translations.reference: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
translations.hypothesis: This theory says that most of the dark matter in the universe is made up of many small rocks orbiting the center of the galaxy in a halo around it.

translations.source: የቴሌቪዥን ዘገባዎች ከፋብሪካው የሚመጡ ነጭ ጭስ ያሳያሉ።
translations.reference: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
translations.hypothesis: Television reports showed white fumes rising from the factory.

translations.source: የአከባቢው ባለሥልጣናት በፋብሪካው አካባቢ የሚገኙ ነዋሪዎችን በቤት ውስጥ እንዲቆዩ ፣ የአየር ማቀዝቀዣዎችን እንዲያጠፉ እና የቧንቧ ውሃ እንዳይጠጡ እያስጠነቀቁ ነው።
translations.reference: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
translations.hypothesis: Local authorities are warning residents to stay indoors, turn off their air conditioners, and not drink tap water.

translations.source: በጃፓን የኒውክሌር ኤጀንሲ መሰረት፣ በፋብሪካው ሬዲዮአክቲቭ ኬዢየም እና አዮዲን ተለይተዋል።
translations.reference: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
translations.hypothesis: According to the Japanese Nuclear Agency, the factory released radioactive caesium and iodine.

translations.source: ፖሊስ እንደሚለው፣ ይህ የሚያሳየው ምናልባት በሥፍራው የነበሩ የዩራኒየም ነዳጅ መያዣ ታንከሮች ተቀደው መፍሰስ ጀምረው እንደነበርነው።
translations.reference: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
translations.hypothesis: The police said that this indicated that the uranium fuel containers had probably been dropped and started to leak.

translations.source: በደቡብ አፍሪካ ክልል KwaZulu-Natal ውስጥ ዶ/ር ቶኒ ሞል ከባድ፣ መድሃኒትን የሚቋቋም የሳንባ ነቀርሳ ዓይነት (XDR-TB) አግኝተዋል።
translations.reference: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.hypothesis: In South Africa, Dr Tony Moll, a leading researcher on TB, died of XDR-TB in KwaZulu-Natal province.

translations.source: በቃለ መጠይቅ ላይ አዲሱ ልዩነት “ይህ በጣም ከፍተኛ በሆነ የሞት መጠን ምክንያት በጣም የሚያስጨንቅ እና የሚያስፈራ” ነው ብለዋል።
translations.reference: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
translations.hypothesis: In the interview, the new variant was described as "the most concerning and frightening" due to its high mortality rate.

translations.source: አንዳንድ ታካሚዎች ትኋኑን በሆስፒታል ውስጥ አግኝተውት ይሆናል፣ ዶ/ር ሞል በትንሹ ሁለቱ የሆስፒታል የጤና ሰራተኞች እንደሆኑ ታስባለች።
translations.reference: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.hypothesis: Some patients may have received tetanus in the hospital, Dr. Mouznik said, speculating that the two hospital health workers may have had it.

translations.source: በአንድ ዓመት ጊዜ ውስጥ፣ የተጠቃ ሰው ከ10 እስከ 15 በቅርብ ያገኛቸውን ሰዎች ሊያስይዝ ይችላል።
translations.reference: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.hypothesis: Over the course of a year, an individual could potentially refer 10 to 15 people they know.

translations.source: ሆኖም፣ በሳንባ ነቀርሳ በሽታ ከጠያዙት ጠቅላላው ብዛት ውስጥ የXDR-TB መጠን በመቶኛ አሁንም ዝቅተኛ ይመስላል፤ በደቡብ አፍሪካ በማንኛውም ልዩ ቅጽበት በበሽታው ከተያዙት አጠቃላይ 330,000 ሰዎች መካከል 6,000 ናቸው።
translations.reference: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
translations.hypothesis: However, the proportion of XDR-TB among all people with TB is still small; in South Africa, for example, only 6000 of the 330 000 people diagnosed with TB in any given year are estimated to have XDR-TB.

translations.source: ሁለቱም ክብደታቸው ከ 1000 ፓውንድ በላይ የሚመዝነው በሰዓት 17,500 ማይል ያህል የሚጓዙት ሳተላይቶቹ ከምድር 491 ማይሎች በላይ ተጋጩ።
translations.reference: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.hypothesis: The two satellites, which weigh more than 1,000 pounds each, will travel at a speed of about 17,500 miles per hour and orbit about 491 miles above the Earth.

translations.source: የሳይንስ ሊቃውንት በግጭቱ ምክንያት የተፈጠረው ፍንዳታ ከፍተኛ እንደነበር ይናገራሉ።
translations.reference: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists say the explosion was likely caused by a meteorite.

translations.source: እስካሁን ግጭቱ ምን ያህል ትልቅ እንደነበረ እና ምድር እንዴት ተፅዕኖ እንደሚያድርባት ለማወቅ እየሞከሩ ነው።
translations.reference: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
translations.hypothesis: They are trying to determine how big the impactor was and what the effects on Earth would be.

translations.source: የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ስትራቴጂካዊ ኮማንድ የዩ ኤስ የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ጽሕፈት ቤት ፍርስራሹ ን እያነሳ ይገኛል።
translations.reference: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
translations.hypothesis: The United States Strategic Command is responsible for organizing the defense of the United States.

translations.source: የንድፍ ትንተና ውጤት የህዝብ ድር ጣቢያ ላይ ይለጠፋል።
translations.reference: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
translations.hypothesis: The results of the design competition will be published on the website.

translations.source: የኦሃዮ ባለሥልጣናት እንደተናገሩት፣ በፔንሲልቬንያ ፒትስበርግ የሕፃናት ሆስፒታል ውስጥ የምትሠራ አንድ ዶክተር፣ እናቷ ረቡዕ ዕለት በመኪናዋ የኋላ መጫኛ ውስጥ ሙተው ስለተገኙ፣ በአሰቃቂ ግድያ ትከሰሳለች።
translations.reference: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
translations.hypothesis: An Ohio woman is being charged with murder after her baby was found dead in the trunk of her car in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, on Wednesday, authorities said.

translations.source: የ29 ዓመቱ ዶክተር ማላር ባላሱበርሜኒያን በሲንሲናቲ በስተ ሰሜን 15 ማይል ያህል ርቀት ላይ በምትገኝ ሰማያዊ አሽ ኦሃዮ ከተማ ውስጥ መንገድ ላይ ከባድ ድንዛዜ በሚመስል ሁኔታ ውስጥ ተጋድመው ተገኝተዋል።
translations.reference: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
translations.hypothesis: The 29-year-old Dr. Malaar Balasubramanian was found dead on the side of a road in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb of Cincinnati, about 15 miles north of downtown.

translations.source: መኮንኖቹን እሷ 500 ጫማ ርቆ ወደሚገኘው ጥቁር ኦልድስሞቢል ሴራዋ መራቻቸው።
translations.reference: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.hypothesis: She led the men fifty feet to a black Oldsmobile sedan.

translations.source: በዚያ ቦታ፣ የ53 ዓመቱን ሳሮጃ ባላሱብራማኒያን በደም የተጨማለቁ ብርድ ልብሶች ተሸፍኖባቸው አገኙ።
translations.reference: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
translations.hypothesis: There, they found Saroj Bala Subramaniam, 53, lying on the floor covered in a blood-soaked shawl.

translations.source: ፖሊስ አስከሬኑ ለአንድ ቀን ያህል የቆየ ይመስላል ብሏል።
translations.reference: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
translations.hypothesis: Police said the body had probably been there for a day.

translations.source: በዚህ ወቅት የመጀመሪያዎቹ የበሽታው አጋጣሚዎች በሐምሌ ወር መጨረሻ ላይ ነበር ሪፖርት የተደረጉት።
translations.reference: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
translations.hypothesis: The first cases were reported in late July.

translations.source: በሽታውን አሳማዎች ይሸከሙትል፣ ከዚያም በወባ ትንኞች አማካኝነት ወደ ሰዎች ይተላለፋል።
translations.reference: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
translations.hypothesis: The parasites are carried by sandflies, which inject them into humans during a blood meal.

translations.source: የበሽታው ወረርሽኝ የህንድ መንግስት ከባድ ጉዳት በደረሰባቸው አካባቢዎች ላይ የአሳማ አሳዳሪዎችን ማሰማራት ፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የወባ ትንኝ አጎበሮችን ማሰራጨት እና ፀረ-ተባዮችን መርጨት የመሳሰሉ እርምጃዎችን እንዲወስድ አስገድዶታል።
translations.reference: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
translations.hypothesis: The epidemic has prompted the Indian government to take action such as the deployment of paramilitaries in the worst affected areas, the distribution of thousands of mosquito nets, and the spraying of insecticides.

translations.source: ለቀጣይ ዓመት የጤና ኤጀንሲዎችን ለማዘጋጀት የሚረዳ በበርካታ ሚሊዮን የሚቆጠር ብልቃጥ የቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽን ክትባት በመንግስት ቃል ተገብቷል።
translations.reference: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
translations.hypothesis: A multi-million dollar investment in a vaccine against a virus causing a disease affecting many of the world's poorest nations has been approved by the government for next year.

translations.source: በገንዘብ እጦት እና ከሌሎች በሽታዎች አንፃር አነስተኛ ቅድሚያ የመስጠት ሁኔታ ምክንያት በዚህ ዓመት በታሪክ ብዙ ለተጎዱት አካባቢዎች ክትባቶችን የመላክ ዕቅዶች ዘገዩ።
translations.reference: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
translations.hypothesis: Funding constraints and the reprioritization of resources due to other disease outbreaks delayed the shipment of vaccines to many of the affected areas earlier this year.

translations.source: በ 1956 ሱለኒያ ወደ ስዊድን ተዛወረ ፣ ከሶስት ዓመት በኋላም ለስዊድን ፖስታ ቤት ሥራ የጀመረ ሲሆን ዋና መሪያቸው ሆነ።
translations.reference: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
translations.hypothesis: In 1956, Sulenya moved to Sweden, where he began working for the Swedish Post Office three years later, eventually becoming its director.

translations.source: ለስዊድን እና ለሌሎች 28 ሀገራት ከ1,000 በላይ የሚሆኑ ቴምብሮችን አምርቷል።
translations.reference: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
translations.hypothesis: He has created more than 1,000 templates for Sweden and 28 other countries.

translations.source: የእሱ ሥራ በጥራት እና ማብራርያ እውቅና ያለው በመሆኑ ከበጎ አድራጊዎች መካከል በጣም ጥቂት "የቤት ስሞች" አንዱ ነው። አንዳንዶች ሥራውን ለብቻው በመሰብሰብ ልዩ ሙያ አላቸው።
translations.reference: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
translations.hypothesis: His work is known for its quality and attention to detail, and he is one of the few "household names" among cartoonists. Some people have a special skill for drawing cartoons.

translations.source: 1000ኛው እትሙ በ2000 ላይ ያሳታተመው አስገራሚው «ግሬት ዲድስ ባይ ስዊድሽ ኪንግስ» በዴቪድ ክሎከር አህረንስትራል ነው፣ በዓለም አቀፍ የድንቃድንቅ መዝገብ ላይ ተጠቅሷል።
translations.reference: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
translations.hypothesis: The 1000th edition was a reprint of David Clouther's "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings", published in 1600, and listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.

translations.source: በተጨማሪም ለብዙ ሀገሮች የባንክ ኖቶችን መቅረጽ ላይ ተሰማርቶ ነበር። የቅርብ ከሆኑ ስራዎቹ መካከል በአዲሶቹ የካናዳ $5 እና $100 ዶላሮች ፊትለፊት ላይ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሥዕሎችን ጨምሮ ይገኙበታል፡፡
translations.reference: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
translations.hypothesis: He was also responsible for the design of many countries' bank notes. Among his more recent works are the portraits of the Prime Minister on the new Canadian five- and hundred-dollar bills.

translations.source: አደጋው ከተከሰተ በኋላ፣ ጊብሰን ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወሰደ ግን ከዚያ ወዲያው ሞተ።
translations.reference: After the accident occurred, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died shortly afterwards.
translations.hypothesis: After the accident, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died soon after.

translations.source: የ 64 ዓመቱ የጭነት መኪና ሾፌር፣ በአደጋው አልተጎዳም።
translations.reference: The truck driver, who is aged 64, was not injured in the crash.
translations.hypothesis: The 64-year-old truck driver was not hurt.

translations.source: ተሽከርካሪው ራሱ በተመሳሳይ ቀን በግምት 1200 GMT አደጋው ከተከሰተበት ቦታ ላይ ተወስዷል።
translations.reference: The vehicle itself was taken away from the scene of the accident at approximately 1200 GMT on the same day.
translations.hypothesis: The vehicle was taken to a secure location later the same day, around 1200 GMT, from where the incident was reported.

translations.source: አደጋው ከደረሰበት አጠገብ በሚገኝ ጋራዥ ውስጥ የሚሠራ አንድ ሰው፥ “መንገዱን ለማቋረጥ የሚጠብቁ ልጆች ነበሩ እናም ሁሉም እየጮሁ እያለቀሱ ነበር” ብሏል።
translations.reference: A person working in a garage near where the accident occurred said: "There were children waiting to cross the road and they were all screaming and crying."
translations.hypothesis: A man who works in a garage across the street said, "There were a bunch of kids waiting to cross the street and they all started screaming.

translations.source: ሁሉም አደጋው ከነበረበት ቦታ ሮጠው ሄዱ።
translations.reference: They all ran back from where the accident had happened.
translations.hypothesis: Everyone just ran away from the scene.

translations.source: የባሊ ውስጥ አጀንዳው ላይ ሌሎች ርዕሶች የዓለምን የቀሩትን ደኖች መታደግ፣ እና ፈጠራን በማጋራት ታዳጊ ሀገሪትን ብክለትን በቀነሰ መልኩ እንዲያድጉ ማገዝን ያካትታሉ።
translations.reference: Other subjects on the agenda in Bali include saving the world's remaining forests, and sharing technologies to help developing nations grow in less-polluting ways.
translations.hypothesis: Other topics on the Bali agenda include leveraging the potential of the Global South, and harnessing innovation to help developing countries grow sustainably.

translations.source: ዩ.ኤንም በዓለም አየር ሙቀት መጨመር ለተጎዱ ሃገራት ተፅዕኖውን እንዲቋቋሙ ለመርዳት ገንዘብ ለማጠናቀቅ ተስፋ ያደርጋል።
translations.reference: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
translations.hypothesis: The UN hopes to raise funds to help countries most vulnerable to the impacts of global warming.

translations.source: ገንዘቡ ወደ ጎርፍ መከላከያ ቤቶች ፣ ለተሻለ የውሃ አያያዝ እና የሰብል ብዝሃነት ሊሄድ ይችላል።
translations.reference: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
translations.hypothesis: The money could go to flood defences, better water management and crop diversification.

translations.source: ፍሉክ አንዳንድ ሰዎች ሴቶችን ስለ ሴቶች ጤና ከመናገር እንዲቆጠብ ያደረጉት ጥረት ያልተሳካ ነበር በማለት ጽፏል።
translations.reference: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
translations.hypothesis: Fluke also reported that their efforts to get some people to stop telling women to stop talking about women's health have been unsuccessful.

translations.source: ወደ እዚህ ድምዳሜ የመጣችው በሚሰጧት ጥሩ አስተያየቶች እና ከሁለቱም ሴት እና ወንድ ወገኖች የወሊድ መቆጣጠሪያ ሕክምና አስፈላጊ ሕክምና እንደሆን ማበረታቻ ስለሚላክላት ነው።
translations.reference: She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
translations.hypothesis: She had come to this conclusion based on the positive feedback she got and the encouragement from both male and female respondents that birth control was a medical necessity.

translations.source: ቁስለኞቹ ወደ ሆስፒታል ከተወሰዱ በኋላ ውጊያው ሲቆም፣ ከሌሎቹ እስረኞች መካከል ወደ 40 የሚሆኑት በግቢው ውስጥ ቆዩ እና ወደ ክፍላቸው ለመመለስ ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም።
translations.reference: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
translations.hypothesis: After the wounded were transported to the hospital, a confrontation with the remaining 40 hostages who refused to return to their rooms, ensued.

translations.source: ተደራዳሪዎች ሁኔታውን ለማስተካከል ቢሞክሩም የእስረኞች ጥያቄ ግን ግልፅ አይደለም።
translations.reference: Negotiators tried to rectify the situation, but the prisoners' demands are not clear.
translations.hypothesis: The hostages' demands are still unknown, though negotiators are trying to establish contact.

translations.source: 10:00-11:00 ከሰዓት ኤምዲቲ መካከል፣ ግቢ ውስጥ በእስረኞቹ እሳት ተነሳ።
translations.reference: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
translations.hypothesis: Between 10:00-11:00 AM EDT, a fire broke out on the hospital grounds.

translations.source: ብዙም ሳይቆይ የአመፅ መሣሪያ የታጠቁ መኮንኖች ወደ ግቢው በመግባት እስረኞችን በአስለቃሽ ጭስ ዘጉ።
translations.reference: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
translations.hypothesis: Shortly after, armed officers in riot gear entered the compound and dispersed the prisoners with tear gas.

translations.source: በመጨረሻ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሠራተኞች ከሌሊቱ 11:35 ሰዓት ላይ እሳቱን ማጥፋት ችለዋል።
translations.reference: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, at 11:35 p.m. the fire was put out by the volunteer fire department.

translations.source: ግድቡ በ 1963 ከተገነባ በኋላ በየአመቱ በወንዙን አቧራ የሚዘራውን የጎርፍ መጥለቅለቅ አቆመ።
translations.reference: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
translations.hypothesis: The dam, built in 1963, has since stopped the annual flooding that used to deposit silt along the river.

translations.source: ይህ ደለል እንደ የዱር ህይወት መኖሪያ ያገለገሉ፣ የአሸዋ ሜዳዎችን እና የባህር ዳርቻዎችን ለመስራት አስፈላጊ ነበር።
translations.reference: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
translations.hypothesis: This dam was necessary to flood the valley, which would then be used to grow crops and fish.

translations.source: በዚህ ምክንያት ሁለት የዓሣ ዝርያዎች ጠፍተዋል ፣ ሌሎች ሁለት ደግሞ ሃምፕባክ ቹብን ጨምሮ ለአደጋ ተጋልጠዋል።
translations.reference: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
translations.hypothesis: As a result, two species of fish have already gone extinct, and two others, including the humpback chub, are listed as threatened.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን የውሃው መጠን ከጎርፉ በኋላ ጥቂት ጫማዎችን ብቻ የሚያድግ ቢሆንም፣ ባለሥልጣኖቹ የተሸረሸሩ አሸዋዎችን ወደታች ለመመለስ በቂ ይሆናል ብለው ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።
translations.reference: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
translations.hypothesis: Although the amount of water will only submerge a few feet, authorities hope it will be enough to wash away the ash.

translations.source: የሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያ አልተሰጠም ፣ የጃካርታ ጂኦፊዚክስ ኤጄንሲ እንደገለጸው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ የ 6.5 መጠንን ስላላሟላ የሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያ አይሰጥም።
translations.reference: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.
translations.hypothesis: No tsunami warning was issued as the Jakarta Geophysics Agency said the earthquake was not of a significant enough magnitude to produce a tsunami.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን የሱናሚ ስጋት ባይኖርም ነዋሪዎቹ መፍራት ጀመሩ እና ንግዶቻቸውን እና ቤቶቻቸውን ጥለው መሄድ ጀመሩ።
translations.reference: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.
translations.hypothesis: Although there was no tsunami threat, the residents started to panic and started to leave their homes and businesses.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን ዊንፍሬይ በስንብቷ እያነባች ብትሆንም፤ ተመልሳ እንደምትመጣ ለአድናቂዎቿ ግልፅ አድርጋለች፡፡
translations.reference: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.
translations.hypothesis: Despite Winfree's reading hiatus, she made it clear to her audience that she would be back.

translations.source: "ይህ ስንብት አይሆንም፡፡ ይህ የአንድ ምእራፍ መዝጊያ እና የአዲሱ መክፈቻ ነው፡፡"
translations.reference: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."
translations.hypothesis: "This is not going to be a blip. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."

translations.source: የናሚቢያ የፕሬዝዳንት እና ፓርላማ ምርጫዎች የመጨረሻ ውጤቶች አሁን በስልጣን ላይ ያለው፣ ሂፊኬፑንዬ ፖሃምባ፣ በሰፊ ወሰን በድጋሚ መመረጡን አመልክቷል።
translations.reference: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.
translations.hypothesis: The final results of Namibia's presidential and parliamentary elections indicate that the incumbent, Hage Geingob, has been re-elected by a comfortable margin.

translations.source: የደቡብ ምዕራብ አፍሪካ ህዝቦች ድርጅት (ኤስ.ደብልዩ.ኤስ.ፒ.ኦ) ገዥው ፓርቲ፣ በፓርላማው ምርጫም ብዙዎችን እንደያዘ ቆይቷል።
translations.reference: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.
translations.hypothesis: The ruling party, the Southern West African Peoples Organisation (SWA-PO), has long dominated the legislature.

translations.source: የኮኦሊሽን እና የአፍጋኒስታን ወታደሮች ቦታውን ለማስጠበቅ ወደ አካባቢው የገቡ ሲሆን ሌሎች የኮኦሊሽን አውሮፕላኖችም እንዲረዱ ተልከዋል።
translations.reference: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.
translations.hypothesis: Coalition and Afghan forces then moved into the area to secure it, and other coalition aircraft were directed to assist.

translations.source: አደጋው በተራራማው የመሬት አቀማመጥ ከፍ ብሎ የተከሰተ ሲሆን በአደገኛ እሳት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ይታመናል።
translations.reference: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
translations.hypothesis: The accident happened on a steep, winding mountain road and was possibly caused by a combination of speeding and a sharp turn.

translations.source: የአደጋውን ቦታ ለመፈለግ የተደረገው ጥረት በመጥፎ የአየር ጠባይ እና በአስቸጋሪ የመሬት አቀማመጥ ጋር ነበር የገጠመው።
translations.reference: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.
translations.hypothesis: The search for survivors is being hampered by the bad weather and the difficult terrain.

translations.source: የህክምና በጎ አድራጎት ማንጎላ ፣ ሜዲሲንስ ሳንስ ፍሮንቲርስ እና የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት በሀገሪቱ ከተመዘገበው ይህ የከፋ ወረርሽኝ ነው ብለዋል።
translations.reference: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.
translations.hypothesis: This is the worst epidemic the country has seen since the cholera outbreak of 1991,” said Dr Alain Boussagol, Médecins Sans Frontières operational manager in Angola.

translations.source: የሜዲሲንስ ሳንስ ፍሮንቲር ቃል አቀባይ ሪቻርድ ቬርማን በበኩላቸው፥ “አንጎላ ከመቼውም ጊዜ በላይ ወደ አስከፊ የወረርሽኝ ስጋት እያመራች ሲሆን ሁኔታው በአንጎላ እጅግ በጣም መጥፎ ነው” ብለዋል።
translations.reference: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
translations.hypothesis: WHO Regional Director for Africa, Dr Richard Mnarama said, “Angola is already on the front line of a severe cholera outbreak and the situation is extremely serious in Angola.”

translations.source: ጨዋታዎቹ ከቀኑ 10:00 ሰዓት ጀምሮ በታላቅ የአየር ሁኔታ ተጀምረዋል እና በፍጥነት ከጸዳው ከጠዋት አጋማሹ ካፊያ በስተቀር፣ ለ 7ቶቹ ራግቢዎች ጥሩ ቀን ነበር፡፡
translations.reference: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
translations.hypothesis: The games started at 10:00 under a bright, sunny sky and for the most part, it was a good day for the 7s, with only the early morning dew presenting any problems.

translations.source: የውድድሩ ምርጥ ቡድን ደቡብ አፍሪካ የጀመሩት 5ኛ ከተደረደሩት የዛምቢያን 26 – 00 በማሸነፍ ምቹ የሆነ ጅማሬ ይዘው ነበር።
translations.reference: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
translations.hypothesis: The defending champions, South Africa, had a comfortable start to their campaign, as they thrashed 5th ranked Zambia 26 – 00.

translations.source: ከደቡባዊ እህቶቻቸው ጋር ያለው ጨዋታ ላይ በደንብ ልምድ የሌላቸው ቢመስሉም ደቡብ አፍሪካ ቀስ በቀስ ውድድሩ በቀጠለ ቁጥር አሻሻለች።
translations.reference: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
translations.hypothesis: While they don't seem to have much experience playing against their Southern sisters, South Africa has improved as the competition went on.

translations.source: ጨዋነት የተሞላበት የመከላከል አቅማቸው፣ የኳስ አያያዝ ችሎታቸው እና እጅግ በጣም ጥሩ የቡድን መግባባት ጎልተው እንዲታዩ ያደረጋቸው ሲሆን ሌሎች መርታት ያለባቸው ይህ ቡድን እንደሆነ ግልጽ ነበር።
translations.reference: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
translations.hypothesis: Their superior defense, ball control, and excellent team coordination made it obvious that this was the team to beat.

translations.source: የአምስተርዳም ከተማ እና የአና ፍራንክ ሙዚየም ባለሥልጣናት ዛፉ በፈንገስ ተይዞ የመውደቅ አደጋ ስለተጋረጠበት የህዝብ ጤናን አደጋ ላይ ይጥላሉ ብለው ይከራከራሉ።
translations.reference: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
translations.hypothesis: Amsterdam and Anne Frank House authorities argue that the ban will endanger public health because the fungus that produces the toxin is known to grow in the house.

translations.source: ማክሰኞ እንዲቋረጥ ቀጠሮ ተይዞ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ከአስቸኳይ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ በኋላ ድኗል።
translations.reference: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
translations.hypothesis: It was scheduled for a hearing on Tuesday, but was dismissed after an emergency court order.

translations.source: “ሰባቱ እህቶች” ተብለው የተጠሩ የዋሻ መግቢያዎች ሁሉ ቢያንስ ከ 100 እስከ 250 ሜትር (ከ 328 እስከ 820 ጫማ) ዲያሜትር አላቸው።
translations.reference: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
translations.hypothesis: All of the entrances to the caves, known as the "Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 metres (328 to 820 ft) in diameter.

translations.source: ታህተቀይ ምስሎች ከማታ እና ቀን የሙቀት ልዩነቶቹ ዋሻዎች እንደሚሆኑ ያሳያሉ።
translations.reference: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
translations.hypothesis: The changing images show that the caves are affected by the difference in temperature between night and day.

translations.source: "በቀን ከከባቢው ገፅታ አንፃር ቀዝቃዛ እና ማታ ላይ ደሞ ሞቃት ናቸው።
translations.reference: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
translations.hypothesis: "They are cool in the day and warm at night, depending on the local conditions.

translations.source: የሙቀት ባህሪያቸው ዓለም ላይ እንዳሉ ቋሚ ሙቀት እንደሚጠብቁ ትላልቅ ዋሻዎች የማይንቀሳቀስ አይደለም፣ ግን እነዚህ በመሬት ውስጥ ጥልቅ ጉድጓዶች ከመሆናቸው ጋር ተስማሚ ነው፣” አለ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ስነምድራዊ ጥናት (ዩኤስጂኤስ) አስትሮጂኦሎጂ ቡድን እና በፍላግስታፍ፣ አሪዞና የሚገኘው ሰሜን አሪዞና ዩኒቨርሲቲ ግሌን ከሺንግ።
translations.reference: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.hypothesis: Their thermal properties are such that they will maintain a constant temperature, regardless of the temperature of the surrounding world, but these are just big holes in the ground," said Glenn Cushing, a planetary geologist with the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Branch and Northern Arizona University in Flagstaff, Arizona.

translations.source: በፈረንሳይ ድምጽ መስጠት በተለምዶ ዝቅተኛ የቴክኖሎጂ ተሞክሮ ነበረው፥ መራጮች እራሳቸውን በዳስ ውስጥ ያገለሉ ፣ የመረጡትን እጩ የሚያመለክት ቀድሞ-የታተመ ወረቀት ወደ ፖስታ ውስጥ ያስገባሉ።
translations.reference: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
translations.hypothesis: Voting in France has traditionally involved a low-tech experience, with voters filling out a paper form on which they mark their chosen candidate and then placing the completed form in an envelope addressed to the returning officer.

translations.source: ባለሥልጣናት የመራጩን ማንነት ካረጋገጡ በኋላ መራጩ ፖስታውን ወደ መስጫ ሳጥኑ ውስጥ ይጥልና የምርጫውን ዝርዝር ይፈርማል።
translations.reference: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.hypothesis: Once the officials are satisfied with the candidate's identity, the candidate signs the ballot paper and puts it in the ballot box.

translations.source: የፈረንሣይ የምርጫ ሕግ ክርክሮችን በጥብቅ ይደግፋል።
translations.reference: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
translations.hypothesis: French electoral law severely restricts paid political advertising.

translations.source: ከ1988 ጀምሮ፣ የምርጫ ኮሮጆዎች በምርጫው መጀመሪያ ላይ ምንም ፖስታዎች እንደሌሏቸው እና በምርጫው መጨረሻ ላይ ደግሞ ከተቆጠሩት እና ፍቃድ ከተሰጣቸው መራጮች ውጪ ሌሎች ፖስታዎች እንዳልገቡ መራጮች እና ታዛቢዎች እንዲያረጋግጡ ወደ ውስጥ የሚያሳዩ መሆን አለባቸው።
translations.reference: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.hypothesis: Since 1988, the lids of ballot boxes have been transparent so that voters and observers can see that the boxes are empty at the start of the voting and that only the ballots of those who have voted are included when the boxes are closed and sealed at the end of the voting.

translations.source: እጩዎች እያንዳንዱን የሂደቱን ክፍል እንዲታዘቡ ተወካዮችን መላክ ይችላሉ። ምሽት ላይ ድምፆች የተወሰኑ አሰራሮችን በመከተል በከባድ ቁጥጥር በበጎ ፈቃደኞች ይቆጠራሉ።
translations.reference: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
translations.hypothesis: Candidates can submit delegates to vote on their behalf for each round of the process. Votes are tallied by volunteers who follow a strict protocol to maintain the integrity of the process.

translations.source: ወጪን ለመቆጠብ እና ለአሠራር ሁኔታዎች በዓለም ዙሪያ ቀደም ብሎ የተለቀቀው ኤሰስ ኢኢኢ ኮምፒውተር፣ በ 2007 ታይፔ አይቲ ወር ላይ ትኩስ ርዕሰ ጉዳይ ሆነ።
translations.reference: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
translations.hypothesis: The Eee PC, released to much fanfare in 2007 at the Taipei IT Month, was a hot topic as it aimed to bring Moore's Law to the masses by releasing a new model every quarter to keep costs down and to keep up with evolving technology.

translations.source: ግን ኤሰስ የ2007 የታይዋን ብርቱ ሽልማት ውስጥ በየቻይና ሪፐብሊክ አስፈፃሚ ዩዋን ከተሸለመ በኋላ በላፕቶፕ ኮምፒውተር ላይ የሸማቹ ገበያ በፍጥነት ይለያያል እንዲሁም ይለወጣል።
translations.reference: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
translations.hypothesis: But after winning the 2007 Taiwan Excellence Award and being featured in the Executive Yuan's 2007 Government Procurement List, Eee PC's consumer market share quickly increased and changed.

translations.source: የጣቢያው ዌብሳይት ትርዒቱን እንዲህ ሲል ይገልጸዋል “የድሮ ትምህርት ቤት የሬዲዮ ቲያትር በአዲስ እና በሚያስደነግጥ የጌጣጌጥ ሽክርክሪት!
translations.reference: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
translations.hypothesis: The show is described on the website as "an old-fashioned radio play with a new and surprising twist!"

translations.source: በቀደምት ጊዜያት ዝግጅቱ በበይነመረብ በሚሰራጨው በሬዲዮ ወሬ ላይ በሚያተኩረው የቶጊኔት የሬዲዮ ድረገጽ ላይ ብቻ ይተላለፍ ነበር።
translations.reference: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
translations.hypothesis: In its early days, the event was streamed live on the TogetheRadio website, a radio station that focused on podcasts.

translations.source: በ 2015 መገባደጃ ላይ ቶጊኔት አስትሮኔት ሬዲዮን እንደ አንድ ንዑስ ጣቢያ አቋቋመ።
translations.reference: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
translations.hypothesis: By the end of 2015, Togentle established an online radio station as a subsidiary.

translations.source: ትዕይንቱ በመጀመሪያ የምሥራቅ ቴክሳስ አካባቢ የሆኑ አማተር የድምፅ ተዋንያንን አሳይቷል።
translations.reference: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
translations.hypothesis: The show originally featured amateur voice actors from the East Texas area.

translations.source: በቢሽኬክ ጎዳናዎች ላይ የህግ አስከባሪ አካላት ባለመገኘታቸው ሌሊቱን ሙሉ ሰፊ ዝርፊያ እንደቀጠለ ይነገራል።
translations.reference: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
translations.hypothesis: Reports from Bishkek streets said that looting went on all night in the absence of police.

translations.source: ቢሽኬክ በአንድ ታዛቢ ወደ “ስርዓት አልበኝነት” ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንደገባች የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ የዱርዬዎች ስብስብ በጎዳናዎች ላይ እየተዘዋወረ የሸማቾች የዕቃዎች መደብሮችን እየዘረፈ ነበር።
translations.reference: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
translations.hypothesis: Bishkek was reported by one observer to be in a state of "near anarchy", with roving bands of looters ransacking shops and consumer goods stores.

translations.source: በርካታ የቢሽከክ ነዋሪዎች የደቡብ ሰላማዊ ሰልፈኞችን ህግ ባለማክበራቸው ወቅሰዋቸዋል።
translations.reference: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
translations.hypothesis: Many residents of Bishkek criticised the South Korean police for their failure to prevent the suicide bombing.

translations.source: ሩስተንበርግ ደቡብ አፍሪካ ባለው በንጉሳዊው ባፎከንግ ስቴዲየም በራግቢ ህብረት የሶስት ሀገሮች ግጥሚያ ላይ ደቡብ አፍሪካ ኦል ብላክስ (ኒውዚላንድ)ን አሸነፈቻቸው።
translations.reference: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
translations.hypothesis: Rensburg South Africa beat New Zealand in the Tri-Nations rugby test match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg.

translations.source: የኦል ብላክ የ15 ጨዋታ በማሸነፍ የሚያጠናቅቅበት የመጨረሻ ውጤት አንድ ነጥብ ነበር ፤ 21 ለ 20 ፡፡
translations.reference: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
translations.hypothesis: The final score was 21 to 20, a one-point victory for the All Blacks, who had won 15 of their previous 16 matches.

translations.source: ለ ስፕሪንግቦክስ የአምስት ግጥሚያዎችን የመሸነፍ ጎዙ አጠናቋል።
translations.reference: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
translations.hypothesis: He completed a five-match unbeaten run for the Springboks.

translations.source: ከሁለት ሳምንት በፊት ዋንጫ ለበሉት ኦል ብላክስ ይሄ የመጨረሻ ውድድር ነበር።
translations.reference: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.hypothesis: This was the final match of the tournament for the All Blacks, who had won the Bledisloe Cup two weeks ago.

translations.source: የስፕሪንግቦክስ አውስትራሊያ በሚገጥምበት ጊዜ፣ የተከታታይ የመጨረሻ ግጥሚያ በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት ጆሃንስበርግ ውስጥ በሚገኘው ኤሊስ ፓርክ ውስጥ ይካሄዳል።
translations.reference: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
translations.hypothesis: When Springboks play their final match next week in Ellis Park, Johannesburg, it will be the decider.

translations.source: ሰኞ 10:08 ፒ.ኤም መጠነኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ምዕራብ ሞንታናን አንቀጠቀጣት።
translations.reference: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
translations.hypothesis: Monday 10:08 p.m. A magnitude 6.8 earthquake shook western Montana.

translations.source: ለዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ስነምድራዊ ጥናት (USGS) ሆነም ለብሄራዊ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ መረጃ ማዕከሉ ምንም አይነት አስቸኳይ የአደጋ ዘገባዎች አልደረሱም።
translations.reference: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
translations.hypothesis: There were no immediate tsunami reports issued by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) or the National Earthquake Information Center.

translations.source: የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ ማእከል የነበረው፣ ከሰሜናዊ-ሰሜንምስራቅ ዲሎን 20 ኪ.ሜ (15 ማይል) አካባቢ ሲሆን ከቡቴ በስተደቡብ ደግሞ 65 ኪ.ሜ (40 ማይል) ያህል ነበር።
translations.reference: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
translations.hypothesis: The epicentre of the earthquake was about 20 km (15 miles) northeast of Delon and 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.

translations.source: የሰው ልጆችን ሊገድል የሚችል የወፍ ጉንፋን ዘለላ፣ ኤች5ኤን1፣ በምስራቅ ፈረንሳይ ከሊዮን አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ ረግረጋማ መሬት ውስጥ፣ ሰኞ የተገኘ የሞተ የዱር ዳክዬን ማጥቃቱ ተረጋግጧል።
translations.reference: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.hypothesis: Bird flu death confirmed in France A wild duck found dead near Lyon in eastern France has tested positive for the H5N1 bird flu virus, French officials said on Monday.

translations.source: በአውሮፓ ህብረት ውስጥ በዚህ ቫይረስ ከተጎዱት ሰባተኛ ሀገር ፈረንሳይ ናት፤ ኦስትሪያን፣ ጀርመንን፣ ስሎቬንያን፣ ቡልጋሪያን፣ ግሪክን እና ከጣሊያንን ተከትላ።
translations.reference: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
translations.hypothesis: France is the seventh country in the European Union to be affected by this virus, following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.

translations.source: ክሮኤሺያ እና ዴንማርክ ውስጥ የ ኤች5ኤን1 የተጠረጠሩ ኬዞች እንዳልተረጋገጡ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
translations.hypothesis: the cases in Croatia and Denmark were not confirmed with H5N1.

translations.source: ቻምበርዎች “በተስፋፋ ሞት ፣ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ የምድር ነዋሪዎችን ጥፋት እና ሽብርተኝነት” አምላክን ከሰው ነበር።
translations.reference: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers said the churches were responsible for "the death, destruction, and terrorization of millions of innocent people."

translations.source: "አዳራሾች፣ ተጠራጣሪ የሆነ ሰው፣ ክሱ "የማይረባ" ነው እናም "ማንም ማንንም ሊከስ ይችላል" ሲል ይከራከራል።
translations.reference: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
