translations.hypothesis: "The accused, a lawyer, argued that the charges were 'frivolous' and that 'anyone can sue anyone'.

translations.source: በፈረንሳይ ኦፔራ በካሚል ሴንት-ሳን የቀረበው የታሪክ ትእይንት “ሕይወቱ ለአደንዛዥ ዕፅ እና ለጃፓን ፍቅር ባለው ሰው ነው የሚተነተነው”።
translations.reference: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.hypothesis: The French Opéra's show, "La vie de Bohème", by Camille Saint-Saëns, is a historical drama about a man in love with drugs and Japan.

translations.source: ስለዚህም አቅራቢዎቹ የሐሺሽ ጥቅሎችን በመድረክ ላይ ያጨሳሉ፣ ቲያትሩ እራሱ ሰዎች እንዲቀላቀሉ እያበረታታ ነው።
translations.reference: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.hypothesis: So the providers will upload their offers on the platform, and the theatre on the other hand will encourage people to come.

translations.source: የቀድሞው የምክር ቤት አፈ ጉባኤ ኒውት ጊንግሪች ፣ የቴክሳስ ገዥ ሪክ ፔሪ እና የምክርቤት አባል ሚሼል ባችማን በቅደም ተከተል በአራተኛ ፣ አምስተኛ እና ስድስተኛ ደረጃን ይዘው አጠናቀዋል።
translations.reference: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Former Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich, Texas Governor Rick Perry, and Representative Michele Bachmann finished fourth, fifth, and sixth respectively.

translations.source: ውጤቱ ከመጣ በኋላ ጊንሪች ሳንቶረምን አድንቀዋል ፣ በአዮዋ ውስጥ አሉታዊ የዘመቻ ማስታወቂያዎች በተላለፉበት በሮምኒ ላይ ግን ከባድ ቃላት ወርውረዋል።
translations.reference: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.hypothesis: After the results came in, they consoled a crestfallen Santorum, while Romney basked in the afterglow of a hard-won victory.

translations.source: ፔሪ “የዛሬ ምሽት የምክክር ጉባኤ ውጤቶችን ለመገምገም ፣ በዚህ ውድድር ውስጥ ለራሴ ወደፊት የሚሄድበት መንገድ ይኑር አይኑር ለመለየት ወደ ቴክሳስ እመለሳለው” በማለት ገልፀው በኋላ ግን በውድድሩ ውስጥ እንደሚቆዩ እና በጥር 21 የደቡብ ካሮላይና የመጀመሪያ ምርጫ እንደሚወዳደሩ ገልፀዋል።
translations.reference: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.hypothesis: Perry said he would return to Texas to evaluate the results of last night's debate and determine his future in the race, but later said he would remain in the race and compete in South Carolina's January 21 primary.

translations.source: በኦገስት የአሜስ ስትሮው ምርጫን ያሸነፈችው ባችማን ዘመቻዋን ለማቆም ወሰነች።
translations.reference: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.hypothesis: After winning the August primary, Ames-Strouth decided to end her campaign.

translations.source: ፎቶግራፍ አንሺው ወደ ሮናልድ ሬገን UCLA የሕክምና ማዕከል ተጓጉዞ ከዚያ በኋላ ሞተ።
translations.reference: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.hypothesis: The photographer was taken to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center and later died.

translations.source: በዘገባው መሰረት ዕድሜው 20ዎቹ ውስጥ ነበር። አንድ መግለጫ ውስጥ፣ ቢበር “በዚህ አደጋ ላይ ያልተገኘሁ ወይም ከዚህ ጋር በቀጥታ ያልተገናኘሁ ሲሆን፣ ሃሳቤ እና ፀሎቴ ከሟች ቤትሰቦች አይለይም።” ብሏል።
translations.reference: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.hypothesis: He was in his 20s, according to reports. In a statement, Beiber said, "I am not at all okay with what has happened and my thoughts and prayers are with the families of the victims."

translations.source: ፎቶግራፍ አንሺው በሴፕልቬዳ ቡሌቫርድ ማዶ ላይ ተሽከርካሪውን አቁሞ መንገዱን ከማቋረጡ እና ከመቀጠሉ በፊት የፖሊስ ማቆሚያውን ፎቶግራፍ ለማንሳት በመሞከር የካሊፎርኒያ አውራ ጎዳና ላይ የትራፊክ ማቆሚያውን በመቆጣጠር ላይ የነበረ የፖሊስ መኮንን፣ ሁለት ጊዜ ወደኋላ እንዲመለስ ትእዛዝ እንደሰጠው፣ የመዝናኛ ዜና ድርጣቢያ TMZ ይረዳል።
translations.reference: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.hypothesis: The photographer, who was on Sepulveda Boulevard just south of the 10 Freeway, stopped his car and tried to take a picture of the police checkpoint on the California freeway, when he was told by the police officer in charge of the traffic stop, to back up twice, according to celebrity news website TMZ.

translations.source: ፖሊስ ባለው መሰረት፣ ፎቶግራፈሩን የገጨው ተሽከርካሪ ሹፌር የወንጀለኛ ቅጣት የመቀበል ዕድሉ እጅግ አናሳ ነው።
translations.reference: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.hypothesis: According to the police, the driver who took the photo is unlikely to face any legal repercussions.

translations.source: በቀን የሚገኙ አስራ ስምንት ሜዳሊያዎችን ብቻ በማግኘት፣ በርካታ ሀገሮች የሜዳሊያ መድረክን መስራት ተስኗቸዋል።
translations.reference: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.hypothesis: With only eighteen medals at stake on the day, several countries had all medal hopes riding on one or two events.

translations.source: እነሱ፣ አና ጆቼምሰን ሱፐር-ጂ ውስጥ የሴቶች ቋሚ ክፍል ውስጥ ዘጠነኛ በመጨረሷ ኔዘርላንድስን፣ እና ካትጃ ሳሪነን በተመሳሳይ ዝግጅት አስረኛ በመጨረሷ ፊንላድን ያካትታሉ።
translations.reference: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.hypothesis: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's super-G, and Finland's Katja Saarinen, who finished tenth in the same event.

translations.source: የአውስትራሊያው ሚቼል ጎርሊ በወንዶቹ የቁም ሱፐር-ጂ ውስጥ አስራ አንደኛ ሆኖ ጨረሰ። የቼክ ተፎካካሪ ኦልድሪች ጄሊኔክ በወንዶቹ ወንበር ሱፐር-ጂ ላይ አስራ ስድስተኛ ሆኖ ጨረሰ።
translations.reference: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Australian Mitchell Gourley finished 11th in the men's super-G. Czech competitor Oldřich Jeleňek finished 16th in the men's super-G.

translations.source: የሜክሲኮው አርሊ ቬላስከዝ በወንዶች የቁጭታ ሱፐር-ጂ አስራ አምስተኛ ሆኖ ጨርሷል። የኒው ዚላንዱ አዳም ሆል በወንዶቹ የቁም ሱፐር-ጂ ሆኖ ጨርሷል።
translations.reference: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Mexico's Arly Velasquez finished 15th in the men's sprint. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished 16th in the men's sprint.

translations.source: ማየት የተሳናቸው የፖላንድ ወንዶች የበረዶ ተንሸራታች ማኪጅ ክረዝል እና መሪው ኣና ኦጋርዝይንስካ ሱፐር-ጂ ላይ ዐሥራ ሦስተኛ ሆነው አጠናቀዋል። የሳውዝ ኮሪያው ሰኦርክ ፓርክ በወንዶች መቀመጫ ሱፐር-ጂ ሃያ አራተኛ ሆኖ አጠናቋል
translations.reference: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: The Polish men's four, including luger Mateusz Ogrodnik, finished 13th in the super-G, while South Korean Seo Young-woo finished 24th in the men's super-G.

translations.source: ከ 2010 የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በኋላ ወደ ሃይቲ የገቡት የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ሃይሎች በጦር ሰፈሩ አቅራቢያ ለጀመረው የበሽታ ስርጭት ተጠያቂ ናቸው ተብሏል።
translations.reference: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.hypothesis: The UN peacekeeping force stationed near the base was blamed for starting the epidemic of cholera that followed the earthquake in Haiti in 2010.

translations.source: በተጠቀሰው ክስ መሠረት ከተባበሩት መንግሥታት ካምፕ የተወሰደ ቆሻሻ በትክክል የንጽሕና አጠባበቅ አልነበረውም ይህም ባክቴሪያዎች ትልቁን ወደ ሄይቲ ወደ አንዱ ወ ደሆነው የአርቢኒየን ወንዝ ገለል ብለው እንዲገቡ አድርጓቸዋል።
translations.reference: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.hypothesis: According to the charges, waste from a United Nations camp was improperly stored, allowing bacteria to contaminate the water supply, which flowed into the Artibonite River, a major source of drinking water in Haiti.

translations.source: ወታደሮች ከመድረሳቸው በፊት ሄይቲ ከ 1800ዎቹ ጀምሮ ከበሽታው ጋር የተያያዙ ችግሮች አጋጥሟት አያውቅም።
translations.reference: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.hypothesis: Haiti has faced cyclical problems with cholera since the early 1800s, before its independence.

translations.source: የሄይቲ የፍትህና የዴሞክራሲ ተቋም የኔፓል የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ሻለቃ ባለማወቅ በሽታውን ወደ ሃይቲ ያመጣ መሆኑን የሚያመለክቱ ገለልተኛ ጥናቶችን ዋቢ አድርጓል።
translations.reference: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.hypothesis: The United Nations peacekeeping mission in Haiti is being blamed for bringing the disease to Haiti by independent studies.

translations.source: ዳንዬል ላንታኝ፣ በበሽታው ዙሪያ የ ዩኤን ባለሙያ፣ ስርጭቱ በሰላም ጠባቂዎች የተከሰተ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ጠቅሳለች።
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.hypothesis: Daniela Larocca, a WHO expert on the disease, said the spread could be linked to the presence of armed groups.

translations.source: ሀሚልተን የሃዋርድ ዩኒቨርስቲ ሆስፒታል ታማሚውን በተረጋጋ ሁኔታ መቀበሉን አረጋግጧል።
translations.reference: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.hypothesis: Hamilton confirmed that Howard University Hospital received the patient in stable condition.

translations.source: በሽተኛው በናይጄሪያ ነበር አንዳንድ የኢቦላ ቫይረስ የተከሰተበት ስፍራ።
translations.reference: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.hypothesis: The patient was a resident of a rural area in Nigeria that had previously experienced outbreaks of Ebola virus disease.

translations.source: ሆስፒታሉ የኢንፌክሽን ቁጥጥርን ለመከላከል፣ ሊከሰቱ የሚችሉ ኢንፌክሽኖችን ለመከላከል በሽተኛውን ከሌሎች ጋር መለየትን ጨምሮ ፕሮቶኮልን የተከተለ ነበር።
translations.reference: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.hypothesis: The hospital followed protocol for infection prevention control, including the isolation of the patient from others, to prevent any potential spread of infection.

translations.source: ከ ዘ ሲምፕሰንስ በፊት ሳይመን በተለያዩ ቦታዎች በበርካታ ትርኢቶች ላይ ሠርቶ ነበር።
translations.reference: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.hypothesis: Before The Simpsons, Simon worked on several shows in various capacities.

translations.source: በ1980ዎቹ ዘመን እንደ ታክሲ፣ ቺርስ እና ዘ ትሬይሲ ኡልማን ሾው ያሉ ዝግጅቶች ላይ ሠርቷል።
translations.reference: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.hypothesis: He had worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers and The Tracey Ullman Show in the 1980s.

translations.source: በ1989 ዘ ሲምሰንስን ከብሩክስ እና ጎሮኢኒንግ ጋር ለመፍጠር አግዟል እናም የፊልሙን የመጀመሪያ የጽሑፍ ቡድን የመቅጠር ኃላፊነትም የእሱ ነበር።
translations.reference: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.hypothesis: In 1989 he was hired to create The Simpsons with Brooks and Graunstein, and he was in charge of hiring the show's original writing staff.

translations.source: በ1993 ዝግጅቱን ቢለቅም ኤክስኪዩቲቭ ፕሮዲውሰር ማዕረጉን ይዞ፣ በየክፍሉ በአስር ሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ዶላሮችን እንደ ባለመብት ሲቀበል ቆይቷል።
translations.reference: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
translations.hypothesis: Although he left the show in 1993, he continued to receive royalties from his role as executive producer, earning him several million dollars a year.

translations.source: ቀደም ብሎ የቻይና የዜና ኤጀንሲ ሺንሁዋ አንድ አውሮፕላን ሊታገት እንደሆነ ዘግቧል።
translations.reference: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
translations.hypothesis: Earlier, Chinese state news agency Xinhua reported that one plane had already been seized.

translations.source: በኋላ ላይ የውጡት ዘገባዎች፣ አውሮፕላኑ የቦንብ ዛቻ ደርሶት ወደ አፍጋኒስታን በማዞር፣ በካንዳሃር ማረፉ ተገልጿል።
translations.reference: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
translations.hypothesis: Subsequent reports said the aircraft had been forced to land in Kandahar, Afghanistan, after being threatened with a bomb.

translations.source: የመጀመሪያዎቹ ዘገባዎች አውሮፕላኑ በኡሩምቂ የድንገተኛ ጊዜ ማረፍ ከተከለከለ በኋላ ወደ አፍጋኒስታን ተመልሷል ይላሉ።
translations.reference: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
translations.hypothesis: Initial reports said the aircraft had returned to base in Urumqi after being denied permission to land at the Afghan airport.

translations.source: በኢራን ውስጥ የአየር አደጋዎች የተለመዱ ናቸው፣ ለውትድርናም ለህዝብም ክንዋኔዎች በመጥፎ ሁኔታ የተያዙ ያረጁ መርከቦች አሉት።
translations.reference: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
translations.hypothesis: Storms in the Persian Gulf are common, and the vessels involved had been known to be in the area for several days.

translations.source: እንደ ዓለም አቀፍ ማዕቀቦች አዳዲስ አውሮፕላኖችን መግዛት አይቻልም ማለት ነው።
translations.reference: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
translations.hypothesis: It is almost like an international sanction to not be able to buy new airplanes.

translations.source: በዚህ ሳምንት መጀመሪያ፣ አንድ የፖሊስ ሄሊኮፕተር አደጋ ሶስት ሰዎችን ገድሎ ሶስት ሰዎችን ደግሞ አቅስሏል።
translations.reference: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.hypothesis: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and injured three others.

translations.source: ባለፈው ወር ኢራን ወደ አርሜኒያ የሚሄድ ኤርላይነር የመከስከስ አደጋ ሲደርስበትና 168 ሰዎችን ሲገል በዓመታት ያላየችውን እጅግ የከፋ የአየር አደጋን አይታለች።
translations.reference: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
translations.hypothesis: Last month Iran saw the deadliest air crash in decades when an airliner bound for Armenia went down, killing all 168 people on board.

translations.source: በዚያው ወር በማሽሃድ አንድ ሌላ አውሮፕላን ከማረፊያው በማለፍ ግድግዳ መትቶ ዐሥራ ሰባት ሰዎችን ገድሏል።
translations.reference: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.hypothesis: That same month, a commuter plane crashed into a hotel in Mashhad, killing 17 people.

translations.source: ኤሮስሚዝ በጉዞአቸው ላይ የነበሩትን ቀሪ ኮንሰርቶች ሰርዘዋል።
translations.reference: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.hypothesis: Aerosmith canceled the rest of their tour.

translations.source: የሮክ ባንዱ እስከ ሴፕቴምበር 16 ድረስ ዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና ካናዳን ለመጎብኘት ቀጠሮ ነበረው።
translations.reference: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.hypothesis: The band had a scheduled tour of the United States and Canada until September 16.

translations.source: መሪ ዘፋኙ ስቲቨን ታይለር ኦገስት 5 ላይ እየዘፈነ ከመድረክ ከወደቀ በኋላ ጉዳት ስለደረሰበት ጉብኝቱን ሰርዘዋል።
translations.reference: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
translations.hypothesis: The lead singer, Steven Tyler, missed the concert because he hurt himself after falling off the stage on August 5.

translations.source: ሙሬይ ሁለቱም ወንዶች እያንዳንዱን የተወረውን ኳስ ከያዙ በኋላ የመጀመሪያውን የአቻ መስበሪያ ተሸነፈ።
translations.reference: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
translations.hypothesis: Murray won the first set after taking the match point.

translations.source: ዴል ፖትሮ በሁለተኛው ዙር ቀዳሚ ጥቅም ነበረው፣ ግን ይህም 6-6 ከደረሱ በኋላ የአቻ መለያ አስፈለገው።
translations.reference: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
translations.hypothesis: Del Potro had the advantage of serving first in the fifth, but this only allowed Roddick to level the score at 6-6.

translations.source: ፖትሮ በዚህ ጊዜ ለትከሻው ሕክምና አገኘ ግን ወደ ጨዋታው ለመመለስ ቻለ።
translations.reference: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.hypothesis: Potter received treatment for his injury at the time but was able to return to the sport.

translations.source: መርሃ ግብሩ 8:30 ፒ.ኤም እንደ አካባቢው አቆጣጠር (15.00 ዩቲሲ) ተጀመረ።
translations.reference: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.hypothesis: The event started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).

translations.source: በመላ አገሪቱ ያሉ ዝነኛ ዘፋኞች የባጃን ወይም የአምልኮ ዘፈኖችን ለሺሪ ሽያም እግሮች ስር አቀረቡ።
translations.reference: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
translations.hypothesis: Famous singers from across the country performed baajaa or devotional songs dedicated to the feet of Lord Shiva.

translations.source: ምሽቱን የጀመረው ዘፋኙ ሳንጁ ሻርማ ነበር፣ ተከትሎ ጃይ ሻንካር ቹድሃሪም chhappan bhog bhajan ን አስደምሟል። ዘፋኙ ራጁ ካንደልዋል አብሮት ነበር።
translations.reference: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.hypothesis: The evening began with a performance by Sanjeev Sharma, followed by Jai Shankar Chudhary who performed a chappan bhog bhajan. Raj Kandewal was the accompanying singer.

translations.source: ከዚያ በኋላ፣ ላካ ሲንግ ባጃንን ለመዘመር ግንባር ቀደም ሆነ።
translations.reference: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
translations.hypothesis: After that, Laka Sing became the first to sing the Bajau songs.

translations.source: 108 የሻፓንግ ቡሆግ (በሂንዱይዝም ውስጥ 56 የተለያዩ የሚበሉ ነገሮች፣ ለምሳሌ፣ ጣፋጮች፣ ፍራፍሬዎች ፣ ለውዝ ፣ ሙሉ ምግብ ወዘተ.የመሳሰሉት ለአማልክት የሚቀርቡ) ለ ባባ ሺያም ቀርበዋል።
translations.reference: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: 108 Shaporas (56 different kinds of eatables, such as cakes, fruits, halva, dry cakes, etc., offered to the deities) were presented to Baba Shyam.

translations.source: ላካ ሲንግ የ chhappan bhog bhajan ንም አቅርቧል። ዘፋኙ ራጁ ካንደልዋል አብሮት ነበር።
translations.reference: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.hypothesis: Laxmi Sing provided a chappan bhog bhajan. Singer Raj Kandolwal accompanied him.

translations.source: በሐሙሱ የቶኪዮ ጨዋታ ትርኢት መክፈቻ አቅርቦት ላይ የኒንቴንዶ ፕሬዝደንት ሳቶሩ ኢዋታ የኩባንያውን አዲሱን የኒንቴንዶ ሬቮሉሽን መሳሪያ ተቆጣጣሪውን ዲዛይን አቀረቡ።
translations.reference: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
translations.hypothesis: At a Tokyo press conference yesterday, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the company's newest gizmo, the Nintendo Revolution controller.

translations.source: የቴሌቪዥን ሪሞት በመምሰል፣ መቆጣጠሪያው አቅጣጫውን በሶስት-ገፅታዊ ቦታ ለመከፋፈል ከተጠቃሚው ቴሌቪዥን አጠገብ የሚቀመጡ ሁለት ሴንሰሮችን ይጠቀማል።
translations.reference: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
translations.hypothesis: Like a TV remote control, the controller uses two sensors that sit next to the user's TV to determine its position in three-dimensional space.

translations.source: ይህ ተጫዋቾችን፤ በቪዲዮ ጨዋታዎች ላይ መሣሪያውን በአየር ላይ በማንቀሳቀስ ድርጊቶችን እና እንቅስቃሴዎችን እንዲቆጣጠሩ ያስችላቸዋል።
translations.reference: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.hypothesis: This allows players to control actions and movement in video games using the device as an aerial joystick.

translations.source: ጂያንካርሎ ፊሲቼላ መኪናውን መቆጣጠር አቅቶት ገና ከጅምሩ ውድድሩን አቋረጠ።
translations.reference: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
translations.hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella retired from the race after an early spin.

translations.source: የቡድን አባሉ ፈርናንዶ ኣሎንሶ ለአብዛኛው ውድድር መሪ ነበረ፤ ነገር ግን ለፍተሻ ከቆመ ቡኃላ ተጠናቀቀ፤ ምክኒያቱም በመጥፎ ሁኔታ የገባ የፊት ጎማ ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.hypothesis: Team mate Fernando Alonso had been the race leader for most of the race, but he retired after a pit stop due to a problem with a wheel nut.

translations.source: ሚካኤል ሽማከር ውድድሩ ከአሎሶ ብዙም ሳይቆይ አቋርጧል፣ ምክንያቱም በውድድሩ ወቅት በነበሩት በርካታ ውጊያዎች ላይ በደረሰበት የሰስፔንሽን አደጋ ምክንያት።
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.hypothesis: Michael Schumacher's race ended prematurely, due to a crash in which he was unhurt, but his car suffered suspension damage.

translations.source: "እሷ በጣም ቆንጆ ናት እና በጣም ጥሩም ትዘፍናለች፣ ብሏል በዜና ጉባኤው ግልባጭ መሠረት ነው።"
translations.reference: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.hypothesis: "She was very pretty and a good singer," a source told Us Weekly.

translations.source: "በዚህ ላይ ልምምድ በምናደርግበት ጊዜ ሁሉ ስሜቴ ይቀሰቀስ ነበር፣ ከልቤ።"
translations.reference: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.hypothesis: "My spirit was always down, you know, from the bottom of my heart."

translations.source: ከተነሳ 3 ደቂቃዎች አካባቢ፣ አንድ የተንቀሳቃሽ ካሜራ ከነዳጅ ታንክ ውስጥ በርካታ የሙቀት መጠበቂያ አረፋዎች ሰብረው ሲወጡ ያሳያል።
translations.reference: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.hypothesis: About 3 minutes later, a live camera feed showed several explosions coming from the fuel tanks.

translations.source: ነገር ግን፣ ለመንኮራኩሩ ምንም ጉዳት አድርሰዋል ተብሎ አይታሰብም።
translations.reference: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.hypothesis: However, it is not expected to impact the company's performance.

translations.source: የናሳ መንኮራኩር ፕሮግራም ሃላፊ ኤን ዌይን ሀሌ ጁኒየር “እኛ ከሚያሳስበን ጊዜ በኋላ” አረፋው ወድቋል ብለዋል።
translations.reference: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.hypothesis: "It was a very long time coming," said N. Wayne Hale Jr., NASA's Space Shuttle Program Manager.

translations.source: በመስታወቱ አምስት ደቂቃ በኋላ ንፋሱ መግባት ይጀምራል፣ ከአንድ ደቂቃ በኋላ ንፋሱ 70ኪ.ሜ/ሰዓ. እየደረሰ ነው… ከዛ ዝናቡ ይመጣል ነገር ግን በጣም ከባድ እና ትልቅ ከመሆኑ የተነሳ ቆዳህን እንደ መርፌ ይመታዋል ከዛ በረዶ ከሰማይ ወረደ፣ ሰዎች እየደነገጡ እና እየጮሁ እና እርስ በራሳቸው ላይ ይሮጣሉ።
translations.reference: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.hypothesis: Five minutes later the wind started to pick up, and a minute later it was 70 km/h... Then came the rain, but it was so heavy and the drops so big that they felt like needles hitting your skin. Then the snow came, and people started screaming and shouting and running into the streets.

translations.source: እህቴን እና ጓደኛዋን አጣሁ እና በመንገዴ ላይ ሁለት አካል ጉዳተኞች በዊልቼር ላይ ነበሩ ፣ ሰዎች ዝም ብለው እየዘለሉ ይገፏቸው ነበር" አርማንድ ቬርሴስ እኝደተናገረው።
translations.reference: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.hypothesis: I lost my sister and a friend and on the way there were two disabled people on wheelchairs, people were just stepping over them and moving on," said Armand Vercies.

translations.source: ኤንኤችኬ በኒጋታ ጠቅላይ ግዛት የሚገኘው የካሺዋዛኪ ካሪዋ የኒኩሊየር ኃይል ማመንጫ እንደተለመደው እየሰራ እንደነበር ዘግቧል።
translations.reference: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.hypothesis: The NHK reported that the reactor at the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata Prefecture was operating normally.

translations.source: ሆኩሪኩ የኤሌትሪክ ኃይል ኮ. ከመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ ምንም ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰ እና እናም በሺካ የኒውክሊየር ኃይል ማመንጫ ያሉት ቁጥር 1 እና ቁጥር 2 ሬክተሮች እንደተዘጉ ዘግቧል።
translations.reference: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.hypothesis: Hokuriku Electric Co. reported that there was no damage from the earthquake and that the No. 1 and No. 2 reactors at the Shika nuclear power plant — which have been shut down — were not affected.

translations.source: በክልሉ ውስጥ ወደ 9400 የሚጠጉ ቤቶች ውሃ የላቸውም ፣ እና በግምት 100 የሚሆኑ ቤቶች ደግሞ መብራት አልባ ናቸው ተብሏል።
translations.reference: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.hypothesis: In the region, almost 9400 households do not have access to water and about 100 households do not have access to electricity.

translations.source: አንዳንድ መንገዶች ተጎድተዋል ፣ በተጎዱ አካባቢዎች የባቡር አገልግሎት ተቋርጧል እንዲሁም በኢሺካዋ መስተዳድር የሚገኘው የኖቶ አየር ማረፊያ እንደተዘጋ ነው።
translations.reference: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.hypothesis: Some roads are impassable, with rail services suspended in the affected areas, and Komatsu Airport in Ishikawa Prefecture closed.

translations.source: ከአገረ-ገዢው ጄኔራል ጽ/ቤት ውጭ አንድ ቦምብ ፈነዳ።
translations.reference: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.hypothesis: A bomb exploded outside the governor's office.

translations.source: በሁለት ሰዓት ውስጥ ሦስት ተጨማሪ ቦምቦች በመንግሥት ሕንፃዎች አቅራቢያ ፈንድተዋል።
translations.reference: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.hypothesis: Three more bombs were detonated in the space of two hours near government buildings.

translations.source: አንዳንድ ዘገባዎች ይፋዊውን የሞት ብዛትን ስምንት ያደረጉ ሲሆን ይፋዊው ሪፖርቶች እስከ 30 የሚደርሱ ሰዎች እንደቆሰሉ አረጋግጠዋል፡፡ ግን የመጨረሻ ቁጥሮች ገና አልታወቁም።
translations.reference: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.hypothesis: Some reports put the death toll at eight, while official reports confirm at least 30 injured. But final numbers are not yet known.

translations.source: ሁለቱም ሲያኑሪክ አሲድ እና ሜላሚን የተባሉ ንጥረ ነገሮች የቤት እንስሳት የተመረዘ ምግብ በልተው ሲሞቱ በሽንት ናሙናቸው ላይ ተገኝተዋል።
translations.reference: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.hypothesis: Both chemicals, a cyanuric acid and melamine, were detected in the urine of animals fed the contaminated feed.

translations.source: ሁለቱ ውህዶች የኩላሊትን ስራ ሊያግድ የሚችሉ ክሪስታሎችን ለመስራት እርስ በርስ ይቀላቀላሉ፣ በዩኒቨርሲቲው ጥናት አድራጊዎች ተናገሩ።
translations.reference: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.hypothesis: The two compounds join together to form crystals that can block kidney tubules, researchers from the University said.

translations.source: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሜላሚን እና ሲያኑሪክ አሲድ በመጨመር በድመት ሽንት ውስጥ የተፈጠሩ ክሪስታሎችን ተመልክተዋል።
translations.reference: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.hypothesis: The researchers observed the formation of crystals in cat urine that were made up of melamine and cyanuric acid.

translations.source: የእነዚህ ክሪስታሎች ጥንቅር ከኢንፍራሬድ ስፔክትሮስኮፒ (FTIR) በኩል ሲታይ በተጎዱ የቤት እንስሳት ሽንት ውስጥ ከሚገኙት ጋር ይዛመዳል።
translations.reference: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.hypothesis: The structure of these crystals is similar to that of the crystals found in the urine of affected animals, as seen by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).

translations.source: እርስዎ ይገነዘቡት ወይም አይገነዘቡት አላውቅም ፣ ግን ከመካከለኛው አሜሪካ የሚመጡ አብዛኛዎቹ ዕቃዎች ወደዚህ ሀገር የመጡት ከቀረጥ ነፃ ነው።
translations.reference: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.hypothesis: You may or may not know, but most products from Central America that are imported here are duty-free.

translations.source: ሆኖም በመካከለኛው የአሜሪካ ሀገራት የዕቃዎቻችን ሰማኒያ ፐርሰንት በታሪፎች ምክንያት ታክስ ይቆረጥበታል። እኛ እንሸፍንልዎታለን።
translations.reference: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: However, in the Central American countries, about 50 percent of our products are tax-free due to trade agreements. We will cover the difference.

translations.source: ይህ ለእኔ ትርጉም ያለው አልመሰለኝም፤ በእውነቱ አግባብ አልነበረም።
translations.reference: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.hypothesis: This was not the case for me; it was actually the opposite.

translations.source: ለሰዎች የምላቸው ነገር፤ እኛ እንደምናስተናግድዎ አስተናግዱን ነው።
translations.reference: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: What I would say to people is, treat us the way you want to be treated.

translations.source: የካሊፎርኒያ ገዥው አርኖልድ ሽዋርዚኔገር የአመጽ ቪዲዮ ጨዋታዎችን መሸጥ ወይም ማከራየትን ለታዳጊዎች የሚከለክል ህግን ተፈራርሟል።
translations.reference: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.hypothesis: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed a law restricting the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.

translations.source: ህጉ በካሊፎርኒያ ግዛት ውስጥ የሚሸጡ አመፀኛ ቪዲዮ ጨዋታዎች "18" በሚል ፅሑፍ ምልክት እንዲደረግባቸው እና ከዚያ ዓመት በታች ለሆነ ልጅ መሸጥ በአንድ ጥፋት $1000 የሚያስቀጣ ነው።
translations.reference: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.hypothesis: The law requires that video games sold in California that contain violence be labeled with an "18" rating and that retailers be fined $1,000 for selling such games to anyone under 18.

translations.source: የሕዝባዊ ዓቃቤ ሕግ ዳይሬክተር አቶ ኪየር ስታርመር ኪው.ሲ ዛሬ ጠዋት በሁኔ እና በፕራይስ ላይ ክሶች መከሰቱን አስታውቋል።
translations.reference: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.hypothesis: The public prosecutor's office, headed by Mr. Kjer Størmer Kjøs, announced this morning the charges against June and Price.

translations.source: ሁህኔ ስልጣናቸውን ለቀዋል እና በካቢኔው ውስጥ በፓርላማ አባሉ Ed Davey ይተካሉ። የፓርላማ አባል ኖርማን ላም የቢዝነስ ሚኒስትር ዴቪድ እየለቀቀው ያለውን ስራ ይወስዳል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
translations.reference: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.hypothesis: Hume has resigned and will be replaced in the cabinet by MP Ed Davey. Lord Norman Lamont is expected to take over from David as Business Minister.

translations.source: ሁህኔ እና ፕራይስ በዌስትሚኒስተር ማጅስትሬትስ ፍርድ ቤት እንዲቀርቡ ፌብርዋሪ 16 ቀን ቀጠሮ ተይዞላቸዋል።
translations.reference: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.hypothesis: Hui and Price are due to appear at Westminster Magistrates' Court on February 16.

translations.source: ሟቾች ኒኮላስ አልዴን 25 እና ዛካሪ ኩድባክ 21 የተባሉት ነበሩ። ኩድባክ ሾፌር ነበር።
translations.reference: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.hypothesis: The deceased were identified as 25-year-old Nicholas Alden and 21-year-old Zachary Kubach. Kubach was the driver.

translations.source: ኤድጋር ቬጉላ የክንድ እና የመንገጭላ ቁስሎች ተቀስቅሷል ኪሪስቶፈር ሽናይደር ለፊቱ መልሶ ማቋቋም የሚያስፈልገውን ቀዶ ጥገና ተፈልጓል።
translations.reference: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.hypothesis: Edgar Veguilla sustained a concussion and several lacerations to his face. Christopher Schneider required reconstructive surgery for his face.

translations.source: ወደ አምስተኛው ሰው ራስ ላይ እያመለከተ የ Uka መሣሪያ አልተሳካም። ሽናይደር ቀጣይነት ያለው ህመም ፣ በአንደኛው አይኑ ላይ ዓይነ ስውርነት ፣ የጎደለው የራስ ቅል ክፍል እና ከታይታኒየም እንደገና የተገነባ የፊት ገጽታ አለው።
translations.reference: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.hypothesis: The fifth man to be targeted by Uka's bomb survived. Schneier sustained a concussion, blindness in his left eye, a partially crushed skull, and a face reconstructed with titanium.

translations.source: ሽናይደር በትውልድ ሃገሩ ከ USAF የጦር ሰፈር በቪዲዮ ሊንክ ቃሉን ሰጠ።
translations.reference: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.hypothesis: Schneider gave his statement via video link from his hometown near the former US Air Force base.

translations.source: ከረቡዕ ዝግጅት ባሻገር፣ ካርፓኔዶ በሻምፒዮንሺፕ በሁለት የግል ውድድሮች ላይ ተወዳድሯል።
translations.reference: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.hypothesis: Besides Wednesday's event, Carpanedo will also take part in two individual races at the Championship.

translations.source: የመጀመሪያዋ ስላሎም ነበር፣ በመጀመሪያ ሩጫዋ ላይ አልጨረሰጭችም። ከ116 ተወዳዳሪዎች 36 በዚያ ውድድር ላይ ተመሳሳይ ውጤት ነበራቸው።
translations.reference: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.hypothesis: The first was a race, which she didn't finish. Of the 116 competitors, 36 had the same result.

translations.source: ሌላው ውድድሯ በግዙፉ ስላሉም በሴቶች ቡድን ውስጥ በተደመረ ሰዓት 4:41.30 ዐሥረኛ ሆና ስትጨርስ አየናት፣ ከመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ጨራሽ ኦስትሪያዊዋ ክላውዲያ ሎአስችህ 2:11.60 ቀስ ያለ እና ዘጠነኛ ከጨረሰችው የሃንጋሪዋ ግዮንግዪ ዳኒ 1:09.02 ያክል የዘገየ ጊዜ ነው።
translations.reference: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.hypothesis: Her other medal was a silver in the team event, where the Netherlands finished fourth in 4:41.30, 0.3 seconds behind the medal-winning team of Austria, Claudia Loasich, who had earlier finished ninth in the individual event in 2:11.60, and Gyongyi Dani of Hungary, who had finished eighth in the individual event in 1:09.02.

translations.source: በሴቶች ቡድን ውስጥ አራት የበረዶ ተንሸራታቾች ሩጫቸውን መጨረስ አልቻሉም፣ በግዙፉ ስላሎም ካሉት ከ117ቱ የበረዶ ተንሸራታቾች 45ቱ በውድድሩ ደረጃ ማግኘት አልቻሉም።
translations.reference: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.hypothesis: Four of the women's bobsled teams failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 sleds in the luge competition crashed.

translations.source: የማድህያ ፕራዴሽ ፖሊስ የተሰረቀውን ላፕቶፕ እና የሞባይል ስልክ አገኘ።
translations.reference: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.hypothesis: The Rajasthan police have recovered the stolen laptops and mobile phones.

translations.source: ምክትል ኢንስፔክተር ጀኔራል ዲ ኬ አርያ “የስዊስዋን ሴት አስገድደው የደፈሯትን አምስት ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ሥር አውለናል እና ሞባይልና ላፕቶፗን አስመልሰናል” ብለዋል።
translations.reference: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.hypothesis: Deputy Inspector General of Police, D. K. Arya, said, "We have arrested five people who are responsible for the Swiss woman's death and have seized their mobile phones and laptops."

translations.source: ተከሳሾች ባባ ካንጃር፣ ቡታ ካንጃር፣ ራምፕሮ ካንጃር፣ ጋዛ ካንጃር እና ቪሽኑ ካንጃር ተብለው ይጠራሉ።
translations.reference: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.hypothesis: The defendants are referred to as Abacha, Buta, Rampra, Gasa and Vishnu.

translations.source: የፖሊስ የበላይ ተቆጣጣሪ ቻንድራ ሸክሃር ሶላንኪ ተከሳሹ ፍርድ ቤት የቀረበው በተሸፈነ ፊት ነው ብሏል።
translations.reference: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.hypothesis: Police chief investigator Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused was produced before the magistrate on Friday.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን መኪናው በተጋጨበት ጊዜ ሶስት ሰዎች በቤት ውስጥ የነበሩ ቢሆንም፣ አንዳቸውም አልተጎዱም።
translations.reference: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
translations.hypothesis: Although three people were in the house at the time of the break-in, none were hurt.

translations.source: ሆኖም አሽከርካሪው በጭንቅላቱ ላይ ከባድ የአካል ጉዳት ደርሶበታል።
translations.reference: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
translations.hypothesis: The driver, however, sustained a serious head injury.

translations.source: የአደጋ ጊዜ አገልግሎት ሾፌሩን ከቀዩ የኦዲ ቲቲ ነፃ ሲያወጣ አደጋው የተከሰተበት መንገድ ለጊዜው ተዘግቶ ነበር።
translations.reference: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.hypothesis: The accident scene was temporarily closed to traffic while emergency services attended to the driver.

translations.source: በግሬት ያርማውዝ ውስጥ በጄምስ ፓጌት ሆስፒታል መጀመሪያ ተኝቶ ነበር።
translations.reference: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.hypothesis: He first slept at James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: በቀጣይ ካምብሪጅ ውስጥ ወዳለው አደንብሩክስ ሆስፒታል ተዘዋውሯል።
translations.reference: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.hypothesis: He later moved to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.

translations.source: አዴኮያ ከዚያን ጊዜ ጀምሮ በኤድንበርግ ሸሪፍ ፍርድ ቤት ልጇን በመግደል ወንጀል ተከሳለች።
translations.reference: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.hypothesis: Adeboye has since been charged with the murder of his daughter at the Edinburgh Sheriff Court.

translations.source: ክስ እና የክስ ማስረጃ እየጠበቀች በቁጥጥር ስር ውላለች፣ ነገር ግን ማንኛውም የአይን እማኝ ማስረጃ ተቀባይነት ላያገኝ ይችላል ምክንያቱም ስለእሷ በማህበረሰቡ በስፋት ተነግሯል።
translations.reference: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.hypothesis: She was detained and charged with theft, but no eyewitness evidence could be produced against her, though many in the community said they knew of her widely.

translations.source: ይህ በUK ውስጥ ሌላ ቦታ የተለመደ ድርጊት ነው ነገር ግን የስኮትላንድ ፍትህ በተለየ መንገድ ይሰራል እናም ፍርድ ቤቶች ፎቶግራፎችን ማተም እንደ ጭፍን ጥላቻ አድርገው ይመለከቱታል።
translations.reference: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.hypothesis: This is a fairly common activity elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts there generally frown on the practice.

translations.source: የዳንዴ ዩኒቨርስቲ ፕሮፌሰር ፓሜላ ፈርግሰን “ጋዜጠኞች ፎቶዎችን እና ሌሎች የተጠርጣሪዎችን መረጃ ካተሙ ጋዜጠኞች በአደገኛ መስመር እየተጓዙ ይመስላል” ብለዋል።
translations.reference: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.hypothesis: "When reporters gather photos and other information about the accused, they are treading on dangerous ground," said Pamela Ferguson, a professor at Dundee University.

translations.source: አጠቃላይ የክስ አቅራቢ የሆነው የአክሊል ቢሮ ለጋዜጠኞች የክስ ማስረጃ እስኪኖር ድረስ ምንም አይነት አስተያየት አይሰጥም ብሏል።
translations.reference: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
translations.hypothesis: The general manager of the defendant's office told reporters that they would not comment on the case until the evidence was presented in court.

translations.source: ሰነዱ ፣ ሾልኮ በወጣው መረጃ መሠረት ማለት ነው፣ ፍልስጤም ከ 1967 የመካከለኛ ምስራቅ ጦርነት በፊት በጠረፍ ላይ ተመስርታ የምትፈልገውን የድንበር ውዝግብ የሚያመለክት ነው።
translations.reference: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
translations.hypothesis: The document, according to Scholz's information, alludes to a border dispute that has been on hold since the Six-Day War in 1967.

translations.source: ሌሎች የተሸፈኑ ርእሶች ሪፖርት እንደተደረገው ለሁለቱም ሀገራት እና ለዮርዳኖስ ሸለቆ ጉዳይ ቅዱስ የሆነ የወደፊቱን የኢየሩሳሌምን ሁኔታ ያካትታሉ።
translations.reference: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
translations.hypothesis: Other pending issues reported for both countries and for the occupied territories include the holy city of Jerusalem and its future status.

translations.source: እስራኤል አንድ ስምምነት ከተፈረመ በኋላ ለአስር ዓመታት በሸለቆው ውስጥ ቀጣይነት ያለው ወታደራዊ መገኘት ትፈልጋለች፣ PA በበኩሉ እንዲህ ዓይነቱን መገኘት ለአምስት ዓመታት ብቻ እንዲሆን ይስማማል።
translations.reference: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
translations.hypothesis: Israel wanted a continued military presence in the valley for a decade after a final agreement was signed, while the PA agreed to a five-year term for such a presence.

translations.source: ተጨማሪ የተባይ ቁጥጥር ሙከራ ውስጥ ተኳሾች በጠባቂዎች ቅርብ ቁጥጥር ይደረግባቸዋል ሙከራው በቁጥጥር ሥር ስለ ዋለ እና ውጤታማነቱ ስለ ተገመገመ።
translations.reference: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
translations.hypothesis: In additional control trials, the vaccines are given to a small number of volunteers and their effectiveness is tested.

translations.source: በስፖርት ተኳሾች ማኅበር የአደን ፕሮግራም በኩል፣ በ NPWS እና በአውስትራሊያ ስፖርት እስኮተርስ ማህበር (NSW) Inc አጋርነት ብቁ ፈቃደኞች ተመልምለው ነበር።
translations.reference: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
translations.hypothesis: Through the Archery Australia inclusion program, in partnership with the National Parks and Wildlife Service (NPWS) and the Australian Sporting Shooters Association (NSW) Inc, suitable volunteers were recruited.

translations.source: በሚክ ኦ’ፍሊን፣ ከኤንፒደብሊውኤስ ጋር የፓርክ ጥበቃ እና ቅርስ ተጠባባቂ ዳይሬክተር መሰረት፣ ለመጀመሪያው የተኩስ ስራ የተመረጡት አራቱ ተኳሾች አጠቃላይ የደህንነት እና ስልጠና ትዕዛዝ ተቀብለዋል።
translations.reference: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
translations.hypothesis: According to Mick O'Flynn, Deputy Director-General of the NWPA, the four crew members of the first manned mission have already received their initial safety and training instructions.

translations.source: ማርቴሊ ዘጠኝ አባላት ባሉት አዲስ የሽግግር ምርጫ ምክር ቤት (ሲኢፒ) ውስጥ ቃል ገብቷል።
translations.reference: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.hypothesis: Martelly has pledged to appoint a new nine-member Provisional Electoral Council (CEP).

translations.source: ይህ በአራት ዓመታት ውስጥ የማርቴሊ አምስተኛው CEP ነው።
translations.reference: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.hypothesis: This is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.

translations.source: ያለፈው ወር ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ኮሚሽኑ ሀገሪቷን ወደ አዲሱ ምርጫ የሚወሰዷቸው እርምጃዎች ጥቅል አካል የሲኢፒን ቀድሞ መልቀቅን መክረዋል።
translations.reference: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.hypothesis: Last month, the Presidential Commission recommended the SEC's early termination as part of a package of measures to reform the country's electoral system.

translations.source: ኮሚሽኑ በጥቅምት ወር ለተጀመረው ሰፊ የፀረ-አገዛዝ ተቃውሞዎች የማርቲሊ ምላሽ ነበር።
translations.reference: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
translations.hypothesis: Martilly's response was to broaden the Commission's mandate, which had begun in October with a focus on anti-competitive mergers.

translations.source: የአንዳንዴ-ዓመፃዊ ሰላማዊ ሰልፎች የሚነሱት ምርጫዎችን ካለማድረግ ነው አንዳንዶቹ ከ2011 ጀምሮ።
translations.reference: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
translations.hypothesis: Occasional protests erupt over the lack of options, some since 2011.

translations.source: ወደ 60 የሚጠጉ የአይፖዶች ከመጠን በላይ መሞቅ ጉዳዮች ብልሽት ሪፖርት የተደረጉ ሲሆን፤ በአጠቃላይ ስድስት የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች በመከሰታቸው አራት ሰዎችን መጠነኛ ቃጠሎ እንዲደርስባቸው አድርጓል።
translations.reference: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
translations.hypothesis: There have been about 60 cases of iDevice overheating reported, with a total of six fire incidents resulting in four people sustaining minor injuries.

translations.source: የጃፓን የኢኮኖሚ፣ ንግድ እና ኢንዱስትሪ ሚኒስትር (ኤምኢቲአይ) ከመሳሪያዎቹ ጋር የተያያዙ 27 አደጋዎችን እንዳወቀ ተናግሯል።
translations.reference: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
translations.hypothesis: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said it was aware of 27 cases involving the equipment.

translations.source: ባለፈው ሳምንት፣ METI አፕል ኩባንያው “ከባድ ያልሆኑ” ብሎ የጠራቸውን 34 ተጨማሪ ከመጠን በላይ የመሞቅ ክስተቶች እንዳሳወቀው ገልጿል።
translations.reference: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
translations.hypothesis: Last week, METI announced 34 additional cases of overheating, which Apple had labelled "non-severe."

translations.source: ሚኒስትሩ የአፕልን የዘገባ ማሸጋገር "በዕውነቱ አሳዛኝ" በማለት ምላሹን ሰጥቷል።
translations.reference: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
translations.hypothesis: The minister responded to Apple's closure of its development centre in the country by saying it was "really sad."

translations.source: የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ማሪናን በ 07:19 ኤ.ኤም. በአካባቢው ሰዓት (አርብ 09:19 ፒ.ኤም ጂኤምቲ) ላይ መታት።
translations.reference: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.hypothesis: The earthquake struck Marina at 7:19 a.m. local time (10:19 a.m. GMT Friday).

translations.source: የሰሜን ማሪያናስ ድንገተኛ አደጋዎች ማኔጅመንት ጽሕፈት ቤት፣ በሃገሪቱ ውስጥ ሪፖርት የተደረጉ ጉዳቶች የሉም ብሏል።
translations.reference: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
translations.hypothesis: The Office of Emergency Management in the Northern Mariana Islands said there were no damages reported in the country.

translations.source: እንዲሁም የፓስፊክ ሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያ ማዕከል የሱናሚ ምልክት እንደሌለ ተናግሯል።
translations.reference: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.hypothesis: The Pacific Tsunami Warning Centre also reported no tsunami threat.

translations.source: አንድ የቀድሞ የፊሊፒንስ ፖሊስ የፊሊፒንስ ዋና ከተማ በሆነችው ማኒላ ውስጥ አንድ አውቶቡስ በመጥለፍ የሆንግ ኮንግ ቱሪስቶች አግቶ ቆይተዋል።
translations.reference: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.hypothesis: A former Philippine police officer hijacked a bus in Manila, the Philippine capital, and held 24 Hong Kong tourists captive.

translations.source: ሮላንዶ ሜንዶዛ የ M16 ጠመንጃውን በቱሪስቶች ላይ ተኩሷል።
translations.reference: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.hypothesis: Rolando Mendoza shot at the tourists with an M16 rifle.

translations.source: በርካታ ታጋቾችን ማዳን ተችሏል እናም እስካሁን በትንሹ ስድስት እንደሞቱ ተረጋግጧል።
translations.reference: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.hypothesis: Several hostages were rescued and at least six deaths have been confirmed.

translations.source: ሕፃናትንና አዛውንትን ጨምሮ ስድስት ታጋቾች፣ እንዲሁም የፊሊፒኖ ፎቶ ባለሞያዎች ቀደም ብለው ተለቀዋል።
translations.reference: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.hypothesis: Six hostages, including three children and an elderly man, as well as Filipino photojournalist James Bully, have already been released.

translations.source: መጸዳጃ ቤት መሄድ ስለፈለገች ፎቶ አንሺዎቹ ያረጀችዋን ሴትዮ ቦታ ወሰዱ። ሜንዶዛ በሽጉጥ ተገደለች።
translations.reference: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.hypothesis: The photographer took a picture of the elderly lady who had gone to the bathroom because she needed to go. Mendoza was killed by a stray bullet.

translations.source: ሊጊንስ የአባቱን ፈለግ በመከተል የሕክምና ስራ ውስጥ ተቀላቀለ።
translations.reference: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.hypothesis: Ligons followed in his father's footsteps and joined the medical field.

translations.source: በማኅፀናት ሐኪምነት ሥልጠና አግኝተው በ 1959 በኦክላንድ ብሔራዊ የሴቶች ሆስፒታል መሥራት ጀመሩ።
translations.reference: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.hypothesis: She trained as an obstetrician and began work at the Oakland National Women's Hospital in 1959.

translations.source: በሆስፒታል ውስጥ በሚሰራበት ጊዜ ሊጊንስ በትርፍ ጊዜው ስለ ቀድሞ የሚመጣ ምጥ ማጥናት ጀመረ።
translations.reference: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
translations.hypothesis: During his time in the hospital, Higgins began researching lucid dreaming in his spare time.

translations.source: የእርሱ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው ሆርሞን ከተሰጠ የሕፃኑን የፅንስ የሳንባ ብስለት ያፋጥናል።
translations.reference: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.hypothesis: His research has shown that the hormone speeds up the development of the fetus’s lungs.

translations.source: የመንግስት መርማሪዎች ረቡዕ ዕለት ሁለት ‘የጥቁር ሣጥን’ የበረራ መቅጃዎችን ማግኘታቸውን ዢንህዋ ዘግቧል።
translations.reference: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.hypothesis: Xinhua reported that government investigators found two "black boxes" on Wednesday.

translations.source: አብረዋት የሚሠሩ ታጋዮችም ለሉና ሃዘናቸውን ገለጹ፡፡
translations.reference: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.hypothesis: Her colleagues also expressed shock and sadness.

translations.source: ቶሚ ድሪመር እንዳሉት “ሉና የመጀመሪያዋ የፅንፈኛ ንግሥት ነበረች። የእኔ የመጀመሪያ ሥራ አስኪያጅ። ሉና በሁለት ጨረቃዎች ምሽት አረፈች። ልክ እንደ እርሷ ልዩ ቆንጆ። ጠንካራ ሴት።"
translations.reference: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.hypothesis: "Luna was the first lady of rock and roll. My first manager. Luna had a two-day pass on the moon. As unique and pretty as she was. She was a tough cookie," Tommy Drexler said.

translations.source: ደስቲን “ጎልደስት” ረነልስ በሰጡት አስተያየት “ሉና እንደ እኔ በጣም እብድ ነበረች… ምናልባት ከኔ የበለጠ… እወዳታለሁ እና ትናፍቀኛለች… በተሻለው ቦታ እንደምትኖር ተስፋ አለን።”
translations.reference: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.hypothesis: Dozens of Rennies' friends and colleagues offered their condolences. "Luna was as mad as me," said Goldstine, "maybe even crazier than me. I loved her and she loved me and we were lucky to have lived as long as we did."

translations.source: ከ2010 ፌደራላዊ ምርጫ በፊት ከመረጡት 1,400 ሰዎች ውስጥ፣ የአውስትራሊያን ሪፐብሊክ መሆን የሚቃወሙት ከ2008 አንስቶ በ8 በመቶ አደጉ።
translations.reference: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.hypothesis: Of the 1,400 people surveyed before the 2010 federal election, opposition to Australia becoming a republic has risen 8 per cent since 2008.

translations.source: ተጠባባቂ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጁሊያ ጊላርድ በ 2010 የፌዴራል ምርጫ ዘመቻ ወቅት ንግስት ኤልሳቤጥ II በንግሥና ማብቂያ አውስትራሊያ ሪፐብሊክ መሆን አለባት ብለው እንደሚያምኑ ተናግረዋል።
translations.reference: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.hypothesis: Deputy Prime Minister Julia Gillard said in the lead-up to the 2010 federal election that Queen Elizabeth II had told her that Australia should become a republic.

translations.source: ከድምጽ መስጫ ጣቢያው ውስጥ 34 በመቶ የሚሆኑት ይህንን አመለካከት የሚጋሩ ሲሆን ንግስት ኤልሳቤጥ II የአውስትራሊያ የመጨረሻዋ ንግስት እንድትሆን ይፈልጋሉ።
translations.reference: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.hypothesis: 34% of respondents in the poll share this view and want Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's final monarch.

translations.source: በምርጫው ጫፎች ላይ፣ ከተጠኑት ውስጥ 29 በመቶዎቹ አውስትራሊያ በተቻለ ፍጥነት ሪፐብሊክ መሆን እንዳለባት ሲያምኑ፣ 31 በመቶዎቹ ደግሞ አውስትራሊያ መቼም ሪፐብሊክ መሆን እንደሌለባት ያምናሉ።
translations.reference: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.hypothesis: On the extremes of the political spectrum, 29% of Australians believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31% believe Australia should never become a republic.

translations.source: የኦሎምፒክ ወርቅ አሸናፊው በ100ሜ እና 200ሜ በነጻ የዋና ውድድር እኛ በኮመንዌልዝ ጨዋታዎች ላይ ሦስት ዱላ ቅብብሎሽ ነው ነገር ግን በቀሬታዎቹ ምክንያት የአካል ብቃቱ በጥርጣሬ ላይ ነበር።
translations.reference: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.hypothesis: The Olympic champion and world record holder in the 100m and 200m freestyle is a triple gold medallist from the Commonwealth Games, but his fitness has been questioned due to his recent injury.

translations.source: ከጨዋታዎቹ የተከለከሉ በመሆናቸው ህመሙን ለመቋቋም የሚያስፈልጉትን መድኃኒቶች መውሰድ አልቻለም።
translations.reference: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.hypothesis: Unable to access the medications he needs to manage his condition because of the restrictions on the movement of people and goods.

translations.source: በማዕከላዊ ሚዙሪ ዩኒቨርሲቲ የሂሳብ ሊቅ እና የኮምፒተር ሳይንስ ፕሮፌሰር የሆኑት ከርቲስ ኩፐር፣ እስከ ጃንዋሪ 25 ቀን ድረስ ትልቁን የብቸኜ ቁጥር አግኝተዋል።
translations.reference: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer scientist at the University of Central Missouri, found the largest prime number as of January 25.

translations.source: ብዙ ሰዎች የተለያዩ ሃርድዌሮችን እና ሶፍትዌሮችን በመጠቀም ግኝቱን እስከ የካቲት መጀመሪያ ድረስ አረጋግጠው ማክሰኞ ይፋ ተደርጓል።
translations.reference: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.hypothesis: Many people used various hardware and software to confirm the discovery until early February, when it was announced on Tuesday.

translations.source: ኮሜቶች ምናልባት ፕሮቲኖችን ሊፈጥሩ እና ህይወትን ሊደግፉ ከሚችሉ ኦርጋኒክ ንጥረ ነገሮች ጋር ወደ ምድር የውሃ አቅርቦት ምንጭ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.hypothesis: Comets may have been a source of water to the early Earth, and may have delivered organic molecules that could have helped to seed life.

translations.source: ኮሜቶች ከረጅም ጊዜ በፊት ከምድር ጋር ተጋጭተው ስለነበረ የሳይንስ ሊቃውንት ፕላኔቶች እንዴት እንደሚፈጠሩ በተለይም ምድር እንዴት እንደተመሰረተ ለመረዳት ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።
translations.reference: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists hope to learn how the planets were formed by studying the composition of these meteorites, as they are thought to be remnants of the early solar system.

translations.source: የ 53 ዓመቱ ኩሞ አገዛዙን የጀመረው በዚህ ዓመት መጀመሪያ ላይ ሲሆን ተመሳሳይ የወሲብ ጋብቻን ሕጋዊ ለማድረግ ባለፈው ወር ተፈረመ።
translations.reference: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.hypothesis: The 53-year-old, who began his reign earlier this year, signed the law last month to legalise same-sex civil unions.

translations.source: አሉባታዎቹን «የፖለቲካ ሁካታ እና ጅልነት» ሲል ጠቅሷቸዋል።
translations.reference: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.hypothesis: He described the allegations as "political persecution and a witch-hunt."

translations.source: በ 2016 ለፕሬዚዳንትነት እንደሚወዳደሩ ይገመታል።
translations.reference: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.hypothesis: He was expected to run for president in 2016.

translations.source: NextGen፣ FAA አንድ አውሮፕላን በየዓመቱ ሚሊየን ጋሎን ነዳጅ እንዲቆጥብ እና የካርቦን ልቀትን እንዲቀንስ አጭር ጉዞዎችን እንዲያረግ ያስችላል ብሎ የሚያውጀው ሥርዓት ነው።
translations.reference: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
translations.hypothesis: NextGen is a system that the FAA claims will allow aircraft to fly more efficiently, saving millions of gallons of fuel and reducing carbon emissions.

translations.source: ከቀድሞው መሬት-ራዳር ላይ የተመሠረተ ቴክኖሎጂ በተቃራኒ፣ የአየር ትራፊክ ተቆጣጣሪዎች አውሮፕላኖችን በከፍተኛ ትክክለኛነት እንዲለዩ እና ለአውሮፕላን አብራሪዎች የበለጠ ትክክለኛ መረጃ እንዲሰጡ ለማድረግ በሳተላይት ላይ የተመሠረተ ቴክኖሎጂን ይጠቀማል።
translations.reference: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.hypothesis: Unlike the previous ground-based technology, it uses satellite-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to identify aircraft with greater accuracy and provide pilots with more precise information.

translations.source: ተጨማሪ ጉዞ እየተጨመረ አይደለም እናም ከመሬት በላይ የሚሄዱ ባቡሮች ዌምብሌይ ላይ አይቆሙም፤ እናም መኪና ማቆሚያ እኛ አቁመው-ይጓዙ ተቋማት መሬት ላይ አይገኙም።
translations.reference: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.hypothesis: Additional trains are not being run and the Underground does not stop at Wembley Park; and Car parks are not available at the Park and Ride locations.

translations.source: የመጓጓዣ እጦት ፍርሃቶች ጨዋታው በተዘጉ በሮች ውስጥ ያለቡድኑ ደጋፊዎች እንዲካሄድ የመገደዱን ዕድል ጨመሩት።
translations.reference: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.hypothesis: Fears over transport logistics also increased the likelihood of the match being played behind closed doors.

translations.source: በሳይንስ መጽሔት ውስጥ ሐሙስ ቀን የታተመ አንድ ጥናት፣ በኢኳዶሪያን ጋላፓጎስ ደሴቶች ላይ አዲስ የወፍ ዝርያ ስለመፍጠር ሪፖርት ተደርጓል።
translations.reference: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.hypothesis: A study published in the journal Science on Thursday reported the discovery of a new species of finch in the Ecuadorian Galapagos Islands.

translations.source: ዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ውስጥ የፕሪንስተን ዩኒቨርሲቲ እና የስዊድን ውስጥ አፕሳላ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ጥናት አድራጊዎች በብርቅዬ ዳርዊን ፊንች፣ ጂኦስፒዛ ፎርቴስ፣ እና በውጩ ካክተስ ፊንች፣ ጂኦስፒዛ ኮኒሮስትሪስ መካከል መራባት ምክንያት፣ ይህ ሂደት የበለጠ ረጅም ጊዜ እንደሚወስድ ይገመት የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ አዲሱ ዝርያ በሁለት ትውልዶች ብቻ መፈጠሩን ዘግበዋል።
translations.reference: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.hypothesis: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden have reported that the new species, known as the Large Ground Finch (Geospiza magnirostris), and the Cactus Ground Finch (Geospiza conirostris), have been found to have evolved from a common ancestor, despite the fact that they are reproductively isolated.

translations.source: ወርቅ ወደ ሁሉም ዓይነት ቅርፆች መሰራት ይችላል። ወደ ትንንሽ ቀርፆች መጠቅለል ይችላል።
translations.reference: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
translations.hypothesis: Gold can be made into almost any shape. It can be beaten into thin sheets.

translations.source: መታጠፍ እና መጎንጎን ወደሚችል ቀጭን ሽቦ መለጠጥ ይችላል። ወደ ልሙጥነት መቀጥቀጥ ወይም መጠቅለል ይችላል።
translations.reference: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
translations.hypothesis: It can be stretched into a thin wire that can be bent and molded. It can be drawn into wires or hammered into thin sheets.

translations.source: በጣም ቀጭን ሆኖ ይሰራና እና በሌላ ብረት ላይ ይጣበቃል። በጣም ቀጭን ሆኖ መሰራት ከመቻሉ የተነሳ "ኢሉሚኔትድ ማኑስክሪፕትስ" በተባሉ መጻሕፍት ውስጥ በእጅ የተሳሉ ስዕሎች ላይ ለማስዋቢያነት የሚያገለግል ነበር።
translations.reference: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.hypothesis: It is made from a very thin sheet of metal, usually gold, and decorated with intricate designs. Because it can be made so thin, it was used to decorate the pages of illuminated manuscripts.

translations.source: ይህ የአንድ ኬሚካል ፒኤች ይባላል። የቀይ ጥቅል ጎመን ፈሳሽን ተጠቅመው ጠቋሚ መስራት ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
translations.hypothesis: This is called the pKa of that chemical. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.

translations.source: የጥቅል ጎመን ጁስ በኬሚካሉ አሲድነት ወይም ቤዝነት (አልካሊ) መሠረት ቀለም ይቀይራል።
translations.reference: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.hypothesis: The litmus juice turns red in the presence of an acid and blue in the presence of a base (alkali).

translations.source: በተሞከረው ኬሚካል ውስጥ ያለው የpH መጠን በሃይድሮጂን (H በ pH ውስጥ) አዮኖች መጠን ያመለክታል።
translations.reference: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.hypothesis: The pH of a chemical substance indicates the concentration of hydrogen (H+) ions in it.

translations.source: የሃይድሮጂን አዮኖች ኤሌክትሮኖቻቸው የተወሰደባቸው ፕሮቶኖች ናቸው (ስለዚህ የሃይድሮጂን አተሞች አንድ ፕሮቶን እና አንድ ኤሌክትሮን ይይዛሉ)።
translations.reference: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.hypothesis: Hydrogen ions are just protons that have lost their electrons (and so a hydrogen atom consists of one proton and one electron).

translations.source: ሁለቱን ደረቅ ዱቄቶች አንድ ላይ በመፈተግ፣ ከዚያም በንጹህ እርጥብ እጆች ወደ ኳስ ይጫኗቸው።
translations.reference: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
translations.hypothesis: Mix the two powders together, then add a little water and form into a ball.

translations.source: በእጆችዎ ላይ ያለው እርጥበታማነት ከውጭ ንብርብሮች ጋር ይጋጫል ፣ ይህም አስቂኝ ስሜት ያለው እና አንድ ዓይነት ዛጎል ይሠራል።
translations.reference: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.hypothesis: The wetness on your hands interacts with the outer layers, creating a fun sensation and a sort of stickiness.

translations.source: የሃራፓ እና ሞሄንጆ-ዳሮ ከተሞች በተራቀቀ የፍሳሽ ማስወገጃ ስርዓት የተያያዘው በእያንዳንዱ ቤት ውስጥ ፍላሽ ያለው መጸዳጃ ክፍል ነበራቸው።
translations.reference: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.hypothesis: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had advanced systems of sanitation with toilets in nearly every house connected to a covered brick-lined drain.

translations.source: የፍሳሽ ስርዓቱ ቅሪቶች በግሪክ ውስጥ በሚኖኣን ከተሞች ክሬቴ እና ሳንቶሪኒ ቤቶች ውስጥ ተገኝተዋል።
translations.reference: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.hypothesis: The earliest known examples of sewage systems can be found in the homes of the ancient Greek cities of Crete and Santorini.

translations.source: በጥንት ግብፅ ፣ በፋርስ እና በቻይና መፀዳጃ ቤቶችም ነበሩ። በሮማውያን ሥልጣኔ ውስጥ መጸዳጃ ቤቶች አንዳንድ ጊዜ ወንዶችና ሴቶች በተቀላቀሉበት አንድ ላይ በሚገኙባቸው የሕዝብ መታጠቢያ ቤቶች ውስጥ አንድ አካል ነበሩ።
translations.reference: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.hypothesis: Toilets also existed in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In ancient Rome, toilets were sometimes part of the public bathhouses, which were a social gathering place for men and women.

translations.source: በሺዎች በሚቆጠሩ ማይሎችን ርቆ ለሚኖር ሰው ሲደውሉ፣ ሳተላይትን እየተጠቀሙ ነው።
translations.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.hypothesis: When you call someone thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.

translations.source: በጠፈር ላይ ያለው ሳተላይት ጥሪውን ተቀብሎ በቅፅበት መልሶ ያንፀባርቃል።
translations.reference: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.hypothesis: The satellite in space receives the signal and immediately sends it back.

translations.source: ሳተላይቱ ወደ ጠፈር በሮኬት ተላከ። የምድር አየር አንዳንዶቹን ብርሃኖች እና እይታዎችን ስለሚቀይር ተመራማሪዎች ጠፈር ላይ ቴሌስኮፖችን ይጠቀማሉ።
translations.reference: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.hypothesis: The satellite was launched into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space to see things that the Earth's atmosphere distorts or blocks from view.

translations.source: በጠፈር ላይ ሳተላይት ወይም ቴሌስኮፕን ለማስገባት ከ 100 ጫማ ከፍታ በላይ ያለው አንድ ግዙፍ ሮኬት ያስፈልጋል።
translations.reference: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.hypothesis: A huge rocket is needed to put a satellite or telescope into orbit in space, at an altitude of more than 100 miles.

translations.source: መንኰራኩር ዓለምን በሚያስደንቅ ሁኔታ ለውጦታል። መንኮራኩሩ ለእኛ ያደረገው ትልቁ ነገር በጣም ቀላል እና ፈጣን መጓጓዣ ስለሰጠን ነው።
translations.reference: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.hypothesis: The wheel changed the world in a profound way. The most important thing the wheel has done for us is give us a means of transport that is both simple and fast.

translations.source: ባቡሩን ፣ መኪናውን እና ሌሎች ብዙ የትራንስፖርት መሳሪያዎችን አምጥቶልናል።
translations.reference: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.hypothesis: He took the train, the car, and many other forms of transportation.

translations.source: በእነሱ ሥር ከጥንቸል እስከ አጋዘን ያሉ መካከለኛ መጠን ያላቸው እንስሶችን የሚበሉ መካከለኛ መጠን ያላቸው ድመቶች አሉ።
translations.reference: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.hypothesis: There are also medium-sized carnivores that prey on medium-sized ungulates, such as pigs, deer, and antelopes.

translations.source: በመጨረሻም ፣ እንደ ነፍሳት ፣ አይጥ ፣ እንሽላሊቶች እና ወፎች ያሉ እጅግ በጣም ብዙ ትናንሽ እንስሳትን የሚበሉ ብዙ ትናንሽ ድመቶች አሉ (ልቅ የሆኑ የቤት እንስሳት ድመቶችን ጨምሮ)።
translations.reference: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, there are many species of small carnivores (including domestic dogs and cats) that prey on a wide range of small animals including birds, rodents and reptiles.

translations.source: የስኬታቸው ምስጢር የመስክ ጽንሰ ሃሳብ ነው፣ እያንዳንዱ ድመት ከሌላው ጋር እንዳይፎካከር የሚያደርገው ልዩ ሥራ ነው።
translations.reference: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.hypothesis: The key to their success is their field of expertise, each cat having a unique skill that they specialise in.

translations.source: አንበሶች መንጋዎች በሚባሉ ትላልቅ ቡድኖች የሚኖሩ፣ በጣም ማሕበራዊ ድመቶች ናቸው።
translations.reference: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.hypothesis: Lions are very social animals that live in big groups called prides.

translations.source: የአንበሳ መንጋዎች የሚመሰረቱት ከአንድ እስከ ሶስት ወጣት ወንዶች፣ ሰላሳ ከሚደርሱ ሴቶች እና ደቦሎች ነው።
translations.reference: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.hypothesis: Lion prides consist of one to three adult males, a harem of 30 or more females and their offspring.

translations.source: እንስቶቹ ብዙውን ጊዜ እርስ በእርሳቸው በጣም የተዛመዱ ናቸው ፣ ብዙ የእህቶች እና የሴቶች ልጆች ቤተሰቦች ናቸው።
translations.reference: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.hypothesis: The animals are often related, with many being family groups of mothers and their offspring.

translations.source: አንበሳ መናጋዎች እንደ ተኩላዎች ወይም ውሾች፣ እንደ አንበሳ ላሉ እንስሳዎች (ግን ሌሎች ትላልቅ ድመቶች አይደሉም) እና ለታዳኛቸው በጣም አደገኛ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.hypothesis: The lion's roar is like that of a hyena or a dog, but much louder, and is probably intended as a warning to trespassers.

translations.source: ነብሩ በደንብ ክብ ቅርጽ ያለው አትሌት፣ መውጣት የሚችል (ምንም እንኳን ጥሩ ባይሆንም) ፣ መዋኘት ፣ ብዙ ርቀቶችን መዝለል እና ከጠንካራ የሰው ኃይል አምስት እጥፍ ጋር መሳብ ይችላል።
translations.reference: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.hypothesis: The neighbor is a well-rounded athlete, capable of running (though not very fast), swimming, vaulting, jumping, and throwing with a force five times that of an average man.

translations.source: ነብር እንደ አንበሶች፣ ሌፐርድ እና ጃጓሮች አንድ ዓይነት ቡድን ውስጥ ነው (ጀነስ ፓንትራ)። ማጓራት የሚችሉት እነዚህ አራቱ ድመቶች ብቻ ናቸው።
translations.reference: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.hypothesis: Tigers are in the same genus (Panthera) as lions, leopards and jaguars. There are only four species of this genus that still exist.

translations.source: የነብር ጩኸት እንደ አንበሳ የሙሉ ድምፅ ጩኸት አይደለም፣ ግን የበለጠ እንደ አረፍተ ነገር ጫጫታ እና ጩኸት ቃላቶች ነው፡፡
translations.reference: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.hypothesis: The roar of a lion is not the full extent of its vocal repertoire, but also includes softer grunts and moans.

translations.source: ኦሴሎትስ/የበረሃ ድመቶች ትናንሽ እንስሳትን መብላት ይወዳሉ። ከቻሉ ዝንጀሮዎችን ፣ እባቦችን ፣ አይጥና ወፎችን ይይዛሉ። ኦሴሎትስ/የበረሃ ድመቶች የሚያድናቸው እንስሳት በሙሉ ማለት ይቻላል ከእነሱ እጅግ ያነሱ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.hypothesis: Ocelots like to eat small animals. If they can, they will catch monkeys, birds, rodents and snakes. All of the ocelot's prey are generally much smaller than the cat.

translations.source: የሳይንስ ሊቃውንት ኦሴሎትስ/የበረሃ ድመቶች በምድር ላይ ለነበሩበት ቦታ እየነፉ በማሽተት የሚመገቡትን (እንስሳትን) እንስሳት ተከትለው ያገኛሉ።
translations.reference: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists believe that the Ocelots/Puma followed their prey (the animals they hunted) into the Americas.

translations.source: በምሽት ዕይታ በደንብ ማየት ይችላሉ፣ እንዲሁም በጥሩ ሁኔታም መንቀሳቀስ ይችላሉ። ኦሴሎቶች ከአካባቢያቸው ጋር በመመሳሰል የሚታደኑ እንስሳዎችን ያገኛሉ።
translations.reference: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.hypothesis: You can see well in the dark, and you can move around well. Ocelots are ambush predators that hunt animals similar in size to themselves.

translations.source: አነስተኛ ህይወት ያላቸው ነገሮች (አነስተኛ ህዝብ ቁጥር) ከመጡበት ዋና ህዝብ ቁጥር (ለምሳሌ ተራራማ አካባቢ አልፈው ወይም ወንዝ አቋርጠው ወይም በቀላሉ መመለስ ወደ የማይችሉበት አዲስ ደሴት ከተጓዙ) ብዙ ጊዜ እራሳቸውን ከቀድሞው በፊት ከነበሩበት በተለየ አካባቢ ውስጥ ያገኛሉ፡፡
translations.reference: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.hypothesis: Small populations that become isolated (by, for example, moving to a new island or up a mountain, or just moving to a new area that they can't easily return from) may find themselves in a new area with no other members of their species.

translations.source: ይህ አዲስ አከባቢ የተለያዩ ሀብቶች እና የተለያዩ ተፎካካሪዎች አሉት፣ ስለሆነም አዲሱ ዝርያ ከዚህ በፊት ከሚያስፈልገው በላይ ጠንካራ ተፎካካሪ ለመሆን የተለያዩ ባህሪያትን ወይም ማስተካከያዎችን ይፈልጋል።
translations.reference: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.hypothesis: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new species needs different characteristics or adaptations to be a successful competitor.

translations.source: የመጀመሪያው ዝርያ በጭራሽ አልተለወጠም ፣ አሁንም እንደበፊቱ ተመሳሳይ ማመቻቸት ይፈልጋሉ።
translations.reference: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.hypothesis: The first generation never changed, still requiring the same accommodations.

translations.source: በጊዜ ሂደት፣ አዲሱ ህዝብ አዲሱን አካባቢውን መልመድ ሲጀምር፣ ከሌሎች ህዝቦች ጋር ያላቸው መመሳሰል እየቀነሰ ይሄዳል።
translations.reference: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.hypothesis: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to its new environment, the similarities between the populations will decrease.

translations.source: መጨረሻ ላይ፣ ከሺዎች ወይም ከሚሊዮን ዓመታት በኋላ፣ ሁለቱ ህዝቦች በመልክ በጣም ከመለያየታቸው የተነሳ አንድ ዓይነት ዝርያዎች መባል አይችሉም።
translations.reference: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.hypothesis: In the end, after thousands or millions of years, the two populations can no longer interbreed because they have changed so much.

translations.source: ይህንን ሂደት ስፔሺኤሽን እንለዋለን ፣ ይህም ማለት አዲስ ዘሮችን መስራት ማለት ነው። አዲስ ዘሮችን መስራት የማይቀር ውጤት እና የዝግመተ ለውጥ አስፈላጊ አካል ነው።
translations.reference: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.hypothesis: This process is called speciation, which means the formation of new species. The formation of new species is an inevitable consequence of genetic drift and an essential part of evolution.

translations.source: እጽዋት ሰዎች የሚተነፍሱትን ኦክስጅንን ይሠራሉ ፣ እንዲሁም ሰዎች የሚያወጡትን ካርቦን-ዳይኦክሳይድን ይወስዳሉ (ማለትም ወደ ውጭ የሚተነፈሰውን)።
translations.reference: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.hypothesis: Plants produce the oxygen that people breathe, and take in carbon dioxide that people breathe out.

translations.source: እፅዋት ከፀሀይ በብርሃን አስተፃምሮ ምግባቸውን ያዘጋጃሉ። ጥላም ያቀርባሉ።
translations.reference: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.hypothesis: Plants make their own food using sunlight. They also provide shade.

translations.source: ቤቶቻችንን ከእጽዋት እናደርጋለን እንዲሁም ከእጽዋት ልብሶችን እንሰራለን። የምንበላቸው አብዛኛዎቹ ምግቦች እፅዋቶች ናቸው። ያለ ዕፅዋት እንስሳት መኖር አይችሉም።
translations.reference: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.hypothesis: We build our homes with plants and make our clothes from plants. Most of the food we eat is from plants. Animals cannot live without plants.

translations.source: ሞዛሳሩስ የዘመኑ የአዳኞች ቁንጮ ነበር፣ ስለሆነም ከሌሎቹ ሞዛሳሩስ በስተቀር ምንም አይፈራም ነበር።
translations.reference: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.hypothesis: The Mosasaur was the top predator of its time, and thus had virtually no natural enemies other than other Mosasaurs.

translations.source: ረዣዥም መንገጭላዎቹ ከ 70 በላይ ምላጭ በሚስሉ ጥርሶቻቸው የታጠቁ ሲሆን በአፉ ጣራ ላይ አንድ ተጨማሪ ስብስብ ይዘው ነበር ፣ ይህም ማለት መንገዱን ለሚያልፍ ምንም ማምለጫ የለም ማለት ነው።
translations.reference: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.hypothesis: The long-necked giants were equipped with teeth up to 70 cm long, and a second set on the roof of their mouth, meaning there was no room for error when it came to chewing.

translations.source: በእርግጠኝነት አናውቅም ፣ ግን ሹካ የሆነ ምላስ ኖሮት ይሆናል። የእሱ ምግብ ኤሊዎችን ፣ ትልልቅ ዓሳዎችን ፣ ሌሎች ሞሳሶርስ ያካተተ ሲሆን ምናልባትም የራሱን ዘር በይ ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.hypothesis: We don't know for sure, but it probably had a long, sticky tongue. Its diet included eels, large fish, other mosasaurs, and possibly even their own kin.

translations.source: በውሃው ውስጥ የሚገባ ማንኛውንም ነገርም ያጠቃ ነበር፣ እንደ ቲ.ሬክስ ዓይነት ግዙፍ ዳይኖሰር እንኳን ለሱ አቻ ሊሆን አይችልም።
translations.reference: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.hypothesis: It would have eaten anything that got in the water, even a huge dinosaur like T. rex.

translations.source: አብዛኛውን ምግባቸውን የምናውቀው ቢሆንም ሮማውያን የዱር ከርከሮ፣ ጣዎስ፣ ቀንድ አውጣዎች እና ዶርማውስ የሚባል የአይጥ አይነትን ጨምሮ እንግዳ ወይም ያልተለመዱ የድግስ ምግቦች ነበሯቸው
translations.reference: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
