translations.hypothesis: While we know much of their diet, the Romans also had access to exotic or seasonal foods such as dormice, peacocks, flamingo, and a type of wild boar called a thrush.

translations.source: ሌላው ልዩነት ደግሞ ድሆቹ እና ሴቶቹ ወንበሮች ላይ ተቀምጠው ምግብ ሲመገቡ፣ ሀብታሞቹ ምግባቸውን በሚመገቡበት ጊዜ በጎን በኩል አብረው የሚዝናኑበት ትልቅ ድግስ ማድረግ ይወዳሉ።
translations.reference: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.hypothesis: Another difference is that the poor and women prefer to sit on the floor while the rich prefer to sit on chairs and enjoy their food while they sit around a large table.

translations.source: የጥንት የሮማኖች ምግቦች በኋለኞቹ መቶ ዘመናት ከአሜሪካ ወይም ከእስያ ወደ አውሮፓ የመጡ ምግቦችን ማካተት አልቻሉም።
translations.reference: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The diet of the ancient Romans was limited to the foods available in Europe, while the later centuries saw the introduction of new foods from the Americas and Asia.

translations.source: ለምሳሌ፣ በቆሎ አልነበራቸውም፣ ቲማቲም፣ ድንች፣ ወይም ኮኮዋም ቢሆን አልነበራቸውም እናም አንድም የቱርክ ዶሮ የቀመሰ የጥንት ሮማዊ የለም።
translations.reference: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.hypothesis: For example, they didn't have wheat, tomatoes, potatoes, or chocolate and no one in ancient Rome ever ate a turkey.

translations.source: ባቢሎናውያን ለእያንዳንዳቸው አማልክቶቻቸው የአማልክት ቤት ተደርጎ የሚወሰድ ዋና ቤተመቅደስ ሠሩላቸው።
translations.reference: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.hypothesis: The Babylonians built ziggurats, which were temple towers dedicated to their respective gods.

translations.source: ሰዎች ለአማልክት መስዋእት ያቅርቡ ነበር እናም ካህናቱ በክብረ በዓላት እና በበዓላት አማካይነት ለአማልክቶች ፍላጎቶች ለመከታተል ይሞክሩ ነበር።
translations.reference: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.hypothesis: People would offer sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to interpret the will of the gods through oracles and divination.

translations.source: እያንዳንዱ ቤተ መቅደስ ክፍት የሆነ የቤተመቅደስ ግቢ እና ካህናቱ ብቻ መግባት የሚችሉበት የውስጥ መቅደስ ነበረው።
translations.reference: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.hypothesis: Each temple had an open-air courtyard and an inner sanctum where only priests could go.

translations.source: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ልዩ የፒራሚድ ቅርፅ ያላቸው፣ ዚጉራትስ የሚባሉ ማማዎች የመቅደሶቹ አካል እንዲሆኑ ይገነቡ ነበር።
translations.reference: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes they were built with a special pyramidal shape, called ziggurats, and were part of the temple complex.

translations.source: የግንቡ አናት ለአምላኩ ልዩ መቅደስ ነበር።
translations.reference: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.hypothesis: The top of the ziggurat was a special shrine to the god.

translations.source: በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ሞቃት የአየር ፀባይ፣ ቤቱ ብዙም አስፈላጊ አልነበረም።
translations.reference: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.hypothesis: In the Middle East's hot climate, the house was too hot to live in.

translations.source: አብዛኛው የዕብራውያን ቤተሰብ ሕይወት የሚመራው ከቤት ውጪ ላይ ነበር።
translations.reference: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the life of the Jewish people was lived outside of the Land of Israel.

translations.source: ሴቶች በጓሮው ውስጥ ምግብ ያበስላሉ፤ መደብሮች ወደ ጎዳና የሚመለከቱ ክፍት መሸጫ ጠረጴዛዎች ነበሩ። ድንጋይ፣ ቤቶችን ለመገንባት ያገለግል ነበር።
translations.reference: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.hypothesis: Women were preparing food in the yard, and shops were open-air tables facing the street. Stone was used for building, and the walls were built with a minimum of mortar.

translations.source: በከነዓን ምድር ውስጥ ትላልቅ ደኖች አልነበሩም፣ ስለሆነም እንጨት እጅግ በጣም ውድ ነበር።
translations.reference: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.hypothesis: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was very precious.

translations.source: ግሪንላንድ ተበትኖ ነበር የሰፈረው። በኖርስ ሳጋስ እንደሚናገሩት ከሆነ ኤሪክ ዘ ሬድ በግድያ ወንጀል ከአይስላንድ በግዞት ተሰደደ እናም ወደ ምዕራብ አቅጣጫ ሲጓዝ ግሪንላንድን አገኛት እና ግሪንላንድ ብሎ ሰየማት።
translations.reference: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.hypothesis: It was settled by the Norse. According to the Norse sagas, Eric the Red was exiled from Iceland for manslaughter and, while sailing west in search of new lands, he found and named Greenland.

translations.source: ግን የእሱ ግኝት ምንም ይሁን ምን፣ የኤስኪሞ ጎሳዎች በወቅቱ እዚያ ይኖሩ ነበር።
translations.reference: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.hypothesis: But whatever his discovery, the Eskimo tribes inhabited the area at the time.

translations.source: እያንዳንዱ ሃገር “ስካንዲኔቪያዊ” የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በዴንማርክ፣ ስዊድን፣ ኖርዌይ እና አይስላንድ ሰዎች፣ ነገስታት፣ ልማዶች እና ታሪክ መካከል ብዙ ልዩነቶች ነበሩ።
translations.reference: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.hypothesis: While every country was "Scandinavian", there were many differences between the people, the rulers, the customs and the history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.

translations.source: ናሽናል ትሬዠር የሚለውን ፊልም ካዩት፣ በነፃነት አዋጁ ጀርባ የሀብት ካርታ እንደተፃፈ ሊያስቡ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.hypothesis: If you have seen the movie National Treasure, you may think of a map that leads to a hidden treasure.

translations.source: ሆኖም፣ ያ እውነት አይደለም። በሰነዱ ጀርባ ላይ የተጻፈ ነገር ቢኖርም፣ ይህ የ ሀብት ካርታ አይደለም።
translations.reference: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.hypothesis: However, that's not entirely true. While there's a paper trail to follow, this is not a straightforward case of resource mapping.

translations.source: በነጻነት መግለጫ ጀርባ ላይ የተፃፉት “የነፃነት መግለጫ የመጀመሪያ ቀን ጁላይ 4 ቀን 1776” የሚሉ ቃላት ነበሩ። ጽሑፉ በሰነዱ ታችኛው ክፍል ላይ ተገልብጦ ይታያል።
translations.reference: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.hypothesis: The words "The first day of the independence of the United States of America was the fourth day of July, 1776" were written on the back of the Declaration of Independence. The text is displayed upside down at the bottom of the document.

translations.source: ማን እንደፃፈው ማንም በእርግጠኝነት ባያውቅም፣ በህይወቱ መጀመሪያ ላይ፣ ትልቁ የብራና ሰነድ (29¾ ኢንች በ 24½ ኢንች ይለካል) ለመቀመጥ ተጠቅልሏል።
translations.reference: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.hypothesis: While it is not known for sure who the author was, in his early life, the largest known copy (measuring 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was used as a lap desk.

translations.source: ስለዚህ ፣ ማስታወሻው እንደ መለያ ብቻ የታከለ ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.hypothesis: So, the note could be considered a form of ID.

translations.source: የዲ-ቀን ማረፊያዎች እና የሚከተሉት ውጊያዎች ሰሜን ፈረንሳይን ነፃ ያወጡ ነበር ፣ ሆኖም ግን ደቡብ አሁንም ነፃ አልወጣም ነበር።
translations.reference: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.hypothesis: The D-Day landings and subsequent battles liberated most of Northern France, but Southern France was still under German control.

translations.source: የሚተዳደረው በ “ቪቺ” ፈረንሳዮች ነበር። እነዚህ በ 1940 ከጀርመኖች ጋር ሰላም የፈጠሩ እና እነሱን ከመዋጋት ይልቅ ከወራሪዎች ጋር አብረው የሠሩ የፈረንሣይ ሰዎች ነበሩ።
translations.reference: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.hypothesis: It was run by the Vichy French. These were French people who made a deal with the Germans in 1940 and worked for the invaders rather than fight them.

translations.source: ኦገስት 15 ቀን 1940 አሊያንስ ደቡባዊ ፈረንሳይን ወረሩ ፣ ወረራው “ኦፕሬሽን ድራጎን” ተባለ።
translations.reference: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.hypothesis: On August 15, 1940, the Allies launched an attack on Southern France, known as "Operation Dragoon".

translations.source: በሁለት ሳምንታት ውስጥ ብቻ አሜሪካውያኖቹ እና ነፃ የፈረንሳይ ኃይሎች ደቡብ ፈረንሳይን ነፃ አውጥተው ወደ ጀርመን እየተመለሱ ነበር።
translations.reference: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.hypothesis: Within two weeks, the Americans and Free French forces had liberated Southern France and were pushing back into Germany.

translations.source: ስልጣኔ ተባብረው በሚኖሩ እና በሚሰሩ ሰፊ ህዝቦች፣ ማሕበረሰብ የሚጋራ ነጠላ ባሕል ነው።
translations.reference: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.hypothesis: A culture is the shared values, beliefs, and norms of a group of people who live and work together.

translations.source: ሲቪላይዜሽን የሚለው ቃል የመጣው ከሲቪሊስ ሲሆን፣ ሲቪል ማለት ነው፣ ከላቲን ሲቪስ ጋር ሲገናኝ፣ ይህ ደግሞ ዜጋ ማለት ነው፣ እንዲሁም ሲቪታስ ማለት ከተማ ወይም የከተማ መስተዳድር ማለት ሲሆን ይህም በሆነ መልኩ የሕብረተሰቡን መጠን ይገልፃል።
translations.reference: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.hypothesis: The word civilization comes from the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, which roughly indicates the size of the population.

translations.source: የከተማ-ግዛቶች የሃገሮች ቀደምቶች ናቸው። የሥልጣኔ ባህል በበርካታ ትውልዶች ውስጥ የእውቀት ማስተላለፍን የሚያመለክት ነው ፣ ዘላቂ የባህል አሻራ እና ፍትሃዊ ስርጭትን።
translations.reference: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.hypothesis: City-States are the ancestors of modern nation-states. A culture of craftsmanship denotes the transmission of knowledge over generations, resulting in a legacy of cultural identity and fair distribution.

translations.source: አናሳ ባህሎች ብዙውን ጊዜ ጠቃሚ ታሪካዊ ማስረጃን ሳይተዉ ይጠፋሉ እናም እንደ መደበኛ ሥልጣኔ ዕውቅና አያገኙም።
translations.reference: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.hypothesis: Minor cultures often disappear without leaving any material traces and are not even recognized as distinct from the dominant culture.

translations.source: በአብዮታዊ ጦርነት ወቅት አሥራ ሦስቱ ግዛቶች በመጀመሪያ ደካማ ማዕከላዊ መንግሥት አቋቋሙ-ኮንግረሱ ብቸኛ አካል ሆኗቸው ማለት ነው - በኮንፌዴሬሽን አንቀጾች መሠረት።
translations.reference: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.hypothesis: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen colonies established a weak central government—the Congress was the only body that could make laws—based on the Articles of Confederation.

translations.source: ምክር ቤቱ ግብር ለመጣል ስልጣን አልነበረውም፣ እና ምንም ብሔራዊ አስፈፃሚ ወይም ፍርድ ቤት ስለሌለ፣ ብዙውን ጊዜ ሁሉንም ህጎቹን ለማስፈፀም በማይተባበሩ የግዛት አመራሮች ይተማመን ነበር።
translations.reference: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.hypothesis: The Council had no power to tax, and in the absence of a national executive or court system, it often relied on state officials to enforce its laws.

translations.source: እንዲሁም በክልሎች መካከል የግብር ህጎችን እና ታሪፎችን የመሻር ስልጣን አልነበረውም።
translations.reference: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.hypothesis: It also did not have the power to overrule tax laws and tariffs between regions.

translations.source: አንቀጾቹ ከመጽደቃቸው በፊት ከሁሉም ክልሎች አንድላይ ፈቃድ ያስፈላጋቸዋል እና ክልሎቹ መዓከላዊ መንግስቱን በትክክል ካልመውሰዳቸው የተነሳ ተወካዮቻቸው በአብዛኛው ቀሪ ነበሩ።
translations.reference: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.hypothesis: The articles require the consent of all regions and, given the regions' reluctance to cede sovereignty to the central government, their representatives voted against the resolution.

translations.source: የጣሊያን ብሔራዊ እግር ኳስ ከጀርመን ብሄራዊ ቡድን ጋር በመቀጠል በዓለም ላይ በጣም ስኬታማ ቡድን ሲሆን በ 2006 የፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫ ሻምፒዮን ነበሩ።
translations.reference: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.hypothesis: The Italy national football team is the second most successful national team in the world, after the German national team, and they were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.

translations.source: ታዋቂ ስፖርቶች እግር ኳስ፣ ቅርጫት ኳስ፣ መረብ ኳስ፣ ውሃ-ፖሎ፣ የጎራዴ ጨዋታ፣ ራግቢ፣ ሳይክል መንዳት፣ የበረዶ ሆኪ፣ ሮለር ሆኪ እና ኤፍ1 የሞተር ውድድርን ያካትታሉ።
translations.reference: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.hypothesis: Popular sports include soccer, basketball, baseball, water-polo, golf, rugby, cycling, ice-hockey, roller-hockey and F1 motor racing.

translations.source: ጣልያኖች በአለም አቀፋዊ ጨዋታዎች እና የኦሎምፒኮች ላይ እየተወዳደሩ ፣ የክረምት ስፖርቶች በጣም የሚታወቁት በሰሜናዊ አካባቢዎች ነው።
translations.reference: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.hypothesis: While Italians compete in world games and Olympics, the most popular winter sport is skiing, mostly done in the Northern regions.

translations.source: ጃፓኖች ወደ 7,000 የሚጠጉ ደሴቶችን የያዙ (ትልቁ ደግሞ ሆንሹ ይባላል) ሲሆን ጃፓንን በዓለም 7 ኛ ትልቋ ደሴት ያደርጋታል!
translations.reference: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.hypothesis: The Japanese hold about 7,000 islands (the largest of which is called Honshu) that make Japan the 7th largest island in the world!

translations.source: ጃፓን ባላት የደሴቶች ስብስብ/ቡድን ምክንያት ጃፓን ብዙውን ጊዜ በጂኦግራፊያዊ አነጋገር "አርኪፔላጎ" ተብላ ትጠራለች
translations.reference: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.hypothesis: Japan is often referred to as an archipelago because of its many islands.

translations.source: ታይዋን የጀመረው በ 15 ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ነበር፣ የአውሮፓ መርከበኞች የሚያልፉ ጊዜ የደሴቷን ኢልሃ ፎርሞሳ ወይም ውብ ደሴት ብለው ሰየሟት።
translations.reference: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.hypothesis: Taiwan was first visited by Europeans in the 15th century, when Portuguese sailors called it Ilha Formosa or Beautiful Island.

translations.source: በ1624፣ ደች ምስራቅ ህንድ ኩባንያ በደቡባዊ ታይዋን የአገሬዎች የእህል አመራረት ልምዶች ላይ ለውጥን በማነሳሳትና በስኳር እና ሩዝ ፋብሪካዎቹ ውስጥ እንዲሰሩ ቻይናዊ የቀን ሰራተኞችን በመቅጠር መሰረቱን መስርቷል።
translations.reference: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.hypothesis: In 1624, the Dutch East India Company established a trading post in southern Taiwan and hired Chinese labourers to work in its sugar and rice plantations, sparking a wave of emigration from Fujian.

translations.source: በ 1683 የቺንግ ሥርወ-መንግሥት (1644-1912) ኃይሎች የታይዋን ምዕራባዊ እና ሰሜናዊ የባህር ዳርቻ አካባቢዎችን ተቆጣጥረው ታይዋንን በ 1885 የቺንግ ኢምፓየር አውራጃ መሆኗን አወጁ።
translations.reference: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.hypothesis: In 1683, the Qing Dynasty (1644–1912) forces conquered the western and northern parts of Taiwan and declared Taiwan as a prefecture of the Qing Empire in 1885.

translations.source: በ 1895 የመጀመሪያው የቻይና-ጃፓን ጦርነት (1894-1895) ከተሸነፈ በኋላ የቺንግ መንግስት የሺሞኖስኪን ስምምነት በመፈረም በታይዋን ላይ ሉዓላዊነትን ለጃፓን ያስረከበ ሲሆን ደሴቲቱ እስከ 1945 ድረስ ተቆጣጠራለች።
translations.reference: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.hypothesis: After losing the First Sino-Japanese War (1894–1895), the Qing government ceded Taiwan to Japan in the Treaty of Shimonoseki, and the island remained under Japanese control until 1945.

translations.source: ማቹ ፒቹ ኢንትኋታና፣ የጸሐይ ቤተ መቅደስ እና ሶስት መስታወት ያለው ክፍል ተብለው የሚጠሩ ሶስት ዋና አወቃቀሮችን ያካትታል።
translations.reference: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.hypothesis: It includes three main structures: Machu Picchu Temple of the Sun, also known as the Intihuatana, and the Room of the Three Windows.

translations.source: ቱሪስቶች መጀመሪያ እንዴት እንደመጡ የተሻለ ግንዛቤ እንዲኖራቸው ለማድረግ በግቢው ውስጥ የሚገኙት አብዛኛዎቹ ሕንፃዎች እንደገና ተገንብተዋል።
translations.reference: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the buildings on the site have been rebuilt to give visitors a better idea of what the place was like when the first Europeans arrived.

translations.source: በ1976 የማቹ ፒቹ ሰላሳ ፐርሰንት ተመልሶ ነበር እናም የመልሶ ግንባታ ሥራው እስካሁን ይቀጥላል።
translations.reference: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.hypothesis: In 1976, Machu Picchu was 30 percent recovered and the reconstruction work continues to this day.

translations.source: ለምሳሌ ፣ በዓለም ላይ በጣም የተለመደው አሁንም የምስል ፎቶግራፍ ቅርጸት 35 ሚሜ ነው፣ ይህ በአናሎግ የፊልም ዘመን ማብቂያ ላይ ዋነኛው የፊልም መጠን የነበረ ነው።
translations.reference: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.hypothesis: For example, the most common film format in the world is still 35 mm, which was the standard film size at the end of the analog era.

translations.source: ዛሬ ድረስ ይመረታል ነገር ግን ምጥጥነ ዕይታው በዲጂታል ካሜራዎች ምስል ዳሳሽ ቅርጸቶች ተወርሷል።
translations.reference: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.hypothesis: It is still used today, but the viewfinder has been replaced by a digital camera sensor.

translations.source: የ 35 ሚሜ ቅርፀት በእውነቱ በተወሰነ መልኩ ግራ የሚያጋባ፣ 36 ሚሜ ስፋት በ 24 ሚሜ ቁመት ያለው ነበር።
translations.reference: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.hypothesis: The 35 mm format was in fact a compromise, the 36 by 24 mm negative being a standard size.

translations.source: የዚህ ቅርጸት ምጥጥነ ገጽታ (በጣም ቀላሉን አጠቃላይ የቁጥር ሬሾ ለማግኘት በአስራ ሁለት በመክፈል) 3:2 ነው ይባላል።
translations.reference: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.hypothesis: The aspect ratio of this format (the ratio of its width to its height, expressed as a simple fraction) is called 3:2.

translations.source: ብዙ የተለመዱ ቅርፀቶች (ለምሳሌ የ APS ቅርጸቶች ቤተሰብ) የዚህ ገጽታ ጥምርታ እኩል ወይም በጣም ቅርብ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.hypothesis: Many common formats (e.g. the family of APS formats) are more or less equivalent in this regard.

translations.source: የተንገላታው እና የሚሳቅበት የሦስተኛ ወገን ደንብ በምስሉ ላይ የተወሰነ ደረጃን ጠብቆ በሚቆይበት ጊዜ ተለዋዋጭነትን ለመፍጠር ቀላል መመሪያ ነው።
translations.reference: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.hypothesis: The Rule of Thirds is a simple guideline for creating balance in your image while keeping the eye moving around the photo.

translations.source: ለዋናው ጉዳይ በጣም ውጤታማው ቦታ ምስሉን ወደላይ እና በአግድመት ወደ ሦስት በሚያካፍሉ የመስመሮች መቆራረጫ ላይ አንደሆነ ይናገራል (ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ)።
translations.reference: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.hypothesis: He says the best place for the main subject is on the top half of the frame and slightly to one side (see example).

translations.source: በዚህ በአውሮፓ ታሪክ ጊዜ ውስጥ ሃብታም እና ባለስልጣን የሆነው የካቶሊክ ቤተክርስቲያን ምርመራ ውስጥ ገባ።
translations.reference: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.hypothesis: In this period of European history, the Catholic Church was the richest and most powerful institution.

translations.source: ከአንድ ሺህ ለሚበልጡ ዓመታት የክርስትና ሃይማኖት የቋንቋና የባህል ልዩነቶች ቢኖሩም የአውሮፓን ግዛቶች አንድ ላይ አቆራኝቷል። እኔ
translations.reference: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
translations.hypothesis: For more than a thousand years, the common Christian faith has helped to bind together the nations of Europe, despite their many cultural and linguistic differences.

translations.source: ሁሉን አጥፊ የሆነው ኃይሉ ከሊቅ እስከ ደቂቅ ሁሉንም የሚነካ ነው።
translations.reference: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
translations.hypothesis: Its all-encompassing nature affects the rich and the poor, the young and the old.

translations.source: ከዋና ዋና ክርስቲያናዊ መሠረተ ሐሳቦች አንዱ ሀብትን መከራን እና ድህነትን ለማቃለል ጥቅም ላይ መዋል አለበት የሚለው ሲሆን የቤተ ክርስቲያኒቱ የገንዘብ ፈንድ በተለየ ለዚህ ምክንያት የተመደበ ነው።
translations.reference: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.hypothesis: One of the main Christian values is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty, and the church's investment fund has a specific mandate for this purpose.

translations.source: የቤተክርስቲያኑ መካከለኛው ባለሥልጣን ከአንድ ሺህ ዓመታት በላይ በሮም ውስጥ ነበር እናም ይህ የኃይል እና የገንዘብ ክምችት ብዙዎች መሠረታዊ የመመሪያ እምነቱ እየተሞላ እንደሆነ እንዲጠይቁ አድርጓቸዋል።
translations.reference: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.hypothesis: The church's central authority has been in Rome for over a thousand years and this accumulation of power and wealth has led many to question the sincerity of its core beliefs.

translations.source: ጠብ ከተነሳ ብዙም ሳይቆይ ብሪታንያ የጀርመንን ባህር ኃይል ማገድ ጀመረች።
translations.reference: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.hypothesis: Shortly after, Britain began to impose a naval blockade on Germany.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን ይህ እገታ ባለፉት ሁለት ምዕተ ዓመታት በበርካታ ዓለም አቀፍ ስምምነቶች የተቀናጀ በአጠቃላይ ተቀባይነት ያገኘ ዓለም አቀፍ ሕግን የጣሰ ቢሆንም ፣ አስፈላጊው ወታደራዊ እና ሲቪል አቅርቦቶችን በመቁረጥ ስልቱ ውጤታማ ሆኗል።
translations.reference: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the fact that this restriction has been enshrined in international law through a number of international conventions over the last two centuries, the tactic has proven effective in bringing about the isolation of the targeted military and civilian supplies.

translations.source: የብሪታንያ ማንኛውም መርከብ በሰፋፊ የውሃ ክፍሎች ላይ እንዳያልፉ ለማድረግ ዓለም አቀፍ ውሃ አካላትን በቦምብ ጠመደች፣ ይህም ለገለልተኛ መርከቦች እንኳን ሳይቀር አደጋ ነበረው።
translations.reference: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
translations.hypothesis: The Royal Navy patrolled the world's oceans to ensure that no ship flew the British flag in foreign waters, even though it was a risk to neutral ships.

translations.source: ለዘዴው የተወሰነ መልስ ብቻ ስለነበር ጀርመን ላልተገደበው የሰርጎገብ መርከብ ጦርነት ተመሳሳይ ጠብቃ ነበር።
translations.reference: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.hypothesis: Germany was similarly restricted by the Treaty of Versailles from having a large navy.

translations.source: በ1920ዎቹ፣ የብዙ ዜጎች እና ሃገራት የጎላው ፀባይ ፀረ ጦርነት እና ብቸኝነት ነበር።
translations.reference: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1920s, the overwhelming mood of many citizens and countries was isolationism and pacifism.

translations.source: በአንደኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወቅት የጦርነትን አስከፊ እና ጭካኔ ከተመለከቱ በኋላ፣ ሃገሮች ለወደፊቱ እንዲህ ዓይነቱን ሁኔታ እንደገና ለማስወገድ ፈለጉ።
translations.reference: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
translations.hypothesis: After witnessing the horrors and follies of war during World War I, countries sought to prevent such an experience from recurring.

translations.source: በ 1884 ቴስላ በኒው ዮርክ ሲቲ ውስጥ በኤዲሰን ኩባንያ ውስጥ ሥራ ለመቀበል ወደ አሜሪካ ተዛወረ።
translations.reference: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.hypothesis: In 1884 Tesla emigrated to the United States to take up a position at Edison's company in New York City.

translations.source: በስሙ 4 ሳንቲም፣ የግጥም መፅሐፍ እና ከቻርልስ ባችለር (የቀድሞ ስራው ኃላፊ) ለቶማስ ኤዲሰን የምስጋና ደብዳቤ ይዞ ዩኤስ ውስጥ ገባ።
translations.reference: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: For four cents he bought a newspaper and a book of poems, and with a letter of introduction to Thomas A. Edison from Charles Batchelor (a former employer) he set off for the United States.

translations.source: ጥንታዊ ቻይና የተለያዩ የጊዜ ወቅቶችን የማሳያ ልዩ መንገድ አለው፣ ሁሉም የቻይና ደረጃ ወይም ሁልም በሥልጣን ላይ የነበረ ቤተሰብ በግልጽ የሚለይ ሥርወ መንግሥት ነበረው።
translations.reference: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: Ancient China had a unique way of marking different time periods, with each Chinese dynasty or era that was ruled by a particular family having its own distinct style.

translations.source: እናም በእንያንዳንዱ ስርወ-መንግስት መካከል የተከፋፈሉ ክፍልሃገራት ያልተረጋጋ ዘመን ነበር። በእነዚህ ጊዜያት ይበልጥ የሚታወቀው በሃን እና ጂን ስርወ-መንግስት መካከል ለ60 ዓመታት የተካሄደው የሶስት ግዛቶች ዘመን ነበር።
translations.reference: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: It was a time of great upheaval between the ruling houses. The most well known of these was the Three Kingdoms period that lasted for 60 years between the Han and Jin dynasties.

translations.source: በእነዚህ ጊዜያት ለዙፋኑ በሚታገሉ በብዙ መኳንንት መካከል ከባድ ጦርነት ተካሂዷል።
translations.reference: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.hypothesis: There was a great battle between many lords who fought for the crown at this time.

translations.source: ሦስቱ መንግስታት በጥንታዊ ቻይና ታሪክ ውስጥ በደም የተሞላ ጊዜ ነበር፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በዢያን ቤተ መንግሥት በከፍተኛው ወንበር ላይ ለመቀመጥ ሲታገሉ ተዋግተው ሞቱ።
translations.reference: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.hypothesis: The three kingdoms was a bloody time in Chinese history, with thousands fighting and dying to sit on the Dragon Throne.

translations.source: እንደ የሜትሪክ ስርዓት አጠቃቀም፣ ከእውነተኝነት ወደ ህዝባዊነት መቀየር፣ ብሔራዊነት እና አገሪቱ የህዝቡ እንጂ የአንድ ብቸኛ ገዢ አለመሆኗን ያሉ በርካታ ማህበራዊ እና ፖለቲካዊ ተፅእኖዎች አሉ፡፡
translations.reference: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.hypothesis: There are many social and political implications, such as the use of the metric system, the shift from aristocratic to democratic societies, secularism, and the concept of the nation-state, in which the nation is seen as the source of political power rather than a single ruler.

translations.source: እንዲሁም ከአብዮቱ በኋላ እጅግ ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት ያላቸው እና ስኬታማ እንዲሆኑ የሚያስችሏቸው ሙያዎች ለሁሉም ወንድ አመልካቾች ክፍት ነበሩ።
translations.reference: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.hypothesis: There were also open admissions for all male applicants to careers in demand after the revolution and which would help them to be successful.

translations.source: ያው ለወታደሩም ተመሳሳይ ነው፣ ምክንያቱም በሠራዊት ደረጃ አሰጣጥ በክፍል ላይ ከመመስረት ይልቅ አሁን በካይላይበር ላይ ተመስርተው ነበር።
translations.reference: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.hypothesis: The same goes for the soldiers, as their army was based on cavalry rather than infantry.

translations.source: የፈረንሣይ አብዮት የሌሎች ብዙ አገራት በጫና ውስጥ ያሉ የሰራተኛው መደብ ሰዎች የራሳቸውን ዐመፅ እንዲጀምሩ አነሳስቷቸዋል።
translations.reference: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
translations.hypothesis: The French Revolution had also inspired many other working class people in other countries to start their own revolutions.

translations.source: መሐመድ ከዚህ ተራ ከሆነ ሕይወት ባሻገር ባሉ ጉዳዮች ላይ ጥልቅ ፍላጎት ነበረው። ለማሰላሰል በ “ኑር” (ብርሃን) ተራራ “ሂራ’ ”በመባል የሚታወቀው ዋሻ ላይ መሄድ ያዘወትር ነበር።
translations.reference: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.hypothesis: Muhammad was interested in philosophy and theology from a young age. He would often go to a cave on Mount Hira, known as the Cave of Contemplation, to meditate.

translations.source: ከዘመኑ የተረፈው ዋሻው ራሱ, የመሐመድን መንፈሳዊ ዝንባሌዎች በጣም ግልፅ የሆነ ምስል ይሰጣል።
translations.reference: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.hypothesis: The cave itself, a remnant of the time before the modern mosque, gives a sense of the mystical atmosphere that surrounds the Prophet's spiritual home.

translations.source: ከመካ በስተሰሜን በአንዱ ተራሮች አናት ላይ ማረፉ፣ ዋሻው ሙሉ በሙሉ ከሌላው ዓለም እንዲገለል አድርጓል።
translations.reference: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
translations.hypothesis: Perched atop one of the cliffs at the northern end of the gorge, the monastery is dramatically isolated from the rest of the world.

translations.source: በእውነቱ ፣ አንድ ሰው መኖሩን ቢያውቅም በጭራሽ ማግኘቱን ቀላል አይደለም። አንዴ ወደ ዋሻው ውስጥ ከገባ በኋላ አጠቃላይ መገለል ነው።
translations.reference: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.hypothesis: In fact, it is not easy to find, even if you know where the person is. Once you are in the tunnel, it is a complete sensory deprivation.

translations.source: ከብዙዎቹ ተራሮች ዙሪያ ካለው ግልጽ፣ ውብ ሰማይ በስተቀር ምንም አይታይም። ከዋሻው ውስጥ ማየት ወይም መስማት የሚቻለው የዚህን ዓለም በጣም ትንሽ የሆነውን ክፍል ነው።
translations.reference: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.hypothesis: Nothing much can be seen except the clear, dark sky all around the many mountains. The only things that can be seen or heard are the smallest parts of this universe.

translations.source: በጊዛ የሚገኘው ታላቁ ፒራሚድ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ቆሞ ያለ ከሰባቱ አስደናቂ ነገሮች ብቸኛው ነው።
translations.reference: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World still standing.

translations.source: በሦስተኛው ክፍለ ዘመን BCE በግብፃውያን የተገነባው ታላቁ ፒራሚድ፣ የሞተውን ፈርዖንን ለማክበር ከተገነቡ በርካታ ትላልቅ የፒራሚድ ሕንፃዎች አንዱ ነው።
translations.reference: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid, built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, is one of the largest of the many royal tombs and pyramids built to honor the dead pharaohs.

translations.source: በግብጽ የሙታን ሸለቆ ውስጥ የሚገኘው “ጊዛ ፕላቱ” ወይም “ጊዛ ነክሮፖሊስ” በርካታ ፒራሚዶችን ይዟል (ከእነዚህም ውስጥ ትልቁ ፒራሚድ ትልቁ ነው) ፣ በርካታ ትናንሽ መቃብሮች ፣ በርካታ ቤተመቅደሶች እና ታላቁ እስፊንክስ ይገኙበታል።
translations.reference: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
translations.hypothesis: The "Giza Plateau" or "Giza Necropolis", located in the Egyptian necropolis of Giza, contains a group of Old Kingdom pyramids (the largest of which is the Great Pyramid) and several smaller pyramids, several mastabas, a few ruined temples, and the Great Sphinx.

translations.source: ታላቁ ፒራሚድ የተሠራ ፈርዖን ክሁፉን ለማክበር ነበር እና አብዛኛዎቹ ትንንሽ ፒራሚዶች፣ መቃብሮች እና ቤተ መቅደሶች የተሠሩት የክሁፉን ሚስቶች እና ቤተሰቦች ለማክበር ነበር።
translations.reference: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid was built to honor the pharoah and most of the smaller pyramids, tombs and temples were built to honor the pharoah's family and wives.

translations.source: “የላይ እጥፋት” ምልክት V ይመስላል እና “የታች እጥፋት ምልክት” የስቴፕለር ሽቦ ወይም ታችኛው ክፍሉን ያጣ ካሬ ይመስላል።
translations.reference: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
translations.hypothesis: The "upstroke" of the V-shape looks like a regular V and the "downstroke" looks like a staple or a bracket with the bottom part missing.

translations.source: ወደላይ ማለት ጫፉ ላይ በመጀመር ቀስቱን መግፋት አለብዎት ማለት ሲሆን ወደታች ማለት ደግሞ ከእንቁራሪቱ መጀመር አለብዎት ማለት ነው (ይህም እጅዎ ቀስቱን የያዘበት ቦታ ነው) እና ቀስቱን ይሳቡ።
translations.reference: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
translations.hypothesis: Up means you have to push the stick up and down means you have to pull the stick down (this is where your hand is holding the stick) and up again.

translations.source: የላይኛው-ምት ብዙውን ጊዜ ለስላሳ ድምፅ ያመነጫል ፣ የታችኛው-ምት ግን የበለጠ ጠንካራ እና የበለጠ አረጋጋጭ ነው።
translations.reference: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
translations.hypothesis: The upper-midrange produces a sound that is often described as smooth, while the lower-midrange is more powerful and assertive.

translations.source: የራስዎን ውጤት በእርሳስ ምልክት ማድረግ ይችላሉ፣ ነገር ግን የታተሙ ቦዊንግ ምልክቶች የተቀመጡት ለሙዚቃ ምክንያቶች ስለሆነም እነሱ መከበር አለባቸው።
translations.reference: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
translations.hypothesis: You can mark your own results, but the published Bowing scores are considered the official results because they are the basis for music awards.

translations.source: በጣም የተደናገጠው ንጉስ ሉዊስ 16 ኛ፣ ንግስት ማሪ አንቶይኔቴ ንግስት ማሪ አንቶይንትቴ ሁለቱ ትናንሽ ልጆቻቸው (የ 11 ዓመቷ ማሪ እሴይ እና የአራት ዓመቷ ሉዊ-ቻርለስ) እና የንጉሱ እህት ማዳም ኤልዛቤት በኦክቶበር 6 ቀን 1789፣ በተቆጣው የገበያ ሴቶች ስብስብ ከቬርሳይ ወደ ፓሪስ እንዲመለሱ ተገደዱ።
translations.reference: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
translations.hypothesis: The King, Louis XVI, his wife Queen Marie Antoinette, their two children (11-year-old Marie Thérèse and four-year-old Louis-Charles), and the King's sister, Madame Elisabeth, were forced to leave Versailles and return to Paris on October 6, 1789, under the protection of a large group of armed market women.

translations.source: በንጉሱ እና በንግሥቲቱ ላይ ጩኸት እና ማስፈራሪያ በሚያሰሙ ብዙ ሰዎች ተከበው ወደ ፓሪስ ተመልሰዋል።
translations.reference: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
translations.hypothesis: They returned to Paris, where they were met by large crowds of people who shouted and jeered at the King and Queen.

translations.source: ለአመጽ የተሰባሰቡ ሰዎች የንጉሱን እና ንግሥቲቱን የሰረገላ መስኮቶች በስፋት እንዲከፍቱ አስገደዷቸው፡፡
translations.reference: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
translations.hypothesis: The mob forced the King and Queen to appear at the windows of the palace.

translations.source: በአንድ ወቅት አንድ የስብስብ ቡድን አባል በተደናገጠችው ንግሥት ፊት በቬርሳይለስ ላይ የተገደለውን የንጉሣዊ ዘበኛ ጭንቅላት እያውለበለበ ነበር።
translations.reference: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
translations.hypothesis: Once, a member of the King's band was killed by a stray musket ball while marching in the parade at Versailles.

translations.source: የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ኢምፔሪያሊዝም የጦርነቱንየወጪ ለፊሊፒንስ ሰዎች ከፍለዋል።
translations.reference: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
translations.hypothesis: The cost of the war was paid for by the Filipino people through American imperialism.

translations.source: በፊሊፒንስ መንግሥት ስም አየር ላይ ያለ ወጪዎች እና የቦንድ ወለድ በዋልስትሪት ባንኮች በኩል ለዩ.ኤስ ገዢ ሃይል ለመክፈል ተስማሙ።
translations.reference: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
translations.hypothesis: The Philippines government agreed to pay the cost of the debt and interest on the bonds through the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).

translations.source: በእርግጥ፣ የተራዘመ የፊሊፒንስን ሕዝብ ብዝበዛ ከተመሠረቱት እጅግ አትራፊዎች ለአሜሪካ ኢምፔሪያሊዝም መሠረታዊ ጥቅሞችን ያስገኛሉ።
translations.reference: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
translations.hypothesis: Of course, the extended Filipino population provides America with a key demographic advantage for American imperialism.

translations.source: ቴምፕላሮችን ለመረዳት አንድ ሰው የሃይማኖት ቡድኑን መፈጠር ያነሳሳውን ሁኔታ መገንዘብ አለበት።
translations.reference: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
translations.hypothesis: To understand the Templars, one must understand the circumstances that led to the formation of the religious order.

translations.source: ክንዋኔዎቹ የተከሰቱበት ጊዜ ከፍተኛ መካከለኛው ዘመን በመባል ይታወቃል በአውሮፓ ታሪክ ውስጥ 11ኛው፣ 12ኛው እና 13ኛው ክፍለዘመናት (AD 1000–1300)።
translations.reference: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
translations.hypothesis: The period in which these events took place is known as the High Middle Ages, a period in European history from around 1000 to 1300 AD.

translations.source: ከፍተኛዎቹ መካከለኛ ዘመኖች በመጀመሪያዎቹ የመካከለኛው ዘመኖች ይቀደማሉ እናም በመጨረሻዎቹ መካከለኛ ዘመኖች ይከተላሉ ይህም በስምምነት 1500 ላይ ያበቃል።
translations.reference: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
translations.hypothesis: The High Middle Ages follow the Early Middle Ages and are succeeded by the Late Middle Ages which end around 1500.

translations.source: የቴክኖሎጂ ቁርጠኝነት በተግባር በርካታ ሀሳቦችን የሚያካትት፣ ከቴክኖሎጂ-ግፊት ወይም ከቴክኖሎጂ አስፈላጊነት ወደ የሰው ልጅ እጣ ፈንታ ከሳይንሳዊ ህጎች እና በቴክኖሎጂው መገለጥ ጋር የተዛመደ መሰረታዊ አመክንዮ የሚመነጭ እንደሆነ ወደ ማሰብ ያደላ ጠንካራ ስሜት።
translations.reference: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
translations.hypothesis: Technological determinism is the belief that technology is the primary driver of social change, and that the development of new technologies inevitably leads to the transformation of human society.

translations.source: አብዛኛዎቹ የቴክኖሎጂ ቆራጥነት ትርጓሜዎች ሁለት አጠቃላይ ሀሳቦችን ይጋራሉ፥ የቴክኖሎጂ እድገት ራሱ ከባህላዊ ወይም ከፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ባሻገር እጅግ በጣም ብዙ መንገድን እንደሚከተል ፣ እና ቴክኖሎጂ በበኩሉ ከማህበራዊ ሁኔታ ይልቅ በተፈጥሯቸው ባሉ ህብረተሰቦች ላይ “ተጽዕኖዎች” አለው።
translations.reference: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
translations.hypothesis: Most definitions of technological determinism share two general ideas: that technological development follows its own momentum, independent of social or political influence, and that technology, in turn, has an effect on society, sometimes described as "shaping" societies.

translations.source: ለምሳሌ፣ የሞተር መኪና በግድ ወደ መንገድ ልማት ይመራል ሊባል ይችላል፡፡
translations.reference: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
translations.hypothesis: For example, it can be said that the motor car has led to the development of roads.

translations.source: ነገር ግን ለትንሽ መኪኖች ሀገር አቀፍ የመንገድ አውታረመረብ በኢኮኖሚ አያስኬድም ስለዚህ የመኪና ባለቤትነት ዋጋን ለመቀነስ አዳዲስ የማምረቻ ዘዴዎች ተመሥርተዋል።
translations.reference: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
translations.hypothesis: However, a country-wide road network for small cars is not economically feasible, so new production methods have been developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.

translations.source: የብዙ መኪና ባለቤት መሆን እንዲሁ በመንገድ ላይ ከፍተኛ የአደጋ አጋጣሚዎችን ያስከትላል፤ ይህም ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን አካላት ለመጠገን አዳዲስ ቴክኒኮችን ወደ መፍጠር ያመራል።
translations.reference: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
translations.hypothesis: The rise of car ownership has also led to more accidents on the road, which in turn has led to the development of new technologies aimed at mitigating the effects of accidents.

translations.source: ሮማንቲሲዝም እንደ ጎተ ፣ ፍቼ እና ሽጌል ካሉ ፀሐፊዎች የተገኘ የባህል ቁርጠኝነት ትልቅ አካል ነበረው።
translations.reference: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
translations.hypothesis: Romanticism was also a reaction to the Enlightenment, with writers such as Rousseau, Goethe, and Schiller championing emotion and individualism.

translations.source: በሮማንቲሲዝም አውድ ውስጥ፣ የጂኦግራፊ ግለሰቦችን ቀርጾ እናም ከጊዜ በኋላ ጂኦግራፊ ጋር የተዛመዱ ባሕሎች እና ከህብረተሰቡ ቦታ ጋር የሚስማሙ በዘፈቀደ ህጎች ከማድረግ የተሻሉ ነበሩ።
translations.reference: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
translations.hypothesis: In the context of Romanticism, the landscape was seen as formative for individuals and as a repository of cultural values and a sense of place that had been lost through modernization.

translations.source: ፓሪስ የዘመናዊው ዓለም የፋሽን ዋና ከተማ እንደምትባለው ሁላ፣ ኮንስታንቲኖፕል የፊውዳል አውሮፓ የፋሽን ዋና ከተማ ይባል ነበር።
translations.reference: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
translations.hypothesis: While Paris is considered the fashion capital of the modern world, Constantinople was the fashion capital of the medieval world.

translations.source: የቅንጦት ዋና መዓከል የመሆኑ ዝና በ400 ኤ.ዲ ላይ ጀምሮ እስከ 1100 ኤ.ዲ ድረስ ቆየ።
translations.reference: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
translations.hypothesis: Its reputation as a luxurious resort lasted from about 400 AD to 1100 AD.

translations.source: በዐሥራ ሁለተኛው ክፍለ ዘመን በዋነኝነት ክርስቲያናዊ ጦርነት ተዋጊዎች እንደ ሃር እና ቅመም ያሉ ከባይዛንታይን ገበያ ከሚያቀርባቸው በላይ ዋጋ የተሰጣቸው ስጦታዎችን ይዘው በመመለሳቸው ሁኔታው ዝቅ አለ።
translations.reference: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
translations.hypothesis: The situation deteriorated in the 12th century when Christian crusaders returning from the Byzantine Empire brought with them gifts such as furs and spices that were more highly valued than the goods the Byzantines offered.

translations.source: በዚህ ጊዜ ነበር የፋሽን ዋና ከተማ የሚለው ርዕስ ከኮንስታንቲኖፕል ወደ ፓሪስ የተላለፈው።
translations.reference: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
translations.hypothesis: It was at this time that the title of fashion capital passed from Constantinople to Paris.

translations.source: ጎቲክ ቅርጽ በ10ኛው እና በ11ኛው ከፍለ ዘመኖች መካከል እና በ14ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ከፍተኛ ሆኖ ነበር።
translations.reference: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
translations.hypothesis: The Gothic style flourished in the 10th and 11th centuries and again in the 14th.

translations.source: መጀመሪያ ላይ፣ ቀሚስ በምሥራቅ በባይዛንታይን ባህል ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ አሳድሯል።
translations.reference: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, the tunic was influenced by the Byzantine culture of the East.

translations.source: ሆኖም፣ በአዝጋሚ የግንኙነት መንገዶች ምክንያት በምእራብ በኩል ያሉ የኑሮ ዘይቤዎች ከ 25 እስከ 30 ዓመት ሊዘገዩ ይችላሉ፡፡
translations.reference: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
translations.hypothesis: However, because of the time difference, lifestyles in the West can be delayed by 25 to 30 years.

translations.source: በመካከለኛው ዘመን መጨረሻ አካባቢ ምዕራብ አውሮፓ የራሳቸውን የአለባበስ ዘዴ መፍጠር ጀመሩ። በጦርነቶቹ ምክንያት ከጊዜው ትልቆቹ ዕድገቶች አንዱ ሰዎች ልብሳቸውን ለመዝጋት ቁልፍ መጠቀም መጀመራቸው ነበር።
translations.reference: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
translations.hypothesis: Around the end of the Middle Ages, Western Europe began developing its own fashion. One of the biggest developments of the time was the beginning of people using keys to lock their clothes.

translations.source: መቆያ ግብርና ማለት ገበሬውን እሱን እና ቤተሰቡን ብቻ ሊጠቅም የሚችል ምርት ሲኖረው ማለት ነው።
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
translations.hypothesis: Subsistence farming is when a farmer only produces enough food to feed their family.

translations.source: የራስን ኑሮ ለመምራት የሚደረግ እርሻ ቀላል ፣ ብዙውን ጊዜ ኦርጋኒክ ፣ ለሥነ-ምህዳሩ ተወላጅ የሆነውን የተቀመጠ ዘርን በመጠቀም ምርትን ከፍ ለማድረግ ከሰብል ማሽከርከር ወይም ከሌሎች በአንፃራዊነት ቀላል ቴክኒኮች ጋር በማቀላቀል የሚደረግ ቀላል ስርዓት ነው።
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
translations.hypothesis: Permaculture is a simple system that uses the natural biodiversity of local ecosystems to increase production by combining crops and other relatively easy techniques such as crop rotation.

translations.source: በታሪክ አብዛኛዎቹ አርሶ አደሮች ከእጅ ወደ አፍ ግብርና ውስጥ ተሰማርተው ይኖሩ የነበረ ሲሆን ይህ በብዙ ታዳጊ ሀገሮች ውስጥ አሁንም እንደዚያው ነው።
translations.reference: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
translations.hypothesis: Historically most farmers have been engaged in subsistence agriculture, and this is still the case in many developing countries.

translations.source: ንዑስ ባህላት በማሕበራዊ ደረጃዎች እንደተገለሉ የሚሰማቸውን አንድ ዓይነት አስተሳሰብ ያላቸው ግለሰቦች አንድ ላይ አምጥቶ የማንነት ስሜት እንዲያዳብሩ ያስችላቸዋል።
translations.reference: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
translations.hypothesis: Subcultures can provide individuals with a sense of belonging and identity, as they are groups of people with shared beliefs and values that are different from the mainstream culture.

translations.source: የአባላቱ ዕድሜ፣ ብሔር፣ ክፍል፣ ቦታ፣ እና/ወይም ጾታ በመከተል ውስጠ ባህላት ልዩ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.hypothesis: The age, race, class, gender, and/or ethnicity of members may be specified.

translations.source: አንድን ንዑስ ባህል ልዩ የሚያደርጉት ባህሪዎች የቋንቋ፣ የስነ ውበት፣ የሃይማኖት፣ የፖለቲካ፣ የጾታዊ፣ የመልካ ምድራዊ ወይም የእነዚህ ቅልቅል ምክንያቶች ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
translations.hypothesis: The characteristics that make a subculture unique can include language, style, religion, politics, sexual interests, geographical location or a combination of these factors.

translations.source: የአንድ ንዑስ ባህል አባላት ብዙውን ጊዜ ፋሽንን ፣ አሰራሮችን እና አርጎትን ያካተተ ልዩ እና ምሳሌያዊ በሆነ የአጻጻፍ ዘይቤ አባልነታቸውን ያመለክታሉ።
translations.reference: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
translations.hypothesis: Members of a subculture often use a distinctive and symbolic style of dress, including particular fashions, hairstyles and argot to identify themselves to other members of the subculture.

translations.source: የማህበራዊ ሕይወትን አስፈላጊነት ለማስረዳት ከምንጠቀምባቸው በጣም የተለመዱ መንገዶች ውስጥ አንዱ፣ በመጥፎ ሁኔታዎች፣ በበደል፣ ወይም በመከራ ውስጥ ያደጉ፣ በአሳዳጊዮቻቸው አብሮ መኖርን ያልተማሩ ሕፃናትን በማየት ነው።
translations.reference: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
translations.hypothesis: One of the most common ways we explain the importance of social life is by looking at children who grow up in deprived conditions, abuse, or extreme poverty, and who have not learned how to get along with their peers.

translations.source: እንደነዚህ ያሉት ልጆች "ፌራል" ወይም ስዶች ይባላሉ። አንዳንድ ስድ ልጆች በሰዎች ተዘግቶባቸዋል (ብዙውን ጊዜ የራሳቸው ወላጆች)፤ በአንዳንድ ሁኔታዎች ይህ ልጅ መተው ወላጆቹ የልጁን ከባድ የአእምሮ ወይም የአካል እክል ባለመቀበላቸው ነው።
translations.reference: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
translations.hypothesis: Such children are referred to as “feral” or “wild”. Some feral children have been raised by other humans (often their own parents); in some cases this is because the parents are unable to care for a child with severe mental or physical disabilities.

translations.source: የተጣሉ ልጆች ከመጣላቸው ወይም ከመሸሻቸው በፊት ከባድ የልጆች ጥቃት ወይም የስሜት ቀውስ አጋጥሟቸው ይሆናል።
translations.reference: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
translations.hypothesis: Children who run away or are abducted may have previously suffered severe physical or emotional abuse.

translations.source: ሌሎች በእንስሳት ያደጉ ናቸው ተብሎ ይታሰባል፣ አንዳንዶቹ በጫካ ውስጥ ብቻቸውን እንደኖሩ ይነገራል።
translations.reference: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
translations.hypothesis: Others are said to have been raised by animals, some even raised by wolves in the wild.

translations.source: የሰው-ልጅ ባልሆኑ እንስሳት ሙሉ በሙሉ ሲያድጉ ፣ የዱር ልጅ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንደ ልዩ እንሰሳት የመሰሉ ባህሪያትን ያሳያል (ለምሳሌ በሰው ልጆች ላይ ፍርሃት ወይም ግዴለሽነት)።
translations.reference: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
translations.hypothesis: While the human infant is totally dependent, the human child quickly develops a full range of species-typical behaviors (e.g., the fear or disgust reactions).

translations.source: በፕሮጀክት ላይ የተመሠረተ ትምህርት መማርን ቀላል እና ሳቢ ማድረግ ቢያስፈልግም ፣ ስካፎልዲንግ ግን አንድ እርምጃ ቀድሞ ይሄዳል።
translations.reference: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
translations.hypothesis: While project-based learning makes learning more practical and engaging, scaffolding takes it a step further.

translations.source: ስካፍፎልዲንግ የመማር ዘዴ አይደለም፣ ነገር ግን አዲስ የመማር ሂደት የሚጀምሩ ለምሳሌ አዲስ የኮምፒውተር ፕሮግራም ለሚጠቀሙ ወይም አዲስ ፕሮጀክት ለሚጀምሩ ግለሰቦችን የሚረዳ ድጋፍ ነው።
translations.reference: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
translations.hypothesis: Scaffolding is not a teaching method in itself, but rather a support that helps individuals who are starting to learn a new skill or process, such as using a new computer program or starting a new project.

translations.source: ማጠቃለያ ምናባዊም እውነተኛም ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ በሌላ አገላለጽ አስተማሪ ልክ ማይክሮሶፍት ኦፊስ ላይ ወረቀት እንደሚያያይዝ ትንሹ ሰው አንድ የማጠቃለያ መንገድ ነው፡፡
translations.reference: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
translations.hypothesis: Summary Can be real or imagined In other words, a summary is just a shorter version of the original text, like a shorter version of a newspaper article.

translations.source: ቨርቹዋል ስካፎልዶች በሶፍትዌሩ ውስጥ ያሉ ናቸው እናም ተማሪው ብቻውን እንዲይዝ ፈታኝ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ አሰራሮችን ለመጠየቅ ፣ ሊመረምር እና ሂደቶቹን ለማብራራት የታሰበ ነው።
translations.reference: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.hypothesis: Virtual Scaffolds are embedded in the software and are designed to challenge the learner to explore and discover processes and explain them.

translations.source: ትኩረት ባለማግኘት፣ በጥቃት እና አልፎ ተርፎም እስከ ስርቆት ድረስ ባሉ የተለያዩ ምክንያቶች ልጆች በማደጎ እንክብካቤ ውስጥ ይቀመጣሉ።
translations.reference: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
translations.hypothesis: Children in institutional care are more likely to be subject to various forms of abuse, including physical, psychological and sexual abuse, and exploitation.

translations.source: የትኛውም ልጅ እንክብካቤ የሌለበት፣ አሳቢ፣ እና አስተማሪ ያልሆነ አካባቢ ውስጥ ማደግ የለበትም፣ ነገር ግን ማደጋቸው አይቀርም።
translations.reference: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
translations.hypothesis: No child should have to grow up in an environment that is unsafe, unstable, and devoid of love and nurturing, but all children can be resilient.

translations.source: እኛ የማደጎ እንክብካቤ ሥርዓትን ለነዚህ ልጆች የደኅንነት ቀጠና አድርገን እናየዋለን።
translations.reference: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
translations.hypothesis: We see the foster care system as a safety net for these children.

translations.source: የእኛ የማሳደጊያ እንክብካቤ ስርዓት ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ ቤቶችን ፣ አፍቃሪ ተንከባካቢዎችን ፣ የተረጋጋ ትምህርት እና አስተማማኝ የጤና እንክብካቤን ይሰጣል ተብሎ ይታሰባል።
translations.reference: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
translations.hypothesis: Our foster care system is thought of as providing safe homes, loving foster parents, a stable education, and reliable medical care.

translations.source: የአሳዳጊዎች እንክብካቤ ከዚህ ቀደም በተወሰዱበት ቤት ውስጥ የጎደላቸውን ሁሉንም አስፈላጊ ነገሮች ይሰጣል ተብሎ ይታሰባል።
translations.reference: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
translations.hypothesis: Foster care is considered to provide all the necessary elements that a child may be missing in their biological home.

translations.source: በይነመረብ የግዝፈት እና የሁለት ሰዎች ግንኙነት ባህሪያትን ያዋህዳል።
translations.reference: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
translations.hypothesis: Internet combines the networking and communication features.

translations.source: የአጠቃቀም እና እርካታ አቀራረብን በተመለከተ የበይነመረብ ልዩ ባህሪዎች ወደ ተጨማሪ ልኬቶች ይመራሉ።
translations.reference: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
translations.hypothesis: The use and satisfaction survey approach leads to more dimensions than the Internet special feature survey.

translations.source: ለምሳሌ ፣ “መማር” እና “ማህበራዊነት” ለበይነመረብ አገልግሎት እንደ ወሳኝ አነሳሺዎች ሆነው ተጠቁሟል (James et al., 1995)።
translations.reference: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
translations.hypothesis: For example, “learning” and “socializing” were cited as important motivators for Internet use (James et al., 1995).

translations.source: በተጨማሪም “የግል ተሳትፎ” እና “ቀጣይ ግንኙነቶች” በኢጊሜ እና ማኮርድ (1998) የድርጣቢያዎች የታዳሚዎች ምላሾችን ሲመረምሩ እንደ አዲስ ተነሳሽነት ገጽታዎች ተለይተዋል።
translations.reference: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
translations.hypothesis: In addition, “personal involvement” and “ongoing communication” were identified as key aspects of effective initiatives by Eames and MacDormand (1998) when exploring the responses of website visitors.

translations.source: የቪዲዮ ቀረፃ በጥቂት ሚሊ ሰከንዶች የሚቆይ ጥቃቅን መግለጫዎችን፣ የፊት እንቅስቃሴዎችን ለመተርጎም ወደ አስፈላጊ ግኝቶች መርተዋል።
translations.reference: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
translations.hypothesis: Video recording led to the discovery of micro-expressions, fleeting facial expressions that give away one's true feelings.

translations.source: በተለይም፣ አንድ ሰው ጥቃቅን-አገላለጾችን በትክክል በመተርጎም አንድ ሰው መዋሸት አለመዋሸቱን ማረጋገጥ ይችላል ተብሎ ይታመናል።
translations.reference: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
translations.hypothesis: In particular, it is thought that one can tell whether a person is lying or not by correctly interpreting micro-expressions.

translations.source: ኦሊቨር ሳክስ ፣ የፕሬዚዳንቱ ንግግር የሚለውን ፅሁፋቸው ውስጥ በአንጎል ጉዳት ምክንያት ንግግርን ለመረዳት የማይችሉ ሰዎች እንዴት ቅንነትን በትክክል መገምገም እንደቻሉ አመልክቷል።
translations.reference: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
translations.hypothesis: In his article, The President's Speech, Oliver Sacks described how people with brain damage affecting speech comprehension can nonetheless often make accurate judgments of sincerity.

translations.source: የሰው ባሕሪ የመለየት እንደዚህ ዓይነት ችሎታዎች እንደ ለማዳ ውሾች ባሉ እንሰሳትም ሊጋሩ እንደሚችሉ ጠቅሷል።
translations.reference: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
translations.hypothesis: He pointed out that the ability to recognize patterns is not unique to humans and is shared by other animals, such as dogs.

translations.source: በሃያኛው ክፍለ ዘመን የተደረገው ጥናት የዘረመል ልዩነት ሁለት ገንዳዎች እንዳሉ ያሳያል-የተደበቁ እና የተገለጹ።
translations.reference: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.hypothesis: Studies in the 20th century showed that racial classifications were based on two dimensions: visible and phenotypic.

translations.source: ሚውቴሽን አዲስ የዘረመል ልዩነትን ይጨምራል ፣ እናም ምርጫው ከተገለፀው የልዩነት ገንዳ ውስጥ ያስወግደዋል።
translations.reference: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
translations.hypothesis: Mutation adds new genetic variants, and selection eliminates the unfit variants.

translations.source: በሁለቱ ገንዳዎች መካከል ከእያንዳንዱ ትውልድ ጋር የመለያየት እና ዳግም ውህደት የውዝግብ ልዩነት።
translations.reference: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.hypothesis: The difference in opinion between the two pools with each generation.

translations.source: በሣቫና ውስጥ ፣ የሰው ልጆች ዓይነት የምግብ መፈጨት ሥርዓት ላላቸው ሰብአስተኔዎች እዛው በሚገኙ የእጽዋት የምግብ ምንጮች የአሚኖ አሲድን ፍላጎቶችን ለማርካት አስቸጋሪ ነው።
translations.reference: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
translations.hypothesis: In the Savannah, the human digestive system's ability to obtain amino acids from the available plant foods is insufficient to meet the body's needs.

translations.source: በተጨማሪ ይህንን ማድረግ አለመቻል ከባድ ውጤቶች አሉት፡ የመንፈስ ጭንቀት፣ የተመጣጠነ ምግብ እጥረት፣ እናም በስተመጨረሻ ሞት።
translations.reference: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
translations.hypothesis: Failure to do so can have grave consequences: depression, malnutrition and ultimately death.

translations.source: በጣም በቀላሉ ተደራሽ የሆኑት የእፅዋት ሀብቶች በቅጠሎች እና በጥራጥሬዎች ውስጥ የሚገኙ ፕሮቲኖች ሊሆኑ ይችሉ ነበር ፣ ግን እነዚህ እንደ እኛ ላሉት አጥቢዎች ካልተበሰሉ በስተቀር ለመፍጨት ከባድ ናቸው።
translations.reference: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
translations.hypothesis: The most easily available plant foods are the proteins found in leaves and stems, but these are difficult to digest unless the plants are cooked.

translations.source: በአንፃሩ፣ የእንስሳት ምግቦች (ጉንዳኖች፣ ምስጦች፣ እንቁላሎች) በቀላሉ የሚታኘኩ ሆነው ሁሉንም አስፈላጊ አሚኖ አሲዶችን ያካተቱ ፕሮቲኖችን በከፍተኛ መጠን ያቀርባሉ።
translations.reference: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
translations.hypothesis: In contrast, animal-based foods (meat, fish, eggs) provide high quality protein that is easily digested and contains all the essential amino acids.

translations.source: ሁሉም ነገሮች ከግምት ውስጥ ገብተው ፣ የራሳችን ቅድመ አያቶች በሳቫና ላይ ያሉ ቺምፖች በዛሬው ጊዜ እንደሚያደርጉት በተወሰነ መልኩ“ የፕሮቲን ችግራቸውን ”ቢፈቱ ሊደንቀን አይገባም።
translations.reference: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
translations.hypothesis: All things considered, our own ancestors probably shouldn't be that surprised at how chimpanzees today solve their "protein problem" on the savanna.

translations.source: የእንቅልፍ መቋረጥ በመደበኛ የእንቅልፍ ጊዜዎ ውስጥ አውቀው የመንቃት እና ከትንሽ ጊዜ በኋላ (10–60 ደቂቃዎች) መልሶ የመተኛት ሂደት ነው።
translations.reference: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
translations.hypothesis: Sleepwalking is a state in which you are normally aroused during your sleep and then re-enter sleep after a short time (10–60 minutes).

translations.source: ሙሉ በሙሉ ከእንቅልፍዎ ሳይነቁ ወደ ህሊናዎ ለማምጣት በአንጻራዊነት ጸጥ ያለ የደወል ሰዓት በመጠቀም ይህ በቀላሉ ሊከናወን ይችላል።
translations.reference: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
translations.hypothesis: This can easily be accomplished by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to rouse you from your sleep.

translations.source: በእንቅልፍዎ ውስጥ ሰዓቱን እንደገና ሲያስተካክሉ ካዩ ፣ ለማጥፋትት ከአልጋዎ እንዲወጡ በክፍሉ ተቃራኒ ሊቀመጥ ይችላል።
translations.reference: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.hypothesis: If you find yourself checking the time in the middle of the night, it may be best to sit away from the bed in the room to avoid winding up.

translations.source: ሌሎች ባዮሪትም የተመሰረቱ አማራጮች ከእንቅልፍዎ በፊት ብዙ ፈሳሽ (በተለይም ውሃ ወይም ሻይ፣ የታወቀ ዲዩሪቲክ) መጠጣት ያካትታል፣ አንድ ሰው ለሽንት ከእንቅልፍ እንዲነሳ ያስገድደዋል።
translations.reference: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
translations.hypothesis: Other biological rhythms include the need to drink fluids (especially water or tea, a known diuretic) before going to bed, which forces the person to urinate during the night.

translations.source: አንድ ሰው ያለው ውስጣዊ ሰላም በአንድ አካል እና መንፈስ ውስጥ ካለው ውጥረት መጠን በተቃራኒው ይዛመዳል።
translations.reference: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
translations.hypothesis: A person’s inner peace is directly related to the degree of congruence between their ideal and actual self.

translations.source: ውጥረቱ ዝቅተኛ በሆነ ቁጥር ፣ የሕይወት ኃይል የበለጠ አዎንታዊ ይሆናል። እያንዳንዱ ሰው ፍጹም ሰላምን እና እርካታን የማግኘት አቅም አለው።
translations.reference: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
translations.hypothesis: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force. Every human being has the potential to experience perfect peace and happiness.

translations.source: ሁሉም ሰው ዕውቀትን ማግኘት ይችላል። በመንገዱ ላይ የቆመው ብቸኛ ነገር የራሳችን ጭንቀት እና አሉታዊነት ነው።
translations.reference: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
translations.hypothesis: Knowledge is power and everyone should have access to it. The only thing that stands in the way of us attaining knowledge is our own limiting beliefs and negative attitude.

translations.source: የቲቤት ቡድሂዝም በቡድሃ ትምህርቶች ላይ የተመሠረተ ነው ፣ ግን በማሃያና የፍቅር መንገድ እና ከህንድ ዮጋ በብዙ ቴክኒኮች የተራዘመ ነው።
translations.reference: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
translations.hypothesis: Tibetan Buddhism is based on the Buddhist teachings, but has also been influenced by the Mahayana and Vajrayana schools of India and by tantric yoga.

translations.source: በመርህ ደረጃ፤ የቲቤታን ቡዲዝም በጣም ቀላል ነው። ኩንዳሊኒ ዮጋ፣ መመሰጥ እና ሁሉን-አቃፊ የፍቅር ጉዞን ያካትታል።
translations.reference: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
translations.hypothesis: In principle, Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It involves Kundalini Yoga, meditation and a love-based journey to enlightenment.

translations.source: በኩንዳሊኒ ዮጋ የኩንዳሊኒ ኃይል (የማወቅ ኃይል) በዮጋ አቋሞች፣ የአተነፋፈስ እንቅስቃሴዎች ፣ ማንትራስ እና በዕይታዎች ይነቃቃል።
translations.reference: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
translations.hypothesis: In Kundalini Yoga, Kundalini energy (the energy of consciousness) is awakened through a combination of yoga postures, breathing techniques, mantras and visualizations.

translations.source: የቲቤት የማሰላሰል ማዕከል የመለኮት ዮጋ ነው። በተለያዩ የአማልክት ተመስጦ አማካኝነት፣ የኃይል ሰርጦቹ ይጸዳሉ፣ ቻካራዎች ይንቀሳቀሳሉ፣ እና የእውቀት ብርሃን ህሊና ይፈጠራል።
translations.reference: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
translations.hypothesis: The Tibetan Buddhist concept of enlightenment is that of a yogi. Through various deity visualisations, the energy channels are purified, the chakras opened, and the light of wisdom dawns in consciousness.

translations.source: በ 2 ኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ጀርመን በ USSR እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ትብብር በመፍጠር የጋራ ጠላት ነበረች። ጦርነቱ ሲያበቃ የሥርዓት ፣ የሂደት እና የባህል ግጭቶች አገራት ወደ ወድቀት እንዲመሩ አድርጓቸዋል።
translations.reference: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
translations.hypothesis: Germany had a common enemy in the USSR and the United States after World War II. The war left countries with political, economic, and cultural issues that led to their decline.

translations.source: ጦርነቱ ሊያበቃ ሁለት ዓመታት ሲቀሩት የቀድሞ አጋሮች አሁን ጠላት ስለነበሩ የቀዝቃዛው ጦርነት ተጀመረ።
translations.reference: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
translations.hypothesis: A cold war began, with former allies now hostile, as the two-year anniversary of the war approached.

translations.source: ለቀጣዮቹ 40 ዓመታት የሚቆይ ነበር እናም ከአፍሪካ እስከ እስያ፣ በአፍጋኒስታን፣ ኩባ እና ሌሎች በርካታ ቦታዎች ባሉ የጦርነት ሜዳዎች በእውን ውጊያው ይካሄድ ነበር።
translations.reference: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
translations.hypothesis: It would last for the next 40 years and be fought in battlefields from Africa to Asia, including in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.

translations.source: በሴፕቴምበር 17፣ 1939 የፖላንድ መከላከያ ተሰብሮ ነበር እናም የነበረው ብቸኛ ተስፋ ማፈግፈግ እና በሮማዊይንን የጦር አቋም ጋር ድጋሚ መደራጀት ነው።
translations.reference: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
translations.hypothesis: On September 17, 1939, Poland's defenses were finally broken and the only hope remaining was to appeal to the Allies and to reorganize the army.

translations.source: ነገር ግን፣ ከሶቪዬት ህብረት ቀይ የጦር ኃይል 800,000 ወታደሮች ሪጋ የሰላም ውል፣ የሶቪዬት-ፖሊሽ ፀረ-ጠብ ስምምነት፣ እና ሌሎች የሁለት እና የብዙ ሃገራት አለምዓቀፍ ውሎችን በመጣስ የፖላንድን ምስራቃዊ ክልሎች ከወረሩ በኋላ ገብተው ቤላሩሲያዊ እና ዩክሬናዊ ግንባሮችን ሲፈጥሩ እነዚህ ዕቅዶች በአንድ ሌሊት ከሸፉ።
translations.reference: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
translations.hypothesis: But those plans were overtaken by events during the night of August 23, when 800,000 Soviet troops invaded the eastern regions of Poland, violating the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, the Riga Peace Treaty, and other international agreements between the two countries, and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts.

translations.source: መርከቦችን መጠቀም ዕቃዎችን ማመላለስ፤ በርካታ ሰዎችን እና ዕቃዎችን በውቅያኖስ ለማጓጓዝ እስካሁን ካሉት ሁሉ በጣም የተሻለ ፍቱን መንገድ ነው።
translations.reference: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
translations.hypothesis: The use of ships for the transportation of goods is the most efficient way to move large quantities of goods and people over long distances across the oceans.

translations.source: የባሕር ኃይሎች የተለምዶ ሥራ የእርስዎ ሀገር ሰዎች እና ዕቃዎችን የማዘዋወር አቅሟን እንደምትጠብቅ ማረጋገጥ እና በዛው የእርስዎን ጠላት ሰዎችን እና ዕቃዎችን የማዘዋወር አቅምን ማስተጓጎል ነው።
translations.reference: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
translations.hypothesis: Naval operations involve the use of ships and aircraft to project a country's power and influence over the sea and its adjacent waters.

translations.source: ሊጻፍ የሚገባው ከዚህ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምሳሌዎች ውስጥ አንዱ የሰሜን አትላንቲክ የሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ዘመቻ ነው። አሜሪካኖቹ ብሪታንያን ለመርዳት ሰዎችን እና ዕቃዎችን በአትላንቲክ ውቅያኖስ ለማዘዋወር እየሞከሩ ነበር።
translations.reference: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.hypothesis: One of the most recent examples of this to be written about is the Second World War in the North Atlantic. The Americans were trying to help the British by sending supplies and people across the Atlantic Ocean.

translations.source: በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ የጀርመን የባህር ኃይል በዋናነት U-ጀልባዎችን በመጠቀም ይህንን ትራፊክ ለማስቆም እየሞከረ ነበር።
translations.reference: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
translations.hypothesis: At the same time, the German Navy was trying to stop this traffic, mainly using U-boats.

translations.source: ተባባሪ ሀገራት ቢወድቁም ኖሮ፣ ጀርመን የተቀረውን የአውሮፓ ክፍል በሙሉ እንደያዘችው ምናልባትም ብሪቴይንን መያዝ ትችል ነበር።
translations.reference: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
translations.hypothesis: If the allied countries had fallen, Germany would have most likely taken over the rest of Europe.

translations.source: ፍየሎች በመጀመሪያ ከ 10,000 ዓመታት በፊት በኢራን ዛግሮስ ተራሮች ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በቤት ውስጥ የተሰማሩ ይመስላል።
translations.reference: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.hypothesis: Goats were probably first domesticated around 10,000 BCE in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.

translations.source: የጥንት ባህሎች እና ጎሳዎች ወተት ፣ ፀጉር ፣ ሥጋ እና ቆዳዎች በቀላሉ እንዲሰጧቸው መጠበቅ ጀመሩ።
translations.reference: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
translations.hypothesis: Ancient cultures and tribes started domesticating them so they could easily obtain milk, hair, meat, and skin.

translations.source: አብዛኛውን ጊዜ የቤት ውስጥ ፍየሎች በተራሮች ወይም በሌሎች የግጦሽ ስፍራዎች በሚንከራተቱ መንጋዎች ውስጥ ተጠብቀው ቆይተው ብዙውን ጊዜ ሕፃናት ወይም ያደጉ ከሚታወቁት እረኛ ጋር የሚመሳሰሉ ናቸው፡፡ እነዚህ የእርባታ ዘዴዎች እስከዛሬ ድረስ ጥቅም ላይ ይውላሉ፡፡
translations.reference: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
translations.hypothesis: The domestic yak is usually herded in the mountains or other high pastures and is often associated with a nomadic or semi-nomadic lifestyle. These pastoral practices have been used for centuries and continue to be used to this day.

translations.source: በ 16 ኛው ክፍለዘመን መጀመሪያ ዋገንዌይስ በእንግሊዝ ተገንብቷል።
translations.reference: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
translations.hypothesis: In the 16th century, the first English-language printing press was established in Waynesboro.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን ሰረገላዎቹ ትይዩ ጣውላዎችን ብቻ ያካተቱ ቢሆኑም፣ ፈረሶችን በበለጠ ፍጥነትን ለማሳካት የሚጎትቷቸው እና ከቀኑ ትንሽ አስቸጋሪ ከሆኑ መንገዶች ይልቅ ትላልቅ ጭነቶች መጎተትን ኣስቻሉ።
translations.reference: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
translations.hypothesis: Although the ponies are only used to pull the sledges, they are necessary to achieve the speed required, and the trails are too rough and difficult for them to travel on by day.

translations.source: ትራኮቹን በቦታው ለማቆየት መስቀለኞቹ ገና ቀደም ብለው አስተዋውቀዋል። ቀስ በቀስ ግን ትራኮች ከላይ የብረት ማዕድን ቢኖራቸው የበለጠ ውጤታማ እንደሚሆኑ መገንዘብ ተቻለ።
translations.reference: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
translations.hypothesis: The crossbars were introduced to stop the sledges from running away down the course. But soon it was realised that the tracks needed to be made of metal for them to be effective.

translations.source: ይህ የተለመደ ተግባር ሆነ ፣ ግን ብረት በሠረገላዎቹ የእንጨት ጎማዎች ላይ የበለጠ የጉዳት ምክንያት ሆኗል።
translations.reference: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
translations.hypothesis: This became a regular occurence, but the metal wheels caused more damage to the wooden rails.

translations.source: በመጨረሻም የእንጨት ጎማዎች በብረት ተተኩ። በ1767፣ የመጀመሪያዎቹ ሙሉ በሙሉ ብረት የሆኑ ሃዲዶች ተዋወቁ።
translations.reference: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
translations.hypothesis: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron ones. In 1767, the first all-iron rails were introduced.

translations.source: የመጀመሪያው የታወቀ መጓጓዣ በእግር መጓዝ ነበር ፣ ሰዎች ከሁለት ሚሊዮን ዓመታት በፊት በሆሞ ኢሬክተስ (ቀጥ ያለ ሰው ማለት) ብቅ ከማለቱ ጋር ታያይዞ፣ በእግር መጓዝ ጀመሩ።
translations.reference: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
translations.hypothesis: The first known form of transportation was walking, which humans began doing upright around 2 million years ago with the emergence of Homo erectus.

translations.source: የቀደሙት፣ ኦስትራሎፒተከስ እንደ ልማዱ ቀጥ ብለው አልሄዱም።
translations.reference: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
translations.hypothesis: The australopithecines, for example, did not evolve much beyond a certain point.

translations.source: የባለ ሁለት እግር መሻሻሎች ከ 4.2-3.9 ሚሊዮን ዓመታት በፊት በአወስትራሎፒቲከስ ቅሪት አካል ውስጥ የተገኙ ቢሆንም ሳሄላንትሮፐስ ከሰባት ሚሊዮን ዓመታት በፊት በሁለት እግሮች በእግር ተራምዶ ሊሆን ይችላል፡፡
translations.reference: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
translations.hypothesis: While bipedalism has been found in the fossil record of australopithecines as early as 4.2–3.9 million years ago, Sahelanthropus may have been bipedal as early as 7 million years ago.

translations.source: ለአከባቢው የበለጠ ወዳጃዊ መኖር መጀመር እንችላለን፣ ወደ አካባቢያዊ እንቅስቃሴው መቀላቀል እንችላለን፣ እናም የወደፊቱን መከራ በተወሰነ ደረጃ ለመቀነስ እንኳን ተሟጋቾች ልንሆን እንችላለን።
