translations.reference: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
translations.hypothesis: We can start by living more sustainably in our own lives, participating in local activism, and even advocating for policies that will reduce future harm.

translations.source: ይህ በብዙ ሁኔታዎች እንደ የምልክት ሕክምና ነው። ሆኖም፣ ጊዜያዊ መፍትሄ ብቻ ካልፈለግን ታዲያ፣ የችግሮቹን መሰረት መፈለግ አለብን እና ማጥፋት አለብን።
translations.reference: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
translations.hypothesis: This is true in many cases, but if we want a sustainable solution, we need to address the root causes.

translations.source: የሰው ልጅ በሳይንሳዊ እና በቴክኖሎጂ ግስጋሴዎች ምክንያት ዓለም ብዙ እንደተለወጠች በግልፅ የታወቀ ነው ፣ እና ከሰው ብዛት እና ከሰው ልጅ ከመጠን በላይ በሆነ የአኗኗር ዘይቤ ምክንያት ችግሮች እየበዙ መጥተዋል።
translations.reference: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
translations.hypothesis: It is obvious that the world has changed greatly because of the progress of science and technology, and that many problems have increased in proportion to the increase in population and the complexity of human society.

translations.source: ሐምሌ 4 ቀን በኮንግረስ ተቀባይነት ካገኘ በኋላ፣ በኮንግረስ ፕሬዝዳንት ጆን ሃንኮክ እና ጸሐፊው ቻርለስ ቶምሰን የተፈረመ በእጅ የተፃፈ ረቂቅ ከዚያ ጥቂት ረድፎች አለፍ ብሎ ወዳለው ማተሚያ ቤት እንዲወሰድ ተደረገ።
translations.reference: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
translations.hypothesis: After being approved by Congress on July 4, the handwritten draft was signed by President John Hancock and Secretary Charles Thomson, and then taken to a printer for a few copies to be made.

translations.source: ሌሊቱን ሙሉ አሁን “ዱንላፕ ብሮድ ሳይድስ” ተብለው የሚጠሩ ከ150 እስከ 200 ቅጂዎች ተሰርተው ነበር።
translations.reference: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
translations.hypothesis: Overnight, 150 to 200 copies were made of what would now be called "Dunlap Broadside".

translations.source: የሰነዱ የመጀመሪያ የህዝብ ንባብ በጆን ኒክሰን በነጻነት አዳራሽ ግቢ ውስጥ ጁላይ 8 ነበር።
translations.reference: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
translations.hypothesis: The first public reading of the document was on July 8, 1976, in Independence Hall.

translations.source: አንደኛው ሐምሌ 6 ወደ ጆርጅ ዋሽንግተን የተላከ ሲሆን፣ በኒውዮርክ ላሉ ሰራዊቶቹ ሐምሌ 9 ላይ አስነብቦታል። ቅጂው ነሐሴ 10 ላይ ለንደን ደርሷል።
translations.reference: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
translations.hypothesis: The first was sent to George Washington on July 6, and announced to the troops in New York on July 9. The copy reached London on August 10.

translations.source: እስካሁን ድረስ የታወቁት 25 የዳንላፕ ሰፋፊ መንገዶች ከሰነዱ የተረፉ ጥንታዊ ቅጅዎች ናቸው። የመጀመሪያው በእጅ የተጻፈ ቅጅ አልተረፈም።
translations.reference: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
translations.hypothesis: The 25 known copies of the Dulaig manuscript are the only surviving copies of the text. No handwritten copy of the original manuscript has survived.

translations.source: ዛሬ ብዙ የቅሪተ አካል ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች አንድ የዳይኖሰር ቡድን መትረፉን እና ዛሬ በሕይወት አለ ብለው ያምናሉ። ወፎች ብለን እንጠራቸዋለን።
translations.reference: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
translations.hypothesis: Many paleontologists think that a group of dinosaurs survived and that they are the ancestors of the birds we see today. We call them birds.

translations.source: ብዙ ሰዎች ላባ ስላላቸው እና መብረር ስለሚችሉ እንደ ዳይኖሰር አይቆጥሯቸውም።
translations.reference: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
translations.hypothesis: They are not considered to be dinosaurs by most people because they have feathers and can fly.

translations.source: ግን ስለ ወፎች አሁንም ብዙ ነገሮች አሉ የዳይኖሰር ይመስላሉ።
translations.reference: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
translations.hypothesis: But there is still so much we don't know about birds, they're just like the dinosaurs in that way.

translations.source: ጥርሶች እና ጥፍሮች ያሉት እግሮች አሏቸው ፣ እንቁላል ይጥላሉ እና እንደ ቲ-ሬክስ በሁለት የኋላ እግሮቻቸው ላይ ይራመዳሉ።
translations.reference: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
translations.hypothesis: They had claws and walked on two legs, laid eggs and walked on two legs like the T-Rex.

translations.source: በአሁኑ ጊዜ በአብዛኛው ሁሉም ኮምፒዩተሮች በሁለትዮሽ ቁጥሮች መልክ ኮድ በተደረጉ የመረጃ ሥርጭት ላይ የተመሠረቱ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
translations.hypothesis: Nowadays almost all computers use a binary code based system for data representation.

translations.source: የሁለትዮሽ ቁጥር አንድ ወይም ሁለት ቦታዎች ብቻ ነው ያሉት፤ ማለትም 0 ወይ 1 እናም እነዚህ ቁጥሮች የሁለትዮሽ ቁጥሮች በመባል ይታወቃሉ - ወይም ቢትስ፤ የኮምፒውተር ቋንቋን ለመጠቀም።
translations.reference: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
translations.hypothesis: Binary numbers use only one of two digits, namely 0 or 1, and these numbers are called binary numbers or bits, to use the language of computers.

translations.source: የውስጥ መመረዝ ወዲያውኑ ላይታይ ይችላል። እንደ ማስታወክ ያሉ ምልክቶች ፈጣን ምርመራ ሊደረግባቸው የማይችሉ በበቂ ሁኔታ አጠቃላይ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
translations.hypothesis: The onset of internal bleeding can be sudden. Symptoms such as vomiting and diarrhea are not specific enough to allow for early diagnosis.

translations.source: የውስጥ መመረዝ መኖሩን የሚያሳይ በጣም ጥሩው ምልክት፣ ክፍት የሆነ መድኃኒት ወይም መርዛማ የቤት ኬሚካሎች መኖር ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
translations.hypothesis: The presence of suicide notes is another indicator of possible suicide, as is the availability of a specific poison or a method of killing oneself with a household product.

translations.source: ለዚያ ልዩ መርዝ ልዩ የመጀመሪያ ዕርዳታ ትዕዛዞች ካሉ ፅሑፉን ይፈትሹ።
translations.reference: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
translations.hypothesis: If there are specific first aid instructions for that particular poison, find them and follow them.

translations.source: ትኋን የሚለው ቃል በኢንቶሞሎጂስት የነፍሳት ቡድን በመደበኛ መልክ ጥቅም ላይ የሚውለው ስም ነው።
translations.reference: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
translations.hypothesis: The word tsetse is the common name used for the insect by entomologists.

translations.source: ይህ ቃል ከጥንታውያን የትኋኖች ዝርያ የመጣ ሲሆን፣ እነዚህ ሰዎችን ተጠግተው ለመኖር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ የተስተካከሉ ነፍሳት ናቸው።
translations.reference: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
translations.hypothesis: This word comes from the ancient Greek word for monkey, which referred to a now-extinct ape that was closely related to humans.

translations.source: ሁለቱም ተናዳፊ-ትንኞች እና የአልጋ ትኋኖች ጥገኝነት ያላቸው፣ ጎጆአቸው ለመኖር ወይም በጥገኛ መኖሪያቸው ለመኖር የተስተካከሉ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
translations.hypothesis: Both the tsetse fly and its trypanosome symbiont are adapted to a very specific ecological niche.

translations.source: በመላው አሜሪካ ፣ በግምት ወደ 400,000 የሚታወቁ የብዙ ስክለሮሲስ (MS) ጉዳዮች አሉ ፣ ይህም በወጣት እና በመካከለኛ ዕድሜ ላይ ባሉ አዋቂዎች ላይ እንደ ዋና የነርቭ በሽታ እንዲሆን ያደርገዋል።
translations.reference: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
translations.hypothesis: In the Region of the Americas, there are an estimated 400,000 cases of multiple sclerosis (MS), which is a major disabling neurological disease affecting young adults.

translations.source: MS በአንጎል ፣ በስፓይናል ኮርድ እና በኦፕቲክ ነርቭ የተገነባውን ማዕከላዊውን የነርቭ ሥርዓት የሚያጠቃ በሽታ ነው።
translations.reference: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
translations.hypothesis: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, spinal cord and optic nerves.

translations.source: ሴቶችን በኤምኤስ የመያዝ ዕድላቸው ከወንዶች በሁለት እጥፍ ያደገ እንደሆነ ምርምር አረጋግጧል።
translations.reference: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
translations.hypothesis: Research has proven that women are twice more likely to be held in mental health facilities than men.

translations.source: ጥንዶች ልጅ ማሳደግ የነሱ ፍላጎት እንዳልሆነ ወይም የልጃቸው ፍላጎት እንዳልሆነ ሊወስኑ ይችላሉ።.
translations.reference: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
translations.hypothesis: Older people may find that they no longer have the desire to have children or that their children no longer want to have children.

translations.source: እኚህ ጥንዶች ለልጃቸው የጉዲፈቻ እቅድ ለማውጣት ሊመርጡ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
translations.hypothesis: These couples may also opt for donor sperm to conceive.

translations.source: በጉዲፈቻ ውስጥ፣ ወላጆች ልጆቹን ሌላ ባልና ሚስት እንዲያሳድጓቸው የወላጅ መብታቸውን ያቋርጣሉ።
translations.reference: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
translations.hypothesis: In divorce, parents give up some of their parental rights and responsibilities when they allow another person to raise their child.

translations.source: የሳይንስ ዋና ግብ ዓለም በሳይንሳዊ ዘዴ አማካኝነት የምትሰራበትን መንገድ ማወቅ ነው። ይህ ዘዴ በእውነቱ በጣም ሳይንሳዊ ምርምርን ይመራል።
translations.reference: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
translations.hypothesis: The main goal of science is to figure out how the universe works through the scientific method. This method is what really guides scientific inquiry.

translations.source: ብቻውን ግን አይደለም፣ መሞከር፣ እና ሙከራ አንድ ወይም ከዚያ በላይ መላ ምቶችን ለማስወገድ የሚጠቅም ፈተና ነው፣ ጥያቄዎችን መጠየቅ፣ እና ምልከታዎችን ማካሄድም ሳይንሳዊ ጥናትን ይመራሉ።
translations.reference: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
translations.hypothesis: But it is not enough to just try, and test, and evaluate one or more responses; it is also necessary to ask questions, and to conduct observations, in order to drive scientific inquiry.

translations.source: የተፈጥሮ ተመራማሪዎችና ፈላስፎች በክላሲካል ጽሑፎች ላይ እና በተለይም በላቲን መጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ላይ አተኮሩ።
translations.reference: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
translations.hypothesis: Natural scientists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, the Latin Bible.

translations.source: በሁሉም ሳይንስ ጉዳዮች ላይ የአርስቶትል እይታ ተቀባይነት አለው፣ ስነ-አእምሮን ጨምሮ፡፡
translations.reference: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
translations.hypothesis: Aristotle's views on all sciences, including psychology, were widely accepted.

translations.source: የግሪክ ዕውቀት እየቀነሰ በሄደ ቁጥር ምዕራባውያን ከግሪክ ፍልስፍናዊ እና ሳይንሳዊ ሥረታቸው ተለይተው ተገኙ።
translations.reference: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
translations.hypothesis: As Greek knowledge declined in the West, Westerners became increasingly ignorant of their Greek philosophical and scientific heritage.

translations.source: በፊዚዮሎጂ እና በባህሪ ውስጥ የተስተዋሉ ብዙ ተውሂዶች ብዙውን ጊዜ በዋነኝነት የሚወሰኑት በፍጥረታዊ ዑደቶች መኖር እና ባዮሎጂያዊ ሰዓቶች ላይ ባላቸው ምርታማነት ላይ ነው።
translations.reference: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the rhythms observed in physiology and behaviour are ultimately dependent on the presence of cyclical patterns in the physical world and the effects of biological clocks.

translations.source: ለውጫዊ ወቅታዊ ምልክቶች ቀላል ምላሽ የማይሰጡ ወቅታዊ ምቶች ለአብዛኞቹ ሕያዋን ፍጥረታት ባክቴሪያ ፣ ፈንገሶችን ፣ እፅዋትንና እንስሳትን ጨምሮ ተመዝግበዋል።
translations.reference: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
translations.hypothesis: Symptoms that respond poorly to conventional treatments have been reported in most living things, including bacteria, fungi, plants and animals.

translations.source: ባዮሎጂያዊ ሰዓቶች እራሳቸውን የሚደግፉ ኦሲሌተሮች ናቸው ፣ የውጭ ምልክቶች ባይኖሩም እንኳ ነፃ የማሽከርከር ብስክሌት ጊዜን የሚቀጥሉ።
translations.reference: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
translations.hypothesis: Biological clocks are self-sustained oscillators, which continue to run even in the absence of external cues.

translations.source: የሄርሽ እና ቼስ ሙከራ ዲኤንኤ የጄኔቲክ ቁሳቁስ ነበር ከሚለው መሪ ሃሳብ መካከል አንዱ ነበር።
translations.reference: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
translations.hypothesis: One of the leading ideas was that the material they were trying to find was a DNA.

translations.source: ሀርሺ እና ቼዝ የራሳቸውን ዲኤንኤ ወደ ባክቴሪያ ለማስገባት ብሎችን ወይም ቫይረሶችን ተጠቅመው ነበር።
translations.reference: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
translations.hypothesis: Harish and Chase used bacteriophages — viruses that infect bacteria — to insert their DNA into the bacteria.

translations.source: ዲ ን ኤ ፌጅ በሬዲዮአክቲቭ ፎስፈረስ ወይም የፕሮቲን ፌጅ ከሬዲዮአክቲቭ ሰልፈር ጋር ምልክት በማድረግ ሁለት ሙከራዎችን አደረጉ።
translations.reference: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
translations.hypothesis: They made two attempts to label the DNA with radioactive phosphorus or protein with radioactive sulphur.

translations.source: ሚውቴሽን በሚውቴሽን ዓይነት ፣ በተጎዳው የጄኔቲክ ንጥረ ነገር ቁራጭ አስፈላጊነት እና የተጎዱት ህዋሳት የዘር-መስመር ህዋሳት ላይ በመመርኮዝ የተለያዩ ልዩ ልዩ ተጽዕኖዎች ሊኖሩት ይችላል።
translations.reference: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
translations.hypothesis: Mutations can have many different effects depending on the type of mutation, the specific DNA sequence involved, and which cells are affected (particularly if the mutation is in a germline cell).

translations.source: የጀርም መስመር ያላቸው ህዋሶች ላይ የሚደረግ ቅይርታ ብቻ ወደ ህፃናት ሊተላለፍ ይችላል፣ ሌሎች ህዋሶች ላይ የሚደረግ ቅይርታ ግን ህዋሱ እንዲሞት ወይም ካንሰርን ይፈጥራል።
translations.reference: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
translations.hypothesis: Only the infection of germline cells can be inherited by offspring, while mutations in somatic cells lead to cell death or cancer.

translations.source: ተፈጥሮን መሠረት ያደረገ ቱሪዝም ተፈጥሮአዊ አካባቢዎችን ለመጎብኘት ፍላጎት ያላቸውን ሰዎች እፅዋትንና እንስሳትን የዱር እንስሳትን ጨምሮ ይዝናናል።
translations.reference: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: Ecotourism is when people go to visit natural areas and enjoy the plants and animals there, including wildlife.

translations.source: በቦታው ላይ የተከናወኑ ተግባራት ምሳሌዎች አደን ፣ ዓሳ ማጥመድ ፣ ፎቶግራፍ ማንሳት ፣ ወፎችን መመልከት እና መናፈሻዎች መጎብኘት እና ስለ ሥነ ምህዳሩ መረጃን ማጥናት ናቸው።
translations.reference: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
translations.hypothesis: Examples of activities that take place on site include hiking, fishing, photography, birdwatching, camping, boating, and picnicking, as well as educational activities and guided tours.

translations.source: ምሳሌ የሚሆነው በቦርኒዮ ስለ ኦርግንጊያችቫንስ መማር፣ መጎብኘት እና ፎቶግራፍ ማንሳት ነው።
translations.reference: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
translations.hypothesis: An example would be learning about, visiting, and photographing the orangutans of Borneo.

translations.source: ሰዎች በየቀኑ ጠዋት ላይ ከትናንሽ የገጠር ከተሞች በመኪና ወደ ሥራ ቦታቸው ይሄዳሉ እና ሌሎች የሥራ መድረሻቸው ጥለውት የሔዱት ቦታ በሆነ ሰዎች ይታለፋሉ።
translations.reference: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
translations.hypothesis: People commute every day from small rural towns to their workplace in the city and back to their hometown.

translations.source: በዚህ ተለዋዋጭ የትራንስፖርት መርከብ ውስጥ ሁሉም ሰው በሆነ መንገድ በግል መኪናዎች ላይ የተመሠረተ የትራንስፖርት ስርዓት እንደምንም ተገናኝቷል እንዲሁም ይደግፋል።
translations.reference: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
translations.hypothesis: Everyone in this mobility ecosystem is somehow connected to the vehicle and dependent on the vehicle.

translations.source: ሳይንስ አሁን እንደሚያመለክትው ይህ ግዙፍ የካርቦን ኢኮኖሚ ላለፉት ሁለት ሚሊዮን ዓመታት የሰውን ልጅ ዝግመተ ለውጥ ከደገፈው የተረጋጋ ሁኔታ ባዮስፌርን እንዳነቃነቀው ያሳያል።
translations.reference: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
translations.hypothesis: Science now shows that this giant carbon cycle has regulated the biosphere and supported the evolution of humans for the last 2 million years.

translations.source: ሁሉም ሰው በኅብረተሰብ ውስጥ ይሳተፋል እና የትራንስፖርት ስርዓቶችን ይጠቀማል። ሁሉም ሰው ማለት ይቻላል ስለ መጓጓዣ ስርዓቶች ቅሬታ ያቀርባል።
translations.reference: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
translations.hypothesis: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone has a complaint about the transportation systems.

translations.source: በአደጉ ሀገራት አንዳንድ ጊዜ ስለ ውሃ ጥራት እና ስለ ድልድዮች መውደቅ እኩል ቅሬታዎች ይሰማሉ።
translations.reference: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
translations.hypothesis: In developed countries there are often complaints about the quality of the water and the falling of the water level.

translations.source: የትራንስፖርት ስርዓቶች ለምን እንደዚህ አይነት ቅሬታዎች ያመጣሉ ፣ ለምን በየቀኑ ሳይሳካላቸው ይቀራል? የትራንስፖርት መሐንዲሶች በቃ ብቃት የላቸውም ማለት ነው? ወይም የበለጠ መሠረታዊ የሆነ ነገር እየተካሄደ ነው?
translations.reference: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
translations.hypothesis: Why do transport systems cause such complaints, and what prevents them from being accomplished every day? Are transport engineers not up to the task? Or is something more fundamental going on?

translations.source: የትራፊክ ፍሰት በሁለት ነጥቦች መካከል የአሽከርካሪዎች እና ተሽከርካሪዎች እንቅስቃሴ እና እርስ በእርስ የሚያደርጉትን ግንኙነት ማጥናት ነው።
translations.reference: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
translations.hypothesis: Traffic flow is the study of the movement of vehicles and pedestrians between two points and their interaction with each other.

translations.source: እንደ አለመታደል ሆኖ የሹፌርን ባህሪ መቶ በመቶ በእርግጠኝነት መተንበይ ስለማይቻል የትራፊክ ፍሰትን ማጥናት ከባድ ነው።
translations.reference: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
translations.hypothesis: Unfortunately, it is difficult to predict traffic flow with any certainty because it is impossible to know for sure what the drivers will do.

translations.source: እንደ እድል ሆኖ ፣ አሽከርካሪዎች በተመጣጣኝ ወጥነት ባለው ክልል ውስጥ ጠባይ ያሳያሉ፡ ስለሆነም የትራፊክ ፍሰቶች የተወሰነ ተመጣጣኝ ወጥነት ይኖራቸዋል እናም በግምት በሂሳብ ሊወከሉ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
translations.hypothesis: Fortunately, drivers exhibit patterns in their routes over time: hence traffic flows have some degree of predictability and can be reasonably anticipated.

translations.source: የትራፊክ ፍሰትን በተሻለ ለመወከል በሦስቱ ዋና ዋና ባህሪዎች መካከል ግንኙነቶች ተመስርተዋል፥ (1) ፍሰት ፣ (2) ጥግግት እና (3) ፍጥነት።
translations.reference: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
translations.hypothesis: Relationships between the three main factors of (1) flow, (2) turbulence and (3) speed are established to better represent the traffic flow.

translations.source: እነዚህ ግንኙነቶች የመንገድ ላይ መገልገያዎችን ለማቀድ ፣ ዲዛይን እና ሥራዎችን ለማከናወን ይረዳሉ።
translations.reference: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
translations.hypothesis: These relationships help facilitate the planning, design, and execution of on-the-ground projects.

translations.source: ነፍሳት ወደ አየር የሄዱት የመጀመሪያ እንስሳት ነበሩ። የመብረር ችሎታቸው ጠላቶችን በቀላሉ ለማሸሽ እና ምግብን እና የትዳር ጓደኛን በብቃት እንዲያገኙ ረድቷቸዋል።
translations.reference: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
translations.hypothesis: Animals were the first organisms to take to the sky. Their ability to fly helped them to avoid predators and to find food and mates more efficiently.

translations.source: አብዛኞቹ ነፍሳት ሰውነታቸውን ወደኋላ በመመለስ ክንፎቻቸውን ማጠፍ የመቻላቸው ጥቅም አላቸው።
translations.reference: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
translations.hypothesis: Most birds have the ability to fold their wings and tuck them back.

translations.source: ይህ ከአዳኝ እንስሳት ለመደበቅ የትንንሽ ቦታዎች ሰፊ ክልል ይሰጣቸዋል።
translations.reference: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
translations.hypothesis: This gives them a wide range of small spaces to hide in from predators.

translations.source: ዛሬ ላይ፣ ክንፋቸውን ወደ ኋላ ማጠፍ የማይችሉት ብቸኛ ነፍሳት የውሃ ተርቦች እና የግንቦት በረሮዎች ናቸው።
translations.reference: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
translations.hypothesis: Today, the only animals that can fly are birds and bats.

translations.source: ከሺዎች ዓመታት በፊት አርስጥሮኮስ የተባለ አንድ ሰው የሶላር ሲስተሙ በፀሐይ ዙሪያ ይዘዋወራል ብሏል።
translations.reference: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
translations.hypothesis: Thousands of years ago, a Greek person named Aristarchus said that the planets go around the Sun.

translations.source: አንዳንድ ሰዎች ልክ እንደሆነ ሲያስቡ ብዙ ሰዎች ግን በተቃራኒው ፀሐይን ጨምሮ (እና ሌሎችን ኮከቦችም ጭምር)፣ ስርዓተ ፀሐይ በምድር ዙሪያ እንደሚንቀሳቀስ ያምኑ ነበር፤ ።
translations.reference: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
translations.hypothesis: While some people think it's just a theory, many people believe that the sun, and all the other stars, are moving around the earth.

translations.source: ይህ ምክንያታዊ ይመስላል፣ ምክንያቱም ምድር የምትንቀሳቀስ አይመስልም፣ አይደል?
translations.reference: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
translations.hypothesis: This sounds reasonable, because the Earth does not seem to move, right?

translations.source: የአማዞን ወንዝ ሁለተኛ ረዥሙ እና በምድር ላይ ትልቁ ወንዝ ነው። ከሁለተኛው ትልቁ ወንዝ ከ 8 እጥፍ የሚበልጥ ውሃ ይይዛል።
translations.reference: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon River is the second longest and the largest river by volume in the world. It contains about 8 times the volume of the second largest river.

translations.source: በተጨማሪም አማዞን በምድር ላይ እጅግ በጣም ሰፊ ወንዝ ነው፣ አንዳንዴ ስድስት ማይሎች ሰፊ ይሆናል።
translations.reference: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon is also the widest river in the world, at times six miles across.

translations.source: ከፕላኔትዋ ወንዞች ፈሶ ወደ ውቂያኖሶች የሚገባው ውሃ ሙሉ 20 በመቶ የሚመጣው ከአማዞን ነው።
translations.reference: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon River contributes to 20% of all freshwater entering the oceans.

translations.source: ዋናው የአማዞን ወንዝ ርዝማኔው 6,387 ኪ.ሜ (3,980 ማይሎች) ነው። በሺዎች ከሚቆጠሩ ትናንሽ ገባሪ ወንዞች ውሃ ይሰበስባል።
translations.reference: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon River's main stem is 6,387 km (3,980 mi) long. It collects the waters from thousands of smaller rivers.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን እስከ ብሉይ ኪንግደም መጨረሻ እስከሚጠናቀቅበት ጊዜ ድረስ የፒራሚድ ግንባታ በድንጋይ መስራቱ የቀጠለ ቢሆንም የጊዛ ፒራሚዶች በመጠን እና በግንባታ ቴክኒካዊ ልኬታቸው በጭራሽ አልተበለጡም።
translations.reference: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
translations.hypothesis: Although pyramid construction continued in stone until the end of the Old Kingdom, the Pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in scale or technical expertise.

translations.source: የጥንታዊ ግብፃዊያኖች አዲስ ግዛት ከአንድ ሺሕ ዓመት በላይ በሆናቸው በቀዳሚዎቻቸው ሀውልቶች ተገረሙ።
translations.reference: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
translations.hypothesis: The New Kingdom Egyptians were amazed at the pyramids of their predecessors, who had ruled Egypt more than a thousand years before.

translations.source: የቫቲካን ሲቲ ህዝብ ቁጥር ወደ 800 ገደማ ነው። በዓለም ትንሹ ሉዓላዊ ሃገር እና ትንሹ የህዝብ ቁጥር ያለው ሃገር ነው።
translations.reference: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
translations.hypothesis: The population of Vatican City is around 800 people. It is the smallest independent state in the world by both area and population.

translations.source: ቫቲካን ሲቲ ጣልያንኛ በሕገ-ደንቧ እና ኦፊሴላዊ ግንኙነቷ ትጠቀማለች።
translations.reference: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
translations.hypothesis: Vatican City uses Italian in its civil law and official communications.

translations.source: ጣልያንኛ እንዲሁ በስቴቱ ውስጥ የሚሰሩ አብዛኛዎቹ የሚጠቀሙበት የዕለት ተዕለት ቋንቋ ሲሆን ላቲን ብዙውን ጊዜ በሃይማኖታዊ ሥነ ሥርዓቶች ላይ ይውላል።
translations.reference: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
translations.hypothesis: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of the population, while Latin is mostly reserved for religious services.

translations.source: ሁሉም የቫቲካን ከተማ ዜጎች የሮማ ካቶሊክ እምነት ተከታዮች ናቸው።
translations.reference: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
translations.hypothesis: All citizens of Vatican City are members of the Roman Catholic Church.

translations.source: ሰዎች ከጥንት ጀምሮ እንደ ወርቅ ፣ ብር እና ናስ ያሉ መሠረታዊ ኬሚካላዊ ንጥረ ነገሮችን ያውቃሉ ፣ እነዚህ ሁሉ በተፈጥሮ ውስጥ ሊገኙ ስለሚችሉ በጥንታዊ መሣሪያዎች ለማዕድን ቁፋሮ ቀላል ናቸው።
translations.reference: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
translations.hypothesis: Humans have known about some of the elements since ancient times, such as gold, silver, and copper, because they are easily obtained from the ground in their native form.

translations.source: ፈላስፋው አርስቶትል ሁሉም ነገር ከአንድ ወይም ከዚያ በላይ ከአራት አካላት ድብልቅ እንደሚሆን ፅንሰ-ሀሳቡን ሰጥቷል። እነሱም ምድር ፣ ውሃ ፣ አየር እና እሳት ናቸው።
translations.reference: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
translations.hypothesis: The Greek philosopher Aristotle gave the concept that everything is made up of a combination of four elements. They are earth, water, air and fire.

translations.source: ይህ ልክ እንደ አራቱ የነገሮች ሁኔታ (በተመሳሳይ ቅደም ተከተል)-ጠንካራ ፣ ፈሳሽ ፣ ጋዝ እና ፕላዝማ ቢሆንም እኛ የምናየውን እንዲፈጠሩ ወደ አዳዲስ ንጥረ ነገሮች እንዲለወጡ ሀሳብ አቅርቧል።
translations.reference: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
translations.hypothesis: This is just like the four states of matter (in no particular order)-solid, liquid, gas, and plasma-except we are postulating that they can be converted into new elements.

translations.source: አሎይስ በመሠረቱ የሁለት ወይም ከዚያ በላይ የብረቶች ድብልቅ ነው። በፔሬዲክ ቴብለ ላይ ብዙ ኤለመንቶች እንዳሉ አይርሱ።
translations.reference: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
translations.hypothesis: An alloy is basically a mixture of two or more metals. There are many elements in the periodic table.

translations.source: እንደ ካልሲየም እና ፖታሲየም ያሉ ንጥረ ነገሮች እንደ ብረቶች ይቆጠራሉ። በእርግጥ እንደ ብር እና ወርቅ ያሉ ብረቶችም አሉ።
translations.reference: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
translations.hypothesis: Elements such as calcium and potassium are metals. Of course, there are also metals such as silver and gold.

translations.source: እንዲሁም እንደ ካርቦን ብረት-ያልሆኑ ንጥረ ነገሮችን የሚያካትቱ ቅይጦች ሊኖሩ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
translations.hypothesis: They can also contain other elements, such as carbon, in the form of carbides.

translations.source: በዩንቨርስ ውስጥ ያለ ነገር ሁሉ ከቁስ አካል የተሰራ ነው። ሁሉም ቁስ አካል አተም ከሚባሉ ትንንሽ ቅንጣጢት የተሰራ ነው።
translations.reference: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
translations.hypothesis: Everything in the universe is made up of matter. All matter is made up of tiny particles called atoms.

translations.source: አቶሞች በጣም ትንሽ ከመሆናቸው የተነሳ ትሪሊየን የሚሆኑት በዚህ አረፍተነገር መጨረሻ ላይ ያለ ነጥብ ውስጥ መግባት ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
translations.hypothesis: Atoms are so small that trillions of them can fit on the head of a pin.

translations.source: ስለሆነም እርሳሱ ሲወጣ ለብዙ ሰዎች ጥሩ ጓደኛ ነበር።
translations.reference: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
translations.hypothesis: So the lead in it was a good friend to many people.

translations.source: የሚያሳዝነው ፣ አዳዲስ የአጻጻፍ ስልቶች እንደወጡ ፣ እርሳሱ ወደ አነስተኛ ደረጃ እና አጠቃቀሞች እንዲወርድ ተደርጓል።
translations.reference: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
translations.hypothesis: Unfortunately, as new writing systems came into existence, the stylus was reduced in size and importance, and eventually fell into disuse.

translations.source: ሰዎች አሁን ወደ መቅረጫ መቅረብ በጭራሽ ሳያስፈልጋቸው ፣ በኮምፒተር ማያ ገጾች ላይ መልዕክቶችን ይጽፋሉ።
translations.reference: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
translations.hypothesis: People now write messages on computer screens that are then transmitted to other computer screens anywhere in the world, all without the need for anyone to physically move the message.

translations.source: አዲስ ነገር ሲመጣ የቁልፍ ሰሌዳ ምን እንደሚሆን አንደ ሰው መገረም ብቻ ነው የሚችለው።
translations.reference: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
translations.hypothesis: One can only wonder what the next big thing will be.

translations.source: የፍንዳታ ቦንብ የሚሠራው ሁሉንም ኃይል በሚቻለው ፕሮቶን እና ኒውትሮን ወደ ኒውክለስ በመሰብሰብ በሚለው መመሪያ ነው።
translations.reference: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
translations.hypothesis: The bomb works by the principle of bringing together all the energy that is normally locked up in the nucleus of atoms.

translations.source: አንድ ከባድ ጋሪ ወደ ኮረብታ እንደሚንከባለል ዓይነት። ኒውክሊየሱን እንደገና በመክፈል ከዚያ የተወሰነውን ኃይል ይለቀቃል።
translations.reference: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
translations.hypothesis: Like a huge boulder rolling down a hill. It releases energy as it re-forms its nucleus.

translations.source: አንዳንድ አቶሞች ያልተረጋጉ ኒውክሊየኖች አሏቸው ይህም ማለት በጥቂቱ ወይም ያለ ምንም ንክኪ በመለያየት የመበተን አዝማሚያ አላቸው።
translations.reference: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
translations.hypothesis: Some atoms have unstable nuclei, which means that they have a tendency to decay by emitting particles or energy.

translations.source: የጨረቃው ገጽ ከአለቶች እና ከአቧራ የተሠራ ነው። የጨረቃው ውጫዊ ሽፋን ክረስት ተብሎ ይጠራል።
translations.reference: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
translations.hypothesis: The moon's surface is made out of rocks and dust. The moon's outer crust is called the regolith.

translations.source: ጠርዙ በአቅራቢያው በኩል 70 ኪሜ ውፍረት ያለው ሲሆን በርቀት በኩል ደግሞ 100 ኪሜ.ነው።
translations.reference: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
translations.hypothesis: The caldera is 70 km across on its long axis and 100 km from rim to rim.

translations.source: በማሪው ሥር ቀጭን ነው ከደጋ ሥር ደግሞ ወፍራም ነው።
translations.reference: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
translations.hypothesis: It is short in the marmoset and long in the titi monkey.

translations.source: በአጠገብ በኩል ብዙ ማሪያ ሊኖር ይችላል ምክንያቱም ቅርፊቱ ሳሳ ያለ ነው። ለላቫው ወደ ላይ መውጣት ቀላል ነበር።
translations.reference: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
translations.hypothesis: There may be many Marias next to each other because the letters are curvy. It was easy for the lava to flow up the side.

translations.source: አሁን ያሉት ፅንሰ ሐሳቦች ያማከሉት ሰዎችን ምን እንደሚማርካቸው ማግኘት ላይ ነው።
translations.reference: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
translations.hypothesis: The focus now is on what the people who attended can take away.

translations.source: እነዚህ ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦች እንደሚያመለክቱት ሰዎች ወደ አዋቂነት ሲያድጉ በውስጣቸው የተቀየሱ የተወሰኑ ፍላጎቶች እና/ወይም ምኞቶች ያሏቸው ናቸው።
translations.reference: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
translations.hypothesis: These theories suggest that as people develop they have particular needs and/or desires that are built into them.

translations.source: እነዚህ ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦች የተወሰኑ ሰዎችን የሚያደርጉትን ነገር እንዲፈልጉ እና በአካባቢያቸው ያሉ ነገሮች አንዳንድ ነገሮችን እንዲያደርጉ ወይም እንዳያደርጉ የሚያደርጋቸው ምን እንደሆነ ያመለከታሉ።
translations.reference: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
translations.hypothesis: These concepts refer to the conditions in which certain people find themselves and which make it more or less likely that they will engage in certain actions or behaviours.

translations.source: ሁለት ታዋቂ የይዘት ፅንሰ ሐሳቦች የማዝሎው የጥቅሞች ተዋረድ ፅንሰ ሐሳብ እና የኸርዝበርግ ሁለትዮሽ ፅንሰ ሐሳብ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
translations.hypothesis: Two popular content theories are the Arousal Theory and the Catharsis Theory.

translations.source: በአጠቃላይ አነጋገር፣ አስተዳዳሪዎች የቀድሞ አቻዎቻቸውን መምራት ሲጀምሩ ሁለት ባህሪዎች ሊመጡ ይችላሉ፡፡ አንዱ ኅብረ ቀለም “ከወንዶቹ አንዱ” (ወይም አንዷ) ሆኖ ለመቀጠል መሞከር ነው፡፡
translations.reference: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
translations.hypothesis: In general, when leaders start to manage their former peers, two behaviours can show up. One is the attempt to continue being “one of the guys” (or gals).

translations.source: የዚህ ዓይነቱ ተቆጣጣሪ ተወዳጅ ያልሆኑ ውሳኔዎችን የማድረግ ፣ የዲሲፕሊን እርምጃዎችን የማከናወን ፣ የአፈፃፀም ምዘናዎችን የማድረግ ፣ ኃላፊነትን የመመደብ እና ሰዎችን ተጠያቂ የማድረግ ችግር አለበት።
translations.reference: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
translations.hypothesis: This regulator is concerned with making unpopular decisions, implementing disciplinary measures, conducting performance evaluations, assigning responsibilities, and holding people accountable.

translations.source: በሌላኛው ጫፍ ላይ, አንድ ሰው ቡድኑን ሲያከናውን የነበረውን ነገር ሁሉ መለወጥ እና የራሳቸው ማድረግ እንዳለባቸው በሚሰማው የማይታወቅ ግለሰብ ላይ ይለወጣል።
translations.reference: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
translations.hypothesis: On the other end of the spectrum is the maverick, who chafes at being told what to do and wants to do his own thing.

translations.source: ያም ሆነ ይሄ፣ ለቡድኑ ስኬት እና ውድቀት ውሎ አድሮ ሃላፊነቱን የሚወስደው መሪው ነው።
translations.reference: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
translations.hypothesis: Either way, the buck stops with the leader when it comes to the success or failure of a team.

translations.source: ይህ ባህሪ ብዙውን ጊዜ በመሪዎች እና በቀሪው ቡድን መካከል ጠብ ያስከስታል።
translations.reference: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
translations.hypothesis: This behaviour often creates distance between leaders and the rest of the team.

translations.source: ቨርቹዋል ቡድኖች ከተለመዱት ቡድኖች ተመሳሳይ የላቁ ደረጃዎች ጋር የተያዙ ናቸው ፣ ግን ስውር ልዩነቶች አሏቸው።
translations.reference: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
translations.hypothesis: Virtual teams are similar to regular teams in that they share the same high ideals, but they also have some unique differences.

translations.source: የምናባዊ ቡድን አባላት ለቅርብ አካላዊ ቡድናቸው እንደ ግንኙነት ነጥብ ያገለግላሉ።
translations.reference: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
translations.hypothesis: The virtual team members serve as the focal point for their local constituency.

translations.source: ከተለመዱት የቡድን አባላት የበለጠ ብዙውን ጊዜ ራሳቸውን በራሳቸው የሚያስተዳድሩ በመሆናቸው በአካባቢያቸው ያሉ አስተዳዳሪዎች ሊገባቸው በማይችሏቸው በተለያዩ የጊዜ ሰቆች ይገናኛሉ፡፡
translations.reference: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
translations.hypothesis: They are more likely to be self-employed and work irregular hours, which makes it difficult for local authorities to understand their needs.

translations.source: የእውነተኛ “ስውር ቡድን” መኖር (ላርሰን እና ላፋስቶ፣ 1989፣ ፒ109) የምናባዊ ቡድኑ ልዩ አካልም ነው።
translations.reference: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
translations.hypothesis: The existence of a "real blind" group (Larsen & LaFasto, 1989, p.109) is also part of the team dynamic.

translations.source: “የማይታየው ቡድን” እያንዳንዱ አባላቱ ሪፖርት የሚያደርጉበት የአስተዳደር ቡድን ነው። የማይታየው ቡድን ለእያንዳንዱ አባል ደረጃዎችን ያወጣል።
translations.reference: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
translations.hypothesis: The "Invisible Team" is the governing body to which each member reports. The Invisible Team sets the standards for each rank.

translations.source: አንድ ድርጅት የመማር ድርጅት ለማቋቋም ጊዜ የሚወስድበትን ሂደት ለምን ማለፍ ፈለገ? የድርጅታዊ ትምህርት ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦችን በተግባር ለማዋል አንድ የግብ ፈጠራ ነው።
translations.reference: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
translations.hypothesis: Why did the startup want to embark on the journey of building an accelerator? It's a goal-oriented program designed to help startups execute their business models.

translations.source: ሁሉም የሚገኙ ግብዓቶች በድርጅቱ የስራ ክፍሎች ውስጥ በአግባቡ ጥቅም ላይ ከዋሉ፣ ፈጠራ እና ብልሕነት ጎልተው ይታያሉ።
translations.reference: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
translations.hypothesis: Innovation and efficiency will shine through if all resources are used effectively within the organization.

translations.source: በዚህ ምክንያት አንድን መሰናክል ለማሸነፍ በአንድነት የሚሠራው ድርጅት የደንበኛውን ፍላጎት ለማገልገል ወደ አዲስ የፈጠራ ሂደት ሊያመራ ይችላል።
translations.reference: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
translations.hypothesis: As a result, a startup that is able to rally a group of people together to solve a problem can lead to innovation that serves the customer.

translations.source: አንድ ድርጅት ፈጠሪ ከመሆኑ በፊት አመራር የፈጠራ ስራ ባህል እንዲሁም የጋራ ዕውቀት እና ድርጅታዊ ትምህርት መፍጠር አለበት።
translations.reference: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
translations.hypothesis: Before an organization can be innovative, it needs to create a culture of innovation as well as knowledge sharing and organizational learning.

translations.source: አንጄል (2006) ፣ የተቋሙ አካሄድ ድርጅቶችን ወደ ከፍተኛ የሥራ አፈፃፀም እንዲደርሱ ለማገዝ ጥቅም ላይ የዋለበትን ቀጣይ ዘዴን ያስረዳል።
translations.reference: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
translations.hypothesis: Angel (2006) explains the process that the firm went through to help the companies reach their full potential.

translations.source: ኒውሮባዮሎጂካል ውሂብ የመገንዘብ ምርመራን ቲዎሬቲካል አቀራረብ በተመለከተ አካላዊ ማስረጃ ይሰጣል። ስለዚህ የምርምር ስፋቱን ያጠበዋል እና የበለጠ ትክክለኛ ያደርገዋል።
translations.reference: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
translations.hypothesis: Neurobiological data provide physiological evidence to support the theoretical approach of the diagnostic criteria. Thus, it maintains the breadth of the research and increases its accuracy.

translations.source: በአይምሮ የበሽታ ጥናት እና በባህሪ መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት ተመራማሪዎችን በምርምራቸው ያግዛቸዋል።
translations.reference: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
translations.hypothesis: The relationship between brain disorders and behaviour is a subject of intense research.

translations.source: የተለያዩ የአንጎል ጉዳት ዓይነቶች ፣ የስሜት ቁስሎች፣ ቁስሎች እና የውስጥ እብጠቶች በባህሪ ላይ ተጽዕኖ እንደሚያሳድሩ እና በአንዳንድ የአእምሮ ተግባራት ላይ ለውጥ እንደሚያመጡ ከረዥም ጊዜ ጀምሮ ይታወቃል።
translations.reference: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
translations.hypothesis: It has long been known that different forms of brain injury, sensory deprivation, infections and endocrine disorders can affect behaviour and give rise to specific patterns of cognitive change.

translations.source: የአዳዲስ ቴክኖሎጂዎች መምጣት የአንጎል መዋቅሮችን እና ሂደቶችን ከዚህ በፊት ታይቶ በማይታወቅ መንገድ እንድንመለከት እና እንድንመረምር ይፈቅድልናል።
translations.reference: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
translations.hypothesis: The emergence of new technologies allows us to observe and investigate brain structures and processes in unprecedented detail.

translations.source: ይህ በአዕምሮአችን ውስጥ ሂደቶችን እንድንረዳ የሚረዱ የማስመሰያ ሞዴሎችን ለመገንባት ብዙ መረጃዎችን እና ቁሳቁሶችን ይሰጠናል።
translations.reference: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
translations.hypothesis: This provides a wealth of data and resources that can be used to build predictive models to help us understand the processes in the brain.

translations.source: AI የሳይንሳዊ ልቦለድ ጠንካራ ምልከታ ቢኖረውም፣ AI በማሽን ውስጥ ስለ ባህሪይ፣ መማር እና ጉብዝና ማስለመድ የሚያጠና የኮምፒውተር ሳይንስ በጣም አስፈላጊ ክፍል ነው።
translations.reference: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
translations.hypothesis: While AI has a science fiction veneer, AI is actually a very important branch of computer science that studies how to make computers behave, learn and solve problems.

translations.source: በ AI ውስጥ የሚደረግ ምርምር ብልህ ባህሪን የሚጠይቁ ስራዎችን በራስ-ሰር ለማከናወን ማሽኖችን መስራትን ያካትታል።
translations.reference: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
translations.hypothesis: Research in AI involves the design of machines that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence.

translations.source: ምሳሌዎች ቁጥጥርን ፣ እቅድ ማውጣት እና የጊዜ ሰሌዳ ማውጣት ፣ ለደንበኞች ምርመራዎች እና ጥያቄዎች መልስ የመስጠት ችሎታ ፣ እንዲሁም የእጅ ጽሑፍ መለየትን ፣ የድምጽ እና የፊት ያካትታሉ።
translations.reference: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
translations.hypothesis: Examples include automated control, planning and scheduling, ability to respond to customer needs and requests, and speech, audio and facial recognition.

translations.source: እንደነዚህ ያሉት ነገሮች የተለዩ ስርዓቶች ሆነዋል ፣ ይህም ለእውነተኛ የሕይወት ችግሮች መፍትሄ መስጠት ላይ ያተኮረ ነው።
translations.reference: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
translations.hypothesis: Such things are systems that are made to solve real world problems.

translations.source: የሰው ሠራሽ ብልህነት ሥርዓት አሁን በኢኮኖሚክስ፣ ሕክምና ፣ ምህንድስና እና የውትድርና ዘርፎች ላይ በአብዛኛው ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል፤ በብዙ የቤት ኮምፒውተሮች እና የቪዲዮ ጨዋታ መተግበሪያዎች ላይም ተወህዶ ተሠርቷል።
translations.reference: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
translations.hypothesis: AI is now most commonly used in economics, medicine, engineering and the gaming industry, and is integrated into many home computer applications and video games.

translations.source: የመስክ ጉዞዎች የማንኛውም ክፍል ዋና አካል ናቸው። ብዙ ጊዜ አስተማሪዋ ተማሪዎቿን በአውቶቡስ መሄድ ወደ ማይቻልባቸው ቦታዎች መውሰድ ትመርጣለች።
translations.reference: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
translations.hypothesis: Field trips are a major component of any class. Often the teacher will take the students on a bus to places the students would not be able to go on their own.

translations.source: ቴክኖሎጂ ከምናባዊ የመስክ ጉዞ መፍትሄውን ይሰጣል። ተማሪዎች የሙዝየሞችን ቅርሶች በመመልከት ፣ የውሃ አካባቢያቸውን በመጎብኘት ወይም በክፍላቸው ሲቀመጡ የሚያምር ስነ-ጥበቦችን ማድነቅ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
translations.hypothesis: Technology provides the solution to virtual field trips. Students can now view museum collections, visit a rainforest, or examine a cell up close while sitting in their classroom.

translations.source: የመስክ ጉዞን በቨርቹዋል መጋራት እንዲሁ በጉዞ ላይ ለማንፀባረቅ እና ለወደፊቱ ትምህርቶች ልምዶችን ለማካፈል ጥሩ መንገድ ነው።
translations.reference: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
translations.hypothesis: Sharing field visits virtually can be a good way to reflect on the visit and to share lessons learnt for further learning.

translations.source: ለምሳሌ፣ በሰሜን ካሮላይና ውስጥ ከሚገኙት የቤኔት ት/ቤት ተማሪዎች በየአመቱ ወደ ግዛቱ ዋና ከተማ ስለሚያደርጉት ጉዞ የድረ-ገጽ ዲዛይን ያዘጋጃሉ፣ በየዓመቱ ድረ-ገጹ እንደገና ይስተካከላል፣ ነገር ግን ነባር ስሪቶች እንደ ማጣቀሻ ስለሚያገለግሉ በመስመር ላይ ይቆያሉ።
translations.reference: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
translations.hypothesis: For example, students at Bennett College in North Carolina create a website for the state's capital city Raleigh each year, which is updated annually, but the old versions are preserved online as a reference.

translations.source: ብሎጎች እንዲሁ የተማሪዎችን አፃፃፍ ለማሻሻል ሊረዱ ይችላሉ። ተማሪዎች ብዙውን ጊዜ የብሎግ ልምዳቸውን በተዛባ ሰዋሰው እና አጻጻፍ ቢጀምሩም ፣ የታዳሚዎች መኖር በአጠቃላይ ያንን ይለውጣል።
translations.reference: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
translations.hypothesis: Blogs can also help students improve their writing. While students may start their blogging experience with poor grammar and sentence structure, the presence of an audience generally changes that.

translations.source: ተማሪዎች ብዙውን ጊዜ በጣም ወሳኝ ታዳሚዎች ስለሆኑ የብሎግ ጸሐፊው ትችቶችን ለማስወገድ ጽሑፎችን ለማሻሻል መጣር ይጀምራል።
translations.reference: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
translations.hypothesis: Students are often the target audience for a blog writer's efforts to improve their writing and avoid criticism.

translations.source: እንዲሁም ብሎግ ማድረግ “ተማሪዎች በዙሪያቸው ስላለው ዓለም የበለጠ እውቀት እንዲኖራቸው ያስገድዳቸዋል።” የታዳሚዎችን ፍላጎት የመመገብ አስፈላጊነት ተማሪዎች ጎበዝ እና ሳቢ እንዲሆኑ ያነሳሳቸዋል (Toto, 2004)።
translations.reference: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
translations.hypothesis: Blogging also "forces students to be more aware of the world around them." The need to engage an audience keeps students interested and motivated (Toto, 2004).

translations.source: ብሎግ መጻፍ ትብብርን የሚያነቃቃ እና ተማሪዎች ከተለመደው የትምህርት ቀን ባሻገር ትምህርታቸውን በደንብ እንዲያሳድጉ የሚያበረታታ መሳሪያ ነው።
translations.reference: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
translations.hypothesis: Blogging is a tool that fosters collaboration and encourages students to take ownership of their learning beyond the regular class hours.

translations.source: የብሎጎች ተገቢ አጠቃቀም "ተማሪዎችን ተንታኝና እና ጠንካራ ተቺዎች እንዲሆኑ ያጠናክራቸዋል፤ ለበይነመረብ የትምህርት ቁሳቁሶች በትጋት ምላሽ በመስጠት ተማሪዎች በሌሎች ጽሑፎች ከሌሎች አንጻር ያላቸውን አቋም መግለፅ እንዲሁም በተወሰኑ ጉዳዮች የራሳቸውን አመለካካት መግለፅ ይችላሉ (ኦራቬክ 2002)።
translations.reference: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
translations.hypothesis: Blogs can encourage students to become more engaged and critical consumers of information, as they respond to each other's ideas and to published material online, and can be used to encourage students to express their own point of view (O'Rourke 2002).

translations.source: ኦታዋ የካናዳ ማራኪ ፣ የሁለት ቋንቋ ተናጋሪ ካፒታል ስትሆን፣ የካናዳ ያለፈውን እና የአሁኑን የሚያሳዩ በርካታ የጥበብ ማዕከለ-ስዕላት እና ሙዚየሞች ይገኙባታል።
translations.reference: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
translations.hypothesis: Ottawa, the capital of Canada, is a bilingual city with many museums and art galleries that show the country's past and present.

translations.source: በደቡብ በኩል የኒያጋራ ፎልስ የሚገኝ ሲሆን በስተ ሰሜን ደግሞ የሙስኮካ እና ከዚያ ወዲያ ያልተነካ የተፈጥሮ ውበት ይገኛል።
translations.reference: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
translations.hypothesis: To the south is the Niagara Falls and to the north are the Muskoka and Algonquin regions with their untouched natural beauty.

translations.source: እነዚህ ሁሉ ነገሮች እና ሌሎችም ኦንታሪዮን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ ካናዳዊ ተብሎ በውጪ ሰዎች እንደ የሚታሰበው ያስቀምጣታል።
translations.reference: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
translations.hypothesis: All these things and more contribute to making Ontario what foreigners see as the safest place in Canada.

translations.source: በሰሜን በኩል ሰፋ ያሉ ሰፋፊ ቦታዎች እምብዛም ከመሆናቸውም በላይ አንዳንዶቹ የማይኖሩባቸው ምድረ በዳ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
translations.hypothesis: The northern half is largely desert, with only a few oases and some areas of sparse vegetation.

translations.source: ብዙዎችን ለሚያስደንቅ የሕዝብ ብዛት ንፅፅር የካናዳ ዜጎች ከሚኖሩት የበዙ በአሜሪካ የሚኖሩ አፍሪካዊ አሜሪካኖች አሉ።
translations.reference: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
translations.hypothesis: For a sizable population, consider that more African Americans live in the United States than the number of citizens in Canada.

translations.source: የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ደሴቶች ከአፍሪካ ምሥራቃዊ የባሕር ዳርቻ በሕንድ ውቅያኖስ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
translations.reference: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
translations.hypothesis: The East African islands are an archipelago located in the Indian Ocean off the coast of East Africa.

translations.source: ዱር እንስሳትን በተመለከተ ማዳጋስካር እስካሁን ካሉት በጣም ትልቁ እና በራሱ አንድ አህጉር ነው።
translations.reference: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: As far as wildlife is concerned, Madagascar is the largest and most diverse island in the world.

translations.source: አብዛኛዎቹ ትንንሽ ደሴቶች እራሳቸውን የቻሉ ሃገራት ናቸው ወይም ከፈረንሳይ ጋር የተያያዙ ናቸው እናም የቅንጦት የባሕር ዳርቻ ሪዞርቶች በመባል ይታወቃሉ።
translations.reference: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the small islands are independent nations or associated with France and are known for their luxurious beach resorts.

translations.source: አረቦቹ እስልምናንም ወደ ምድሪቱ አመጡ እናም በኮሞሮ እና በማዮቴ ውስጥ በጣም ተሰራጭቷል።
translations.reference: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
translations.hypothesis: Arabs also brought Islam to the continent, and it is the dominant religion in Comoros and Mayotte.

translations.source: ፖርቱጋላዊው ተመራማሪ ቫስኮ ዳ ጋማ የኬፕ መስመርን ከአውሮፓ እስከ ህንድ ስላገኘው የአውሮፓ ተጽዕኖ እና ቅኝ ግዛት በ 15 ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ተጀመረ።
translations.reference: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
translations.hypothesis: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century with the Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama finding a sea route from Europe to India around the Cape of Good Hope.

translations.source: በሰሜን በኩል ክልሉ በሳህል እና በደቡብ እና ምዕራብ በአትላንቲክ ውቅያኖስ ይዋሰናል።
translations.reference: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
translations.hypothesis: The region is bordered to the north by the Sahara desert and to the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.

translations.source: ሴቶች፡ የትኛውም የሴቶች ተጓዦች ትክክለኛ የጋብቻ ሁኔታ ምንም ይሁን ምን ማግባታቸውን ቢናገሩ ይመከራል።
translations.reference: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
translations.hypothesis: Women: Any women travelling alone should be aware of the local attitude to unveiled women, whatever their marital status.

translations.source: ቀለበት ማድረግም ጠቃሚ ነው (ብዙ ውድ የማይመስል ይሁን እንጂ።
translations.reference: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
translations.hypothesis: It's also worth getting a SIM card (though less so than it used to be).

translations.source: ሴቶች የባህል ልዩነቶች እነሱ ትንኮሳ ብለው ወደሚያስቡት እንደሚያመራ ማሰብ አለባቸው እና መከተል እና በእጅ መጎተት ወዘተ. ያልተለመደ አይደለም።
translations.reference: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
translations.hypothesis: Women should be wary of cultural differences that may lead them to think they are being insulted and not just walking away or turning the other cheek.

translations.source: ወንዶችን እምቢ በማለት ላይ ጠንካራ ይሁኑ እና አቋምዎን ለመያዝ አይፍሩ (የባህል ልዩነቶች ኖሩም አልኖሩም፣ ደህና አያደርገውም!)።
translations.reference: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
translations.hypothesis: Be firm about not wanting male partners and don't be afraid to state your boundaries (cultural differences notwithstanding, it's not your job to educate or please).

translations.source: ዘመናዊቷ የካዛብላንካ ከተማ በ 10 ኛው ክ / ዘ ከክርስቶስ ልደት በፊት በበርበር አሳ አጥማጆች የተቋቋመች ስትሆን ፊንቄያውያን ፣ ሮማውያን እና ሜሬኒዶች አንፋ የተባለ ስትራቴጂካዊ ወደብ ሆና ታገለግል ነበር።
translations.reference: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
translations.hypothesis: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by the Berbers in the 10th century BC and Phoenicians, Romans and Merinids used it as a strategic port called Anfa.

translations.source: ፖርቹጊዞቹ አፈረሱት እና ካዛ ብራንካ በሚል ስም መልሰው ገነቡት፣ በ1755 ከመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በኋላ መልሰው ተዉት።
translations.reference: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
translations.hypothesis: The Portuguese rebuilt it, and renamed it Vila Branca, which was destroyed in the 1755 earthquake.

translations.source: የሞሮኮው ሱልጣን ከተማዋን ዳሩ ኤል ባድያ ብሎ በመሰየም እንደገና የገነባት ሲሆን እዚያ የንግድ ቦታዎችን ባቋቋሙ የስፔን ነጋዴዎች ካዛብላንካ የሚል ስያሜ ተሰጥቶታል።
translations.reference: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
translations.hypothesis: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city and renamed it Dar el-Badia, while the Spanish merchants, who established a trading post there, called it Casablanca.

translations.source: ካዛብላንካ በሁሉም ሞሮኮ ውስጥ ለመገብየት በዝቅተኛ ደረጃ አስደሳች ከሆኑ ቦታዎች አንዱ ነው።
translations.reference: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
translations.hypothesis: Casablanca is one of the most interesting places to visit in all of Morocco.

translations.source: በአሮጌው መዲና ዙሪያ እንደ የሸክላ ሳህን፣ የሸክላ ዕቃዎች፣ የቆዳ ውጤቶች፣ የሺሻ ማጨሻዎች እና አጠቃላይ የጌጋዎች ያሉ ባህላዊ የሞሮኮ እቃዎች ሲሸጡ ማግኘት ቀላል ነው፣ ግን ይህ ሁሉ ለቱሪስቶች ነው።
translations.reference: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
translations.hypothesis: Traditional Moroccan goods such as tagines, ceramics, leather goods, babouches and kaftans can be found for sale around the old city, but cater mostly to tourists.

translations.source: ጎማ በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ምስራቅ ጫፍ ሩዋንዳ አቅራቢያ የምትገኝ የቱሪስት ከተማ ናት።
translations.reference: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
translations.hypothesis: Goma is a city in eastern Congo, close to the Rwandan border, and a tourist destination.

translations.source: በ2002 ጎማ አብዛኛው የከተማው ጎዳናዎች በተለይም የከተማውን መሃል ኒያራጎንጎ የእሳተ ገሞራ ፍንዳታ አውድሞ ቀብሮታል።
translations.reference: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
translations.hypothesis: In 2002, Goma's southern districts, including the city centre of Nyiragongo, were buried by lava.

translations.source: ጎማ በተመጣጣኝ ሁኔታ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ቢሆንም፣ ከጎማ ውጭ የሚደረጉ ማናቸውም ጉብኝቶች በሰሜን ኪቪ አውራጃ የቀጠለውን የውጊያ ሁኔታ ለመረዳት ጥናት መደረግ አለባቸው።
translations.reference: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
translations.hypothesis: While Goma is relatively secure, any travel outside of Goma should be undertaken with an understanding of the ongoing insecurity in the North Kivu province.

translations.source: በአፍሪካ ውስጥ በጣም ርካሽ ከሆኑት የተራራ ጎሪላ ፍለጋዎች መሆኗን አክሎ ከተማዋ የኒራጎንጎ እሳተ-ገሞራ ለመውጣት መሠረትም ናት።
translations.reference: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
translations.hypothesis: It is also the base for the cheapest gorilla tours in Africa, and a starting point for climbing Mount Nyiragongo.

translations.source: ወደ ጎማ ለመዞር ቦዳ-ቦዳ (የሞተር ብስክሌት ታክሲ) መጠቀም ይችላሉ። መደበኛው (አካባቢያዊ) ዋጋ ለአጭር ጉዞ ~ 500 የኮንጎ ፍራንክ ነው።
translations.reference: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
translations.hypothesis: You can use the bodas (motorcycle taxis) to get around. The normal (local) price for a short ride is ~500 CFA.

translations.source: በአንፃራዊነት ተደራሽነቷ ካለመኖር ጋር ተጣምሮ፣ "ቲምቡክቱ" ብርቅ እና ሩቅ ለሆኑ ምድሮች እንደ አቃቂራዊ ተምሳሌት እንድንገለገልባት ሆናለች።
translations.reference: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
translations.hypothesis: In relative inaccessibility, Timbuktu has long served as a metaphor for remoteness.

translations.source: ዛሬም፣ ቲምቡክቱ ምንም እንኳን ዝናዋ የቱሪስት መስህብ ቢያደርጋትም፣ እና አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ቢኖራትም፣ ድሃ ከተማ ናት።
translations.reference: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
translations.hypothesis: Today, Timbuktu is a poor town, though its fame has made it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.

translations.source: በ 1990 በበረሃ አሸዋዎች ስጋት ምክንያት በአደጋ ላይ ካሉ የዓለም ቅርሶች ዝርዝር ውስጥ ተጨምራለች።
translations.reference: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
translations.hypothesis: In 1990 it was added to the List of World Heritage in Danger due to the threat of desertification.

translations.source: በሄነሪ ሉዊስ ጌትስ ፒቢኤስ የአፍሪካ አለም አስገራሚ ነገሮች ላይ አንዱ ዋና ማቆሚያ ነበር።
translations.reference: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
translations.hypothesis: The Henry Louis Gates PBS series on African American history was one of the most important things to happen to black people in a long time.

translations.source: ከአፍሪካነት የበለጠ የአረብ ገጽታ ስላላት፣ ከተማዋ ከሌሎቹ የአገሪቱ ከተሞች ጋር ፍጹም ተቃራኒ ናት።
translations.reference: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
translations.hypothesis: With more Arab influence than the rest of the country, the city is a world apart from the rest of the nation.

translations.source: ክሩገር ብሔራዊ ፓርክ (ኬኤንፒ) ከደቡብ አፍሪካ በሰሜን ምስራቅ የሚገኝ ሲሆን፣ በምስራቅ የሞዛምቢክ ድንበር ያዋስነዋል፣ በሰሜን ዚምባብዌ፣ እና የደቡብ ድንበሩ ክሮኮዳይል ወንዝ ነው።
translations.reference: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
translations.hypothesis: Kruger National Park (KNP) is in northeastern South Africa, bordering Mozambique to the east, Zimbabwe to the north, and the Crocodile River to the south.

translations.source: ፓርኩ 19,500 ኪ.ሜ² የሚሸፍን ሲሆን፤ በ14 የተለያዩ የኢኮ ዞኖች ተከፋፍሏል፤ እያንዳንዱ የተለያየ የዱር ህይወት ይዟል።
translations.reference: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: The park covers 19,500 km2 and is divided into 14 different eco-zones, each with its own unique wildlife.

translations.source: ይህ የደቡብ አፍሪካ ዋና መስህቦች አንዱ ነው፣ እናም የደቡብ አፍሪካ ብሔራዊ ፓርኮች (SANParks) ዋና ምልክት ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል።
translations.reference: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
translations.hypothesis: This is one of South Africa's most important nature reserves, and is considered to be the flagship park of SANParks.

translations.source: እንደ ሁሉም የደቡብ አፍሪካ ብሔራዊ ፓርኮች ሁሉ ለፓርኩ የቀን በቀን ጥበቃና የመግቢያ ክፍያዎች አሉ።
translations.reference: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
translations.hypothesis: Like all of South Africa's national parks, there are conservation and entrance fees to the park.

translations.source: አንድ ሰው በደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ላሉት ፓርኮችም ሆነ ለሁሉም የደቡብ አፍሪካ ብሔራዊ ፓርኮች መግቢያ ምርጫ የሚሰጥ የዱር ካርድ መግዛት ጠቃሚ ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
translations.hypothesis: It may be worth getting a Wild Card if you intend to visit more than a few of the parks in South Africa, or any of the South African National Parks.

translations.source: የሆንግ ኮንግ ደሴት የሆንግ ኮንግ ግዛት ስያሜ የሰጠው ሲሆን ብዙ ቱሪስቶች እንደ ዋና ትኩረት የሚመለከቱት ቦታ ነው።
translations.reference: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
translations.hypothesis: Hong Kong Island gave its name to the Hong Kong state and is the place most tourists will focus on.

translations.source: የሆንግ ኮንግ ሰማይን የሰሩት የፎቆች ድርድር በቪክቶሪያ ሃርበር ምክንያት የሚያብለጨልጭ ከሆነው የባር ቻርት ጋር ተነፃፅሯል።
translations.reference: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
translations.hypothesis: The Hong Kong skyline is compared to the neon-lit bars of Victoria Harbour.

translations.source: የሆንግ ኮንግን ምርጥ ዕይታዎች ለማግኘት፣ ደሴቱን ትተው ወደ ኮውሉን የውሃ ግንባር ተቃራኒ ይሂዱ።
translations.reference: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
translations.hypothesis: For the best views of Hong Kong, take the Star Ferry across Victoria Harbour to Kowloon.

translations.source: አብዛኛው የሆንግ ኮንግ ደሴት የከተማ ልማት በሰሜናዊው ዳርቻ ላይ ከተመለሰው መሬት ላይ ተጠቅጥቋል።
translations.reference: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
translations.hypothesis: Most of Hong Kong Island's urban area is built on land reclaimed along its northern coast.

translations.source: ይህ የእንግሊዝ ቅኝ ገዥዎች እንደራሳቸው የወሰዱት ቦታ ነው እናም ስለዚህ የክልሉን የቅኝ ግዛት ዘመን ማስረጃ ከፈለጉ ይህ ለመጀመር ጥሩ ቦታ ነው።
translations.reference: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
translations.hypothesis: This is where the British colonialists first took over the country and if you're looking for a starting point for your exploration of the colonial history of the region then this is a good place to start.

translations.source: ሳንዳርባን በዓለም ትልቁ የማንግሮቭ ዳርቻ ይዘት ናቸው፣ ከባንግላዴሽ እና ህንድ ሰፈሮች ዳርቻው 80 ኪ.ሜ (50 ማይል) ይዘረጋል።
translations.reference: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
translations.hypothesis: The Sundarbans are home to the largest mangrove forest in the world, and extend across 80 km (50 mi) of the delta region of Bangladesh and India.

translations.source: ሰንዳርባን የዩኔስኮ የዓለም ቅርስ መሆኗ ታውጇል። በሕንድ ግዛት ውስጥ ያለው የደን ክፍል ሰንዳርባንስ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ ተብሎ ይጠራል።
translations.reference: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
translations.hypothesis: Sunderbans is declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The forested area in the Indian state of West Bengal is known as the Sundarbans National Park.

translations.source: ነገር ግን ደኖቹ የማንግሮቭ ረግረጋማዎች ብቻ አይደሉም - በአንድ ወቅት የጋንጌቲክ ሜዳን የሸፈኑትን አስፈሪ ጫካዎች የመጨረሻ ቀሪዎችን ያካትታሉ።
translations.reference: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
translations.hypothesis: But the mangroves are not the only remaining traces of the once vast Gangetic plains delta; they include the last vestiges of the petrified wood forests that once covered the Gangetic plain.

translations.source: ሰንዳርባን 3,850 ኪ.ሜ² ፣ ስፋት ይይዛል፣ ከዚህም አንድ-ሦስተኛው በውሃ/በረግረግማ ስፍራዎች የተሸፈነ ነው።
translations.reference: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
translations.hypothesis: Sendai spans 3,850 km2, a third of which is covered in forests and mountains.

translations.source: ከ1966 ጀምሮ ሰንዳርባኖች የዱር እንስሳት መኖሪያ ሆነዋል፣ እናም በአሁኑ ጊዜ በአካባቢው 400 ሮያል ቤንጋል ነብሮች እና 30,000 አካባቢ ነጠብጣብ ያለባቸው ሚዳቋ እንደሚገኙ ይገመታል።
translations.reference: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
translations.hypothesis: Since 1966, the Sundarbans have been home to the Bengal tiger, and it is now estimated that there are around 400 Royal Bengal tigers and 30,000 spotted deer in the area.

translations.source: አውቶቡሶች ቀኑን ሙሉ ከየአውራጃው የአውቶቡስ መናኸሪያ (ከወንዙ ማዶ) ይነሳሉ ፣ ምንም እንኳን አብዛኛዎቹ በተለይም ወደ ምስራቅ እና ጃካር/ቡምታን የሚጓዙት ከ 06:30 እስከ 07:30 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ ይነሳሉ።
translations.reference: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
translations.hypothesis: Buses depart throughout the day from the main bus station in the district (across the river), although most, especially those heading east towards Jakarta/Buitenzorg, leave between 06:30 and 07:30.

translations.source: የወረዳ ውስጥ አውቶቡሶች በብዛት ሙሉ ስለሆኑ፣ ትንሽ ቀናት ቀደም ብሎ ትኬት መግዛት ይመከራል።
translations.reference: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
translations.hypothesis: It is recommended to book your bus tickets a few days in advance, as the buses are often full.

translations.source: አብዛኞቹ ወረዳዎች ምቹ እና ጠንካራ በሆኑ ትናንሽ የጃፓን ኮስተር አውቶቡሶች ይገለገላሉ።
translations.reference: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
translations.hypothesis: Most districts are served by comfortable and reliable small Japanese coastal buses.

translations.source: እንደ ፓሮ (Nu 150) እና ፓኑካ (Nu 200) ያሉ የጋራ ታክሲዎች በአቅራቢያ ወዳሉ ቦታዎች ለመጓዝ ፈጣን እና ምቹ መንገዶች ናቸው።
translations.reference: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
translations.hypothesis: Shared taxis, such as the paro (Nu 150) and phunu (Nu 200), are a convenient and relatively quick way to get to the closer valleys.

translations.source: የኦያፖክ ወንዝ ድልድይ በገመድ የተሰራ ድልድይ ነው። የብራዚልን የኦኢፖክ ከተማና በፈረንሳይ ጊኒ የሚገኘውን ሴንት-ጎርጅስ ዲ ለኦያበክ ለማገናኘት ሙሉ የኦያፖክ ወንዝን ይሸፈናል።
translations.reference: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
translations.hypothesis: The Oiapoque River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It connects the Brazilian town of Oiapoque with Saint-Georges-de-l'Oya in French Guiana across the Oiapoque River.

translations.source: ሁለቱ ማማዎች ከፍታቸው 83 ሜትር ነው፣ ቁመቱ 378 ሜትር ሲሆን 3.50 ሜትር ስፋት ያለው ሁለት መንገድ አለው።
translations.reference: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
translations.hypothesis: The two towers are 83 metres (272 ft) tall, 378 metres (1,240 ft) long, and 3.5 metres (11.5 ft) wide, and have two lanes of traffic.

translations.source: ከድልድዩ ስር ያለው ቀጥታ ከፍታ 15 ሜትር ነው። ግንባታ የተጠናቀቀው በኦገስት 2011 ነው፣ እስከ ማርች 2017 ለህዝብ ክፍት አልሆነም።
translations.reference: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
translations.hypothesis: The direct drop from the top of the tower is 15 m (49 ft). Construction was completed in August 2011, but it was not opened to the public until March 2017.

translations.source: የብራዚል የጉምሩክ ፍተሻ ይጠናቀቃል ተብሎ በሚጠበቅበት፣በሴፕቴምበር 2017 ድልድዩ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲሠራ ታቅዷል።
translations.reference: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
translations.hypothesis: The bridge was scheduled to be fully operational by September 2017, when the Brazilian customs inspection is expected to be completed.

translations.source: ጓራኒ አሁን ምስራቅ ፓራጓይ የሆነው ውስጥ ከእጅ ወደ አፍ ግብርናንም እየሰሩ እንደ ክፊል-ዘላን አዳኞች የሚኖሩ፣ በጣም አስፈላጊ የሃገሩ ተወላጅ ቡድን ነበሩ።
translations.reference: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
translations.hypothesis: The Guarani were the most important indigenous group in what is now eastern Paraguay, living as semi-sedentary agriculturalists and hunters, and practicing oral tradition.

translations.source: የቻኮ ክልል እንደ ጓይኩሩ እና ፓያጉዋ ያሉ ሌሎች የአገሬው ተወላጅ ጎሳዎች በአደን ፣ በመሰብሰብ እና በማጥመድ የተረፉ ነበሩ።
translations.reference: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
translations.hypothesis: The Chaco region was inhabited by other indigenous groups such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá who were left to their own devices after the decimation of the native population by the Spanish.

translations.source: በ 16 ኛው መቶ ክፍለ ዘመን ፓራጓይ፣ ቀደም ሲል “የሕንዶች ግዙፍ ግዛት”፣ ተብሎ ይጠራ የነበረው የተወለደው የእስፔን ድል አድራጊዎች ከአገር-በቀል ቡድኖች ጋርተጋጥመው በመጣው ውጤት ነው።
translations.reference: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
translations.hypothesis: In the 16th century Paraguay, once called the "Giant of the South", was the result of a Spanish victory over the native Guarani people.

translations.source: ስፔናውያን ለሦስት መቶ ዓመታት የቆየውን የቅኝ ግዛት ዘመን ጀመሩ።
translations.reference: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The Spanish began a three-hundred-year colonial period.

translations.source: በ 1537 አሱንሱዮን ከተመሠረተበት ጊዜ አንስቶ፣ ፓራጓይ ብዙ አገር በቀል ባህሪያትን እና ማንነቶችን ለማቆየት ችላለች።
translations.reference: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
translations.hypothesis: Since its founding in 1537, Paraguay has managed to preserve many of its native cultural traits and identities.

translations.source: አርጀንቲና በአለም ላይ በጣም ምርጥ ከሆኑት የፖሎ ቡድኖች እና ተጫዋቾች አንዱን በመያዝ በደምብ ትታወቃለች።
translations.reference: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
translations.hypothesis: Argentina is known to be one of the best, if not the best, polo playing nation in the world.

translations.source: የዓመቱ ታላቅ ውድድር በዲሴምበር ላስ ካኒታስ ውስጥ ፖሎ መስኮቹ ጋር ያካሄዳል።
translations.reference: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
translations.hypothesis: The big event of the year is the December Classic held at the Polo Fields in Las Canitas.

translations.source: እዚህ በሌሎች የአመቱ ጊዜያትም ትንንሽ ውድድሮች እና ጨዋታዎችም ሊታዩ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
translations.hypothesis: Here you can also find smaller events and games at other times of the year.

translations.source: ለውድድሮች ዜናዎችና ለፖሎ ጨዋታዎች የት ትኬቶችን እንደሚገዙ አሶሴሽን አርጀንቲና ዲ ፖሎን ይመልከቱ።
translations.reference: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
translations.hypothesis: See Asociacion Argentina de Polo for where to buy tickets for news and polo matches.

translations.source: ኦፊሲያላዊ የፎክላንድ መገበያያ ዋጋው ከአንድ የብሪታኒያ ፓውንድ (ጂቢፒ) ጋር እኩል የተቀመተው የፎክላንድ ፓውንድ (ኤፍኬፒ) ነው።
translations.reference: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
translations.hypothesis: The official currency of the Falkland Islands is the Falkland Pound (FKP), which is equal in value to the British Pound (GBP).

translations.source: ገንዘብ ከ FIC ዌስት መደብር ባሻገር በስታንሌይ በሚገኙት ደሴቶች ብቸኛው ባንክ ሊለወጥ ይችላል።
translations.reference: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
translations.hypothesis: Money can only be changed at the bank in Stanley, which is also the only bank on the islands, other than the ATM at the FIC West store.

translations.source: የብሪታንያ ፓውንድ በአጠቃላይ በደሴቶቹ ላይ በማንኛውም ቦታ ተቀባይነት አላቸው እንዲሁም የስታንሊ የክሬዲት ካርዶች እና የአሜሪካ ዶላርም እንዲሁ ብዙውን ጊዜ ተቀባይነት አላቸው።
translations.reference: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
translations.hypothesis: The British pound is widely accepted throughout the islands, as are US dollars and most major credit cards.

translations.source: የብሪታኒያና ዩናይትድ ስቴትስ መገበያያ ሊወሰድ ቢችልም በውጨኞቹ ደሴቶች የዱቤ ካርዶች ተቀባይነት ላይኖራቸው ይችላል፤ ተቀባይነት ያለው የክፍያ ዘዴ ምን እንደሆነ ከባልተቤቶቹ ጋር ቀድመው ያረጋግጡ።
translations.reference: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
translations.hypothesis: While most BritRail and USA Rail Passes are only valid on certain routes, the Eurail Pass is valid on almost all major routes in Europe.

translations.source: የፋልክላንድን ገንዘብ ከዴሴቱ ውጪ መለወጥ የማይቻል ነገር ነው፤ ስለዚህ ደሴቱን ከመልቀቅዎ በፊት ገንዘብዎን ይለውጡ።
translations.reference: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
translations.hypothesis: It is not possible to exchange Falkland currency outside the islands, so exchange your money back before you leave.

translations.source: ከሞንቴቪዲዮ ከምድር ወገብ በስተደቡብ ስለሆነ፣ በሰሜናዊ ንፍቀ ክበብ ክረምት ሲሆን በዚያው በጋ እና በተቃራኒው ደግሞ ክረምት ነው።
translations.reference: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
translations.hypothesis: Because it is located south of the Equator, it is summer in the Southern Hemisphere and winter in the north.

translations.source: ሞንቴቪዲዮ ከፊል ሞቃታማ ክፍል ውስጥ ይገኛል፤ በበጋ ወራት፣ +30°C የሙቀት መጠኖች የተለመዱ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
translations.hypothesis: Montevideo is located in a subtropical region, and summer temperatures can often exceed +30 °C.
